dpe baspun gsal bshad/ /spyir deng sang 'dzam gling gi srid 'byor rig gsum 'phel rgyas byung ba dang bstun/ rang rigs bod kyi rig gnas dang / lo rgyus/ goms gshis dang srol rgyun sogs nyams pa sor chud dang /mi nyams gong 'phel byed rgyu ni rang cag la ma khur rang babs kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu gyur ba dang / mi rigs gzhan dag gi shes rig dang dpung rdang gshib bzhin pa'i dus 'dir/ gang la'ang lo rgyus dang rgyu mtshan yang dag re yod pa shin tu gal che bar 'dug des na nga tshos da lan par du bskrun pa'i〈mi nyag dang ra this dgon gyi byung ba brjod pa chu dwangs nor bu'i phung po〉zhes pa 'di'ang mi lo 'ga'i sngon nas brtsams 'dug cing / nang don gtso bo bod dang 'brel ba'i mi nyag chen po'i 'phel 'grib bshad pa/ mi nyag yul gyi sgrub gnas spyi dang khyad par spyi shwa bkra shis dpal lung gi 1

gnas bshad pa/ mi nyag mkhas dbang lnga'i ya gyal ra this rma se ston pa rin chen bzang pos ra this dga' ldan gling rten dang brten pa phyag btab tshul dang / de 'dzin gyi skyes bu mkhas grub ye shes rdo rje dang / skyes mchog 'jam dbyangs grags pa sos/sa mkhan sprul skyes bu mang zhig gi rnam thar sogs mi lo bdun brgyar nye ba'i mi nyag yul gyi lo rgyus rnying pa dang ngag rgyun sna tshogs phyogs sdom byas yod pas/ bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas la dpyad zhib byed mkhan spyi dang / khyad par mi nyag gi lo rgyus dpyad zhib byed mkhan rnams la/ 'di ni rin thang can gyi lo rgyus shig tu mthong /des na lo rgyus zhib 'jug pa dang/ rgya che'i chos dad pa dag gi dgos mkhor dmigs nas nga tshos dpe bskrun bgyis pa lags na'ang / chad lhag dang/ nor 'khrul gang byung rgya cha'i klog pa po rnams kyis dgongs 'char dang nor bcos 'dzem med gnang bar zhu zhu/2

sngon du brjod pa'i gtam/(gcig) sa sgang gi go la sngo ril 'di'i steng du bod mi rigs ni mi rje lha yis mdzad cing srid 'byor rig gsum gang thad nas mi dman pas rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi rigs su 'dra zhig dang bsdur na ngo gnong mi dgos pa yin pas rgyal khab so so'i mkhas pa dag gis zhib 'jug byed yul du gyur pas ches dga' spro skye 'os pa zhig red/ yin na'ang dga' phyogs kho na la mgo 'khor na 'jig rten gyi dpe la pho shes med khog la chos sku 'char zer ba bzhin 'gyur bas thun min gyi chos rig gzhung la che sa nas bsam rgyu dang mtho sa nas blta rgyu ni gal 'gang che shos zhig yin/(gnyis) deng sang 'dzam gling mi rigs kyi khrod du bod gangs can zhes pa chos ldan gyi rgyal khab yin yang khams mi nyag ces logs su mtha' 'khob mun gling zhig tu cha 'jog lkug rtsis 3

byed mkhan yang nyung shas zhig mthong / de la dngos thog bden tshol gyis bshad na/ bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs rdzogs pa chen po sems klong man ngag gi sde rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po dang spang mi pham mgon po sogs las brgyud pa zam ma chad par byung ba dang mi nyag a ro ye shes 'byung gnas la mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bka' bab pa sogs byung / phyi dar gyi skabs su go rung seṅge grags kyi mdun du bla chen gyis 'dul lung sde bzhi gsan tshul dang mi nyag tsa mi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas grags dang mi nyag grags rin sogs kyis sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa dar spel mdzad pa'i lo rgyus de tsho ni gleng rin yod pa'i mdzad rjes shig dang nub pa med pa'i rdo ring zhig red pas khams mi nyag ni bstan pa'i 'byung khungs yin/yang gcig bshad na mi nyag rgyal po'i sras mo ru yong bza' rgyal mo btsun gyi sras btsan po gung ri gung btsan nas bzung chos srid gnyis la dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyal rgyud de dag kun mi nyag nas mched pas bod chen po'i chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po red ces bshad chog4

(gsum pa) mi nyag yul gyi rgyal blon gyi byung ba nyung shas zhig dang / de'i rjes 'brel du mi nyag ra this dgon gyi lo rgyus bsdus tsam dang gdan rabs dang mkhan rabs rim byung gi lo rgyus 'di ni〈spyod 'jug las〉bdag dang skal pa mnyam pa gzhan gyis kyang / /ci ste 'di dag mthong na don yod 'gyur/ /ces pa bzhin phyis 'byung gzhon nu dag la phan par 'gyur nges pa'i spobs sems 'gog med du shar bas 'das pa'i lo rgyus phyogs sdom dang da lta'i gnas babs la bsam gzhigs ma 'ongs pa'i phyogs la 'dzub ston gyi thabs lam 'di med na bya dngos mtha' dag gsar pa nas rnying pa rnying pa nas med par 'gyur ba ni chos nyid cig yin pas rang sa nas dar spel ma btang na sos dal mdo shor gyis yun thung mi tshe'i nyi ma nub la nye tshe 'phyis drags 'gro/ 'on kyang skyes sbyang gi shes rab dman zhing rtsom sgrig gi g.yul sar zhugs pa'i nyams myong med pas tshig don zung la skyon gyi cha mi nyung ba re yod pas gzu bo'i blos skyon brjod dang dag bcos 'dzem med du mdzad par bka' drin che//5

dkar chags dpe skrun gsal bshad/ (1)sngon du brjod pa'i gtam/ (3)mchod brjod/ (1)bod dang 'brel ba'i mi nyag gi chos srid dar tshul/ (6)bod kyi snod bcud grub tshul/ (7)mi nyag gi mi rigs dar rgyas byung tshul/ (12)chos srid khyad par ba dar tshul/ (18)bstan srid sil ma'i skabs dang mjug sdud pa/ (26)gang du 'chag pa'i gnas kyi che ba brjod pa/ (36)spyir gnas kyi dbye ba sogs bshad pa/ (36)gnas kyi chags yul bshad pa/ (39)gnas de'i phyogs bzhi'i gnas chen sogs bshad pa/ (46)1

gdan rabs bdun pa rab 'byams pa smon ༵ma dpal/ (105)gdan rabs brgyad pa mkhas grub rin chen legs pa/ (107)gdan rabs bcu ba tshangs sras 'byung gnas/ (107)gdan rabs bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa/ (108)gdan rabs bcu gsum pa dang bcu bzhi pa/ (109)gdan rabs bco lnga pa tshe dbang rdo rje/ (110)gdan rabs bcu drug pa rtogs ldan a bsod/ (113)gdan rabs bcu bdun pa mchog sprul 'jam dpal ye shes/(115)gdan rabs bco brgyad pa bsod nams bkra shis/ (125)gdan rabs bcu dgu pa mchog sprul smin grol rin po che/ (138)gdan rabs nyi shu pa mchog sprul pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ (143)gdan rabs nyer gcig pa mchog sprul 'gyur med rgyal mamyodron/ (145)mkhan rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar bsdus pa/ (151)mkhan sprul dngos grub rin po che/ (154)gser kha'i mkhan po ye shes/ (156)mo 3

༄shi+o/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa dbyings su bcom zhing g.yu ral dag pa'i mkha' la g.yo/ /sbyin sogs pha rol phyin pa drug ldan sder bzhi ma nyam phyogs kun bsgrad/ /rgol ngan wa skyes gshed du khros pas rten 'byung sgra yi spa bkong ba/ /'dren mchog mi yi seṅge bdag yid gangs ri'i spo la rtag tu rol/ /rgyal kun ye shes sku mchog mkhyen pa'i gter// gsung gi dbang phyug snying rje'i pad dkar 'chang //thugs kyi mdzod 'chang gsang bdag bdud dpung 'dul//rigs gsum sems dpa'i thugs rjes rtag skyongs shig/gdod nas dri bral chos sku'i gzhi dbyings ge sar bzhad pa'i lang tsho las/ /lhun grub ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo rje'i lus/ /'gro ba'i don du gzhon nu'i skur bzhengs rigs kun khyab 2

pa'i bdag po mchog /pad+ma 'byung gnas spyi bos mchod do 'di dang phyi ma'i phan bde stsol/ /kha ba'i mu khyud dkar po'i byang shar khyon//rlabs chen chos srid dbyar rnga 'bum sgrog pa'i//mi nyag lo paṇa mkhas grub ji snyed kyi//bka' drin dran bzhin snying nas thal mo sbyar//rlabs chen tshogs gnyis chu gter chen po thugs bskyed smon pa'i bde 'byung bas/ /yongs su bsrubs las mkhyen gter nyi zla'i mdzad dkar snang ba 'bum dang bcas/ /yangs pa'i khyon kun bde dgas skyong mdzad rma ston rin chen bzang po sogs/ /karma rka tshang brgyud par bcas la gus pas 'dud do shis pa stsol/ /lnga bdo'i mun pas gtses pa'i 'gro khams su//

yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor che//'khor lo gsum gyis gsal mdzad ra this ba'i//rig 'dzin mañju shrī sogs gtsug na rgyal//stong chen blo 'das gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings rtsal snang ma 'gag lhun gyis grub/khyab brdal ye shes sgyu ma'i rol ba gang 'dul phrin las gar bsgyur ba/ /mtshungs med 'dren pa 'khor lo'i mgon po chos rje pad+ma skal bzang sogs// grub dbang rdzogs chen yab sras brgyud pas tshe rabs phreng ba kun tu skyongs/ /mi dang mi min gzu bo'i spyan yangs pos//gsal la mi gsal lo rgyus snyogs ma'i chu//dag byed lung rigs gtsang ma'i ke ta ka /tshigs su sdeb par gnang ba'i skabs phyes shig/phyogs rdzogs grags pa'i mu khyud dkar po byung nas yal ba'i 4

gtam rgyud snyan/ /lo yi 'khor lo'i 'gros dang bsdebs nas 'byung bzhi'i klong du thim nye tshe/ /slar yang 'di zhes smra ba'i spobs pa lhag bsam bzang po'i nye rgyu las//ngo mtshar gtam gyi lha dar dkar pos mkhas rnams dgyes pa'i dga' ston bya/ /zhes yul dam pa rnams la mchod par brjod pa'i ngag gi ut+pal cir yang 'thor zhing dngos por nges par bstan pa'i tshig bcad nyung ngus gtam gyi lam yangs por phyes nas/ 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni bsil ldan gangs ri'i ljongs kyi shar phyogs mtho sgang du gnas 'cha' ba'i mi nyag dang ra this dgon gyi byung ba brjod pa chu dwangs nor bu'i phung po zhes bya ba yin la/ 'di la bod dang 'brel ba'i mi nyag gi chos srid dar tshul bshad pa dang / gang du chags pa'i gnas kyi che ba brjod pa/ gdan sa chen mor bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar tshul/ gdan rabs gser ri'i phreng ba'i 5

rnam par thar ba/ mkhan rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar bsdus pa/skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar zur du byung ba/ mjug sdud tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan pa ste rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i skabs bdun du phye ba'o/ /bod dang 'brel ba'i mi nyag gi chos srid dar tshul bshad pa dmag dpon rin po che lta bu'i skabs te dang po/dang po la spyir bod kyi snod bcud grub tshul/ bye brag mi nyag gi rigs rgyud dar rgyas byung tshul/ yul der chos srid khyad par ba dar tshul/ mi nyag sil ma'i skabs dang mjug sdud bcas sa bcad bzhi las/6

bod kyi snod bcud grub tshul/sangs rgyas gnyis pa dbyig gi gnyen po'i zhal nas/ las las 'jig rten sna tshogs skye/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi las gyi dbang gis/ ji skad du/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten/ /de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro 'di brten/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin mi mjed 'jig rten gyi zhing 'di ni dang po 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor sra mkhregs chen po che'i rdo rjes kyang gzhig mi nus par chags pa'i steng du chu dang gser gyi dkyil 'khor chags shing rde'i dbus su rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i ri rab lhun po mngon par mtho ba'i mthar gser ri rim pa bdun dang gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa chags pa'i lho phyogs mthing sngon baiḍūr zhun ma'i 'od kyis yongs su khyab cing 'dzam bu prik+ṣas nye bar mtshan pa'i gling chen po skal bzang sangs rgyas stong gis byin gyis brlabs shing zhabs kyis pad+mo rnam par bkod pa dang 7

'god par 'gyur ba'i gnas chen rgya gar rdo rje gdan zhes grags pa der/ rang cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos kyang sprul pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan cing / 'gro ba ma lus pa'i khams dang dbang po'i rim pa dang rjes su mthun par theg pa chen po dang chung ngu mtha' klas pa zhig drang don dang nges don gyi sgo nas/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi bde ba'i 'jug sgo grangs med pa de la de 'tshams su bstan pa ma zad/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdo dang / za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo dag las/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ /kha ba can gyi mtsho bri nas/ /sā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ ma 'ongs par 'di nas byang phyogs nor bu man shel gyi ra bas kun nas mdzes pa'i mu khyud zlum po ru 'khod pa'i/ dbang sngon baiḍūr zhun ma'i mdangs kyis 'khyud pa'i dwangs gsal yan lag brgyad pa'i chu gter dag bri nas rim gyis g.yu mdog ljon tshal sna tshogs mngon du rgyas shing lhan skyes dri bsung gis 'thul ba'i zhing khams rang byung du bzhad pa ni/ yang 'dren mchog shākya'i rgyal po 'od ma'i tshal du bzhugs 8

pa'i tshe zhal 'dzum pa mdzad cid 'od dkar po mu med pas byang phyogs kun tu khyab pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel gyis de'i rgyu mtshan dris par bka' bstsal ba/ mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams der dam pa chos kyi bstan pa nyi ma ltar shar bar 'gyur bas 'dzum par mdzad pa dang 'od kyis khyab pas yul de byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ bdag gis gang la gang 'dul thabs rgya mtshos/ /sems can de kun smin cing grol byas nas/ /mtha' 'khob de ni rin chen gling lta bur/ /dam pa'i chos kyis kun nas 'byor bar shog /la sogs pa'i smon lam mang du btab cing /yul de rgyal sras spyan ras gzigs gyi gdul zhing du mkhyen nas thugs ka nas 'od dkar po 'phros pa bde ba can du song ste 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim/ 'od zer tshur byung de bdud rtsi'i mtsho pad+ma can du zhugs/ de nas pad+ma'i tshal chen po de'i dbus su gzhan kun zil gyis gnon pa'i pad+ma chen po gzi brjid 'bum gyi mdangs dang ldan pa kun nas phye ba'i khongs nas mchog gi sprul ba'i sems dpa' chen po sku mtshan dpe blta bas chog mi shes pa 9

zhig 'khrungs pa na/ 'od dpag med kyis phyag g.yas pas dbur byug bzhin du bka' bstsal ba/ mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul khams der/ /yi dam lha yi skal ba khyod yin te/ /yi dam khyod la brten nas ma 'ong dus/ /yul der sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med 'byung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ /chos skal snying po yig drug 'di yin te/ /snying po 'di la brten nas ma 'ongs dus/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i gsung rab dam chos kun/ /yul der dar rgyas mi kun chos spyod 'gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes pa la sogs pa'i dbugs dbyung lung bstan mang po byas pa bzhin phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bsngags shing shes pa'i me tog rab tu 'thor bar byas pa na spyan ras gzigs kyis pus mo btsugs shing thal mo sbyar nas/ 'gro kun byang chub che la ma 'god bar/ /rang nyid zhi bde'i bsam pa skyes pa na/ /sangs rgyas ma lus bdag gis bslus pa'i phyir/ /mgo bo a rdza ka yi dog pa ltar/ /tshal ba bcur gas pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar/ /lus kyang rnam pa stong du phye bar gyur/ /la sogs pas snying stobs 10

chen po'i dam bca' bar mdzad nas gang la gang 'dul gyis ngan song gi sdug bsngal ma lus bsgral bar byas shing / khyad par mtha' 'khob bod khams 'dul ba'i khur chen bsnams nas gangs can chu bo'i gling du byon/ der gnas srog chags rnams kyis rang byas las kyi sdug bsngal ya nga ba myong bzhin par snying rje bzod blag med pa skyes shing spyan chab bdud rtsi'i thig pa gnyis byung ba jo mo khro gnyer can dang sgrol mar gyur nas grogs bya bar khas blangs/mtsho rnams med par gyur cing sems can rnams kyi lus ngan spangs nas ri dwags sogs su gyur pa la 'tshe med chos kyi sbyin pas 'tsho bar byas na'ang / las kyi dbang gis slar yang gnod sbyin nag pos dbang bsgyur ba'i bzang yul rgyan med sogs mi min lha 'dre'i rgyal rabs bcu tsam byung ba na lha mchog thugs rje chen pos mi min yi dwags kyi rigs gyur de dag las kyi 'phro rnams zad nas mtho ris mi'i lus rten du rung bar dgongs nas sprul ba'i spre'u zhig sgom du btang bar brag srin mo chags pas de'i gdung ba bskong bar 'phags pas gnang nas khyim thabs byas 11

pas rigs drug nas 'phos pa'i phrug gu mi 'dra ba drug byung ba gdong dbyibs dang mthun par ming se mu ldong stong dbra 'bru bcas ming drug btags pa rnams rim bzhin mi ru gyur ba'o/ /mi nyag gi mi rigs dar rgyas byung tshul/de yang mi'u gdung drug gi nang tshan ldong ni (rus mdzod du)yul mi nyag nas ldong rigs zhes dang gzhan du yang ldong ngam mi nyag zhes 'byung na/ dpa' bo ldong gi rigs rgyud rnams mdo dbus khams zhes grags pa'i bod kyi zhing khams chen por stod smad bar gyi cha gsum bgos pa'i smad mdo khams sgang drug gi nang tshan mi nyag ra ba sgang ste mdo stod nas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba zhig yin te/ 〈gser dgon sangs rgyatra/ bstan 'dzin gyis〉〉bod mi'u gdong drug gi ya gyal ldong gi rigs mched pa'i mes po sger rgyal dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa khams phyogs la phebs te/mdo khams sgang drug yod pa las/ zal mo sgang du gnas 12

bcas/ zal mo sgang gi phu ngos la mi gnyag ri mang zer/mda' ngos la tsha mo rong zer ba yin/ sger rgyal gyi bu rgyud mang che ba mi gnyag ri (ru)mang la chags pas de rnams la'ang mi gnyag pa zhes zer ba yin/ zhes dang 〈rgya bod yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed las〉dpa' bo mi nyag gi rgyal rabs ni sngon dang po gha thag la sogs mi nyag gi yul thams cad ces pa ltar da lta'i rab sgang 'di nas rim gyis dar khyab byung nas byang mtha'i bar khyab pas dpa' bo mi nyag gi rgyal khams zhes grags pa yin na'ang rigs rus dar tshul dang rgyal blon ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus kha gsal ma rnyed pas skabs shig bod kyi rgyal rabs dang 'brel nas cung tsam gleng na/bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po rgyal por bskos nas/ la dwags rgyal rabs las / ra sang dar ba dang / khyung po'i khod pa byas/ mi nyag gi bshes gnyen blon por bskos tshul tsam las khri rjes ma rnams dang sa yi legs drug sogs kyi lo rgyus rgyas par ma mthong bas mi nyag dang 'brel tshul bzhag la/ bod rgyal so gsum pa srong btsan sgam po'i dus su mi nyag gi rgyal khams zhes bod 13

las gzhan pa'i rgyal khab stobs 'byor can du gyur yod par nges te/ ka khol ma las/ bod kha ba can gyi byang na hor dang mi nyag gi rgyal khams zhes 'byung ba dang / mi nyag tsa mi rgyal po'i sras mo ru yong bza' srong btsan gyi btsun mor bsus pa'i rdzong 'debs su 'phrul rta nag po khrung gshog ces rta yi lus la mi yi sems dang ldan pa gyi ling rta yi rgyal po sogs rin po che'i 'bul nod rgya chen byas shing rgyal bo gnyis thun min chos kyi 'brel ba dam por gyur ba yin te/ blon bo mgar gyis/mi nyag tsa mi rgyal po yang / /khyed kyi mtshan thos brkyang phyag 'tshal/ /mtshan brjod mkhan de la bya dga' ster/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / ru yong bza' 'ang rnam dkar gyi bgyi bar rab tu dad pa zhig ste/ ka khol mar/lcags po ri la brag phug gi lha khang bzhengs snyam nas/ rdo bre re phod na tshwa bre re sbyin pas mgon po kun tu zhal gyi lha khang bzhengs pa ni jo bo shākya mu ne dang zhal mnyam pa'i byin nus gzi brjid dang ldan pa brag lha klu phug ces grags pa de dang / lo rgyus gzhan du mig mang tshal gyi lha khang bzhengs pa dang sras gong ru gung btsan gyi 14

bskyed yum yang yin par bshad cing / ra sa 'phrul snang sogs bzhengs skabs bzo bo'i lag rtsal dang 'byung rtsis kyi 'byung khungs mi nyag yin te/rgyal rabs gsal me sogs su/ shar rgya dang mi nyag nas bzo dang rtsis kyi dpe blangs zhes 'byung bas gang ltar mi nyag ces rgyal khams tha dad lta bur gyur yod na'ang bod kyi chos srid la sri zhu rlabs chen bsgrub pa sha stag ste gtso bo thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi blon po mgar dam pa yang mi nyag bzhag bra'i rtse mor steng 'od gsal gyi lha zhig dmu thag las babs pas mtshan mgar gnam tsha 'brug dang / de'i brgyud pa mgar bla mkhyen chen po de'i sras mgar stong mes khri chags de'i sras mgar stong btsan te gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i sprul ba'i blon po de nyid lags shing / de dag shar bzhag bra'i g.yas phyogs kyi lung pa nas gdung rgyud rim gyis dar bas mgar dar zhes 'khrungs yul dang g.yon phyogs su mgar gyi bla mtsho de la dmu 'od mtsho ste dmu thag las babs pa'i 'od gsal lha'i bla mtsho zhes pa'i bsdus ming yin par ngag rgyun du grags so/ /bod kyi lo rgyus slob gzhi las/ srong btsan 15

'das rjes tsha bo zhig khrir 'khod kyang de chung bas rgyal srid kyi bya ba rnams yun ring mgar gyis bskyang / mgar 'das rjes mgar gyi bu che ba nyid kyi go sar bskos te blon po gzhan gsum gyis kyang dmag dpon byas te sa mtshams bsrung / gru gu dang / rgya'i dmag dpon zho'i ren kos dang go tan phan sogs rgya'i yul tshan mang po pham par byas pas rgya'i lo rgyus su shin tu grags chen gyi mi sna zhig tu gyur ba sogs kyi lo rgyus dang / srong btsan chos rgyal yin pa dang mi nyag tsa mi rgyal po chos la dga' ba/ ru yongs bza' bod kyi btsun mor gyur ba mgar stong btsan yab sras bod la mkho nyag che ba sogs la bsam na/ 'di nas bod dang mi nyag gcig gyur lta bu'i dpung gdang bsgrel nas rgya bod kyi sa mtshams/ lan gru dang dbin khron phyogs su mkhar rdzong mang po mi nyag ldong gi las dmags la bzung du bcug pas/ da lta de phyogs na ldong gi rigs mang ba'ang 'di las byung zhing 'di skabs bye ma a drung las grub pa'i jo bo mthong grol lnga ldan nyid mgar stong btsan gyis lha sa nas gdan drangs te gter du sbas pa da lta'i khro skyabs thugs rje 16

chen po 'di yin pa dang mi nyag pa byang phyogs su dar khyab byung ba'i mgo /dus 'di nas tshugs par mngon no/ /bod rgyal so lnga pa 'dul srong mang po rje'i sku tshe'i smad tsam ste mgar gdung rabs lnga ba nas rang yul khams phyogs su phebs nas sde dge sa skyong gi rgyal rgyud mched cing rnam dkar dge ba'i sgo brgya kun nas yangs pa'i mdzad pa mtha' yas pa dag lo rgyus gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /yang bod rgyal rabs so brgyad pa khri srong lde'u btsan gyis za hor gyi mkhan po bho rnyi sa twa dang slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs bod du gdan 'dren zhus te 'phags yul gyi mdo rgyud ma lus pa bod du bsgyur cing mdo sngags chos kyi lte ba chos tshig gi yul dbus su gyur skabs mi nyag gi yul du bzo rtsal dang sman rtsis rab tu dar bas sman pa mkhas pa mi nyag rong rje sogs yod tshul bshad pa dang / slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' dag las mi nyag sog mo dang rtsa dur sogs mngon spyod kyi ngan sngags kyang mang po dar bar mngon/ skabs shig bod rgyal por bdud blon 'gas phra ma bcug ste lo chen be+e ro tsa na mi nyag gi bye brag rgyal mo rong du sgyugs pas 17

khong gis rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pas rgyal po mdo bzher sogs dad par gyar nas sri zhu phun sum tshogs pas bla mar bkur ba'o/ /sto chos srid khyad par ba dar tshul/de nas shar mi nyag gi rgyal khams kun tu che ba drug ldan snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa sems klong man ngag gi sde dang bcas dam pa chos kyi nyi gzhon gyi snang bas khyab pas rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po dang sras mo g.yu sgra dpal sgron gzhan yang / bai ro'i rnam thar pad+ma'i dga' tshal las/zla 'od bzang dang tshe dbang chos rgyal dngaḥ ma ṇi don yod su ṇa pha la bzhiḥ kun dga' dh+wa dza pra dzha badz+ra mingaḥ sur+ya maṅga blon po'i bu dang bdunaḥ ces sogs lo paṇa mang po byung zhing mdo sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur/ g.yu sgra snying pos gtsos rab byung 'dul ba'i sde dang / bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gtsos sngags pa'i sde ste dge 'dun pa'i sde btsugs/ pad+ma'i dga' tshal las/ khyad par gnas chen sum cu rtsa brgyad btsalaḥ gnas rnams byin dbab 18

sa gzhi byin gyis brlabasaḥ zhes pa ltar gnas rnams su sgrub pa mdzad cing byin gyis brlabs pa sogs sems can gyi don mtha' yas pa mdzad/ de nas bai ro tsa na dbus su phebs skabs rgyal rong dang rkang lam nyin gsum gyis chod pa'i rta'u spang nang du spang rgan mi pham mgon po la be+e ro tsa nas mgron po mkhar tshugs kyi gdams pa bstan te slob rgyud dang bcas pa 'ja' lus su dengs pa byung / spang rgan zhes pa spang nang gi rgan po zhes pa mtshan gyi dbur smras pa las sprang rgan zhes tshig ngan pa bla mar zhu ga la 'tshal te de ni nor ba'o/ /'di nas bzung mdo khams mi nyag gi zhing khams 'dir 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi dbang gis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ste 'bras bu'i bstan pa la longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dpal gyis 'tsho zhing kun tu gnas pa ste snga dar gyi tshul mdo tsam mo/ /yang bod rgyal zhe gnyis pa glang dar gyis dbus su bstan pa bsnubs skabs/ rma g.yo gtsang gsum mdo smad mi nyag gi yul du phebs nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal rab tu byung / de nas dbus gtsang gi mi bcu bla chen 19

gyis mkhan po mdzad nas rab tu byung bas bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu brnyes pa dang bla chen nyid kyis kyang mi nyag gha ru go rung seṅge grags kyi mdun nas 'dul ba gsan pas lung sde bzhi bstan bcos dang bcas pa'i glegs bam bla chen la gnang nas bstan pa gsal bar gyis shig ces gdam pas rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/ de nas khams lha rtse bhig tig tu kwa 'od mchog grags kyi mdun phar phyin dang mngon pa byang sa sogs chos mang po la sbyangs/g.yu sgra snying po las rdzogs chen skor gsan pa sogs mkhan chen bho rnyi sa twa dang lo chen bai ro sogs dang zhal mnyam pa'i skyes bu 'di nyid phyi dar bstan pa'i babs so nyag gcig tu gyur/ gzhan yang tsa mi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas grags dka' sdug gis lam phreng ring mor srog dang bsdos nas 'phags yul rdo rje gdan dang na len+d+ra ru mi lo nyi shu lhag la slob gnyer byas shing na len+d+ra'i mkhan po mdzad/lo tsa ba 'di nyid 'phags bod dang mi nyag la bka' drin 'gran zla dang bral ba bcas mdor na bstan pa rin po che dri ma med pa zhig smad nas rim par dbus su dar ba yin pas/ phyi dar mi nyag 20

gi yul gyi paṇa grub rnams ni rang cag chos ldan bod kyi mi rigs dag la gsob du med ba'i bka' drin dang brjed du med pa'i phyag rjes bzang pos mi rigs rang gi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa'i tshe srog gi khrag rgyun mthud pa dang / bde nas bde bar bsgrod pa'i lam bzang por ma rmongs par byed pa lags so/ /de yang mdo stod de rab sgang gi sa cha 'dir mi nyag tsa mi rgyal po dang / 'ge mtha' rgyal po/ se rgyal po/ tung ko'i rgyal po/ ta cin rgyal po sogs byung /zhing byang mtha'i bar rab byung gi mgo ma tshugs sngon du bskyangs/bod sil bu'i rjes su mi nyag gi rgyal khams rgya nag gis bzung ba 'dra ste/mkhas pa'i dga' ston tu/sngon mi nyag gi yul rnams rgya yi 'og tu yod cing phyis su su hu byung tshul dang / gzhan yang spyir rgya nag dang / hor mi nyag gsum yul tha dad yin yang rgyal bo res mos su byas pa zhig byung ba'i shākya'i rgyal po gzhu brtan dang dus mtshungs pa'i ce'u'i rgyal po byung ste/ ce'u'i rgyal po sum cu so drug sogs rus tshan mi 'dra ba bco lnga la rgyal po brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu tsam du rgya mi nyag hor gsum rgya nag gis bskyangs/ de nas mi 21

nyag gi rgyal po su hu byung nas rgyal rabs bdun nam bcu gnyis tsam du mi nyag gis gsum ga'i bdag po byas te bod yul gyi bstan pa la zhabs tog cher byas/ zhes sogs dang yang rgya'i rgyal po ci'u tha'i dzu spun gnyis kyi lo sum cur rgyal sa bzung ba'i rjes su su hu byung zhes pa sogs la bltas na gong gi rgya'i rgyal po brgya dang rtsa dgu zer ba nor 'dug snyam/ rab byung dang po'i sngon tsam du gha dang byang ngos kyi bar smon shri zhes pa'i ri la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag drag rtsal can su hu'am ga dzu zhes pa 'khor bcas rta ba dkar bo bdun du sprul nas byang ngos kyi mkhar nang du bsdad/gzhi bdag 'khor bcas yul de'i bud med dang 'grogs pas bu zhig byung ba na/ nam mkha' la sngar med kyi skar ma zhig byung / rtsis pa rnams kyis dpyad pas mkhar 'dir rgyal sa 'phrog pa'i bu zhig btsas 'dug ces gleng / rgyal pos de tshol cig ces bka' bab pa na mas bu de sa kong mo zhig tu sbas/ pang leb kyis kha bcad steng du chu phor gang bzhag pas rtsis pa rnams kyis mtsho chen po dang shing gi sa gzhi'i 'og na 'dug zer bas 'tshol ma thub pas rgyal 22

pos lo gnyis lon pa tshun gyi byis pa ma lus pa gsad dgos pa'i bka' bsgrag /rgan mo skrag nas bu chung chu dkyil gyi rtswa 'thug po'i nang du bskyur ba nyin bzhin bya rgod cig gi gshog pas mi 'khyag par sros/ ba mo zhig gis 'o ma bsnun pa rjes su kun gyis mthong zhing ya mtshan nas ming la rus pa du ma'i zhes bod skad du ba las 'o ma 'thung zhes btags/ de lta bu'i mi min gzhi bdag gi 'phrul bu de lo bdun lon pa nas gzhan rta pa drug po'i bu chung drug yod pa btsal nas gangs ri'i gseb tu bros nas ri der shing 'thu ba'i skyes pa rnams bzung nas dmag mi byas/ rgya'i rgyal por ngo log byas nas rang gi khyim rgyud mi nyag gi rgyal sa bzung 'dod pa na/mi nyag gi rgan mo mngon shes can gyis thabs bstan pa/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin khyod kyis dmag shog rta lcags rta sbangs mang po tshol la chur skur cig dang khyed la rgyal sa dbang ngo smras/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin rgan mo de rgyal po'i lcags ri'i steng du ngu zhing brang rdung gin phyin pa rgyal pos drir btang ba na/ rgan mos lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi lung gis mi nyag gi rgyal bo zhig gsos yod pas rang cag 23

rgya yi ming tsam yang mi lhag par bya nges te dmag bsam gyis mi khyab pa sang nyin chu bo brgyud nas 'ong bas ltos dang shes sogs smras nas rgyal bo'i bsam pa bsgyur/ phyi nyin bltas pas rta sbangs dang rta lcags kyis chu mdog 'gyur ba mthong nas rab tu skrag /rgan mo la thabs ci dga' dris pas dam kha khyer la bros shig zer/rgyal bo 'khor bcas lam du chas pa mi nyag gi dmag mang po dang 'phrad nas rgyal bo 'khor bcas bsad/ dam kha blang nas rim gyis blon po 'ga' bsad cing dbang du bsdus pas rgya yi yul kun tu/ rgan mo zhig gi kha yi nyes pa yis/ /zur gsum sgo drug yod pa'i rgya mkhar bshig /ces grags pa nas bzung mi nyag su hu rgyal po'am ga dzu rgyal po 'di mi nyag gi rgyal rabs khrod stobs 'byor mnga' thang shin tu che bar grags pa ste/ rab byung dang po'i chu sprel lor rgya'i yul phal cher dbang du bsgyur/ rgya'i rgyal po 'di ni rgya nag sung gi rgyal rabs bzhi ba yin par bshad/ mi nyag gi rgyal po 'dis mi nyag dang rgya sog po bcas gcig gyur gyi rgyal khabs yun du bskyangs te lo rgyus 'gar rgyal rabs bcu gnyis kyis mi lo nyis 24

brgya drug bcur srid bskyangs zhes pa dang 'ga' zhig tu rgyal rabs drug gis lo brgya dang go lnga'i bar srid bzung bar grags/rgyal rabs lnga ba la tha'i ha'i chos la rab tu dad pas chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa gdan 'dren du btang yang ma byon/ 'o na nyid dang mnyam pa'i rgyal tshab cig gtong bar zhu zhes pas sprul bas rjes su bzung ba'i grub chen gtsang bo pa phebs nas mi nyag gi rgyal khams thams cad chos la bkod pas phyis su mi nyag rgyal pos mtshur phu'i dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten gser dngul gyi na bza' dang bla bre sogs phul nas sri zhu chen po bgyis/ mi nyag gi yul 'dir sngar bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa dar khyab che ba bla ma 'di ba'i bka' drin gtso bo yin no/ /gzhan yang 'di'i sngon du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas parnyi ta chen po su ma ti kirti'am bal bo'i sen+ta pa sogs mi nyag gi yul du gdan drangs nas bka' brgyad phyag chen gyi bstan pa dar ba dang mi nyag ta cin rgyal bos kaḥdam pa bde gshegs bla mar bkur zhing gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar ba dang snga 'gyur gyi bka' babs 25

zur bo che'i slob ma'i gtso bo rtse mo bzhi'i nang tshan sgyu 'phrul bshad pa'i rtse mor gyur ba mi nyag khyung grags dang grub pa'i dbang po mi nyag gha ras a ro ye shes 'byung gnas bcas kyis gsang chen snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bstan pa rab tu dar bar byas pa'o/bstan srid sil ma'i skabs dang mjug sdud pa/skabs shig sog gis btsan rgol 'ga' byas kyang ma thub na'ang rgyal rabs lnga ba la tha'i hu'i sras te rgyal rabs drug pa rgyal rgod rdo rje dpal zhes pa sog skad du shri tur go thul ken han ka rgyal sar bzhugs skabs/ sog pog ta rgyal po ching sing gis btsan 'dzul byas par dpa' ngar gyis 'gog rgol yun ring byas na'ang srog gnyis me chur 'phrad pas 'thab pa don med du gyur nas rgyal po mtshon 'og tu 'das shor zhing / de'i btsun mo sog skad du gur pul cen swo bya ba ching seng gis btsan thabs kyis chung mar blangs/ btsun mos 'khon lan du dgra bo'i rlig 'bras 26

btsir nas lo der bsad kyang btsan 'dzul 'di'i 'og tu mi nyag byang phyogs la god chags shin tu chen po byung nas rgyal po'i dbon gyi gtsos 'bangs sde mang po dbus nas brgyud 'ga' zhig mi nyag lha btsan legs pa nas byang pa rgyal por gyur nas byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang sogs byung / shar ba'i chos 'byung las/ mi gnyag rigs las mched pa'i rus gzhan ni shar ba/ shis brag pa/mdo grub pa sogs yin/ khams mi nyag nas mi chen grags pa nye 'khor gang yod/ lcags mi nyag sogs kyi lo rgyus dang pho lha bshad pa'i yig dpe las/ khams lcags mo brag gi lung par bsam 'grub dar po la/ lcags mi nyag gdong kha ring mo 'khrungs/'di'i bu che ba dpal chen rdo rje dang / sangs rgyas dpal 'byor 'khrungs/ zhes dang 'ga' zhig 'brug yul dang 'bras ljongs sogs su gnas bcas par grags/ rgyal rgyud dngos mi nyag lho phyogs su 'phos nas yon rgyal rab skabs mi nyag rgyal bo la khrang ho zhi an h+pho hri zi zhes pa'i thabs thob ste rgyal mkhar mi nyag gi yen kon kri bya bar btsugs par bshad/ ming rgyal rabs skabs mi nyag rgyal po 27

ngag dbang bstan 'dzin bya bas ming gong mar rogs skyor gyis 'jang yul du hor dmags bcom zhing gong mar 'tshams zhus phebs pas ming gong mas khams shar mtha'i dmag srid zung gi dbang cha sprad cing de nas rgyal sa dar rtse mdo zhes pa/ slob dpon pad+mas/ 'dzam gling shar phyogs rgya bod gnyis kyi mtshamasoḥ rgya bod dar rtse mdo ru mkha' 'gro gnas: de la rtag tu mkha' 'gro tshogs rnams 'dus: zhes gsungs pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i gnas mchog sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog der rgyal srid bzung / ching rgyal rabs skabs mi nyag rgyal po bstan 'dzin grags pas rgyal sa bzung yang ring po ma lon par sku drongs pas de'i btsun mos rgyal sa bzung zhing chin rgyal rabs kyis rgyab rogs gnang bar brten mda' mdo dang brag steng khro skyabs sogs dpon phran lnga bcu lhag gi spyi dpon du gyur/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing sbrul spyi lo 1725la mi nyag rgyal bo sangs rgyas 'das shing bu che ba rgyal mtshan dar rgyas rgyal sar bskos de 28

la bu gnyis kyi che bas rus rgyal dang / chung bas rus lcags bzung ba/ bu chung bas rus lcags bzung zhes pa 'di bu chung bas rgyal bo mdo bzher nag po'i rgyal rgyud rgyal nag lcags mgon tshang gi khyim rgyud bzung nas pha'i rgyal sar mi nyag gi rgyal bo byas pa mi nyag lcags lha rgyal bo'am rgyal nag lcags la zhes grags snyam/ de nas bzung lcags la rgyal bo zhes mched par grags pa'i rgyal rgyud kyi zam ma chad par da lta'i lcags la rgyal mtshan gyi bar du 'phel 'grib kyi lo rgyus yun ring dang ldan pa'o/ /gzhan yang mi nyag gi yul 'dir lha sgrung dag gi khrod na mi nub rma bya rgyal po dang / mi nyag g.yu khri rgyal po/ mi nyag khri btsan rgyal bo sogs mi rje ge sar rgyal bos chos la bkod cing rdzong phab pa'i g.yul 'gyed mtshon gyi 'khor lo'i rang sgra snyan lhang lhang du skye bo kun gyi rna lam du 'jo ba khag gcig snang ba 'di dag kyang dpyad pa'i gnas so/ /spyir me nyag ni lo 'khor nyis stong lhag gi lo rgyus ldan tshul sogs yod par grags kyang / lo rgyus gsal bo ma mthong bas skabs shig dpyad gzhi tsam las 'bri ma spobs la gang ltar btsan po gnam 29

lcags kyi sta re lta bu/ skyen po nam mkha'i thog lta bu/ dpa' bo dug shing gi tsher ma lta bu'i rgyal rabs ring mo der thun mong ma yin pa'i skad dang yi ge'i srol rgyun dang rig gnas kyi thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa yod tshul phyis nas thon pa'i rdo ring dang yi ge sogs lo rgyus kyi dan rtags mang po gzi brjid kyi rin thang mngon par mtho ba dag gis rang re spun zla rnams par snyan grags kyi dbu rna dkar bo mtho bar byas pa dag gi shes la tshan rig pa dag gis rdo chas de dag mi lo khri phrag gi gong yin tshul bshad pa dang mi nyag 'ge mtha' rgyal bos 'phags nga/ gnas brtan bcu drug rgya nag nas spyan drangs shing yon bdag byas te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad pas ya thog gdod ma'i chos ldan gyi rgyal khams shig yin ces bshad chog par snang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i dga' ston du shar rgya nag dang /lho 'jang nub/bod byang hor gyis bcad pa'i dbus ni mi nyag gi rgyal khams te/ gha dang byang ngos rab stong tshar sgang bcas yin par gsungs so/ /mi nyag gha'am mi nyag lho ngos ni mdo stod khams kyi yul na yod pa'i mi nyag yul 30

rnams dngos gzhi dang / byang ngos ni mdo smad phyogs te phyis su dbang bsgyur ba'i mi nyag chen po zhes grags pa ni/deb dmar las/mong gol rgyal po'i lho nub er hun gtsang bo'i stod rgyud an har te lin dang rgyal sa pe cin bcas dang / rab stong tshar sgang ni si khron zhing chen gyi nub rgyud dang / yun nan mu li tshun chad gcig tu gyur ba'i rgyal khams chen po zhig yin/ phyis su mi nyag lho byang gnyis po rgyal khab tha dad pa dang 'di yin de min gyi lab nyob cung re mol ba ni zhib par ma brtags pa ste/ dang po mi nyag ces pa'i ming 'di ji ltar byung ba rus mdzod sogs las mi nyag nas ldong dang / sngon dang po 'ga' thag la sogs mi nyag yul nas dpa' bo ldong gi rigs dar bas sa ming mi la thogs pa ste sa de ni mi nyag rab sgang la ngos 'dzin dgos pa gzhir bzhag /mi nyag rab sgang ni/ gzhan du spo ba mi srid la sngon gyi yi ge rnying ba dang gter ma'i gnas bstod dang bsang yig dag las/ mi nyag bzhag brag dang / mi nyag gangs dkar/ mi nyag dar rtse mdo zhes 'byung ba kho nas kyang bden dpang mi thub bam/ ming de dag gis bsnyad 31

pa'i yul gzhan zhig gang du'ang mi 'dug pas/ yul 'di nas byung zhing yul 'di'i la rgya bzung mkhan nam 'di'i mnga' khongs su gtogs pa la mi nyag pa zer zhing 'di dag rim gyis dar khyab byung ba'i rgyal khams kyi 'phel 'grib la ltos pa las/ mi nyag bya ba'i mi khyad par ba sha mo lta bu zhig yul nges med du spang nas rdol ba ga la yin/ dper na da lta'i mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi khong gtogs sog po dang hor ba dag la mtsho sngon pa zhes khri shor rgyal mo'i ming gis 'bod gyi yod la phyis su bod ljongs lta bus dbang bsgyur na/ mtsho'i 'gram rgyud ma gtogs gzhan rnams la mtsho sngon gyi sgras mi bsnyad pa bzhin no/ /mi nyag lho byang zhes pa 'di yang mi nyag rang gi yul dbus la ltos nas btags so/ /rus ldong dang rigs mi nyag las mched pa goms gshis bod dang mthun pa'i rgyal khams shar mtha' rgya nag dang lho 'jang nub bod byang sog dang 'brel ba sogs lo rgyus rgyas pa yod par nges la/ 'on kyang bod kyi lo rgyus phal mo cher rgyas par mi snang ba ni phrag tog gdon gyis gzir nas phyag sor ma g.yo ba sha stag red ces smra mi spobs 32

kyang lo rgyus snga ma dag tu mi nyag mnga' thang che bas rgyal khams gzhan du brtsis nas bod dang 'brel tshul cung re ma gtogs ma bshad pa dang phyis su mi nyag sil bur 'thor nas bod las gzhan du ma dmigs pa'i rkyen du gyur ba e yin snyams pa bcas deng sang na mnyam gangs gzhon gyi khyu tshogs chen po shes rig gi kho lag rdzogs pa dag gi mkhyen spyan yangs por dpyad gzhi'i skul slong dang rang cag gi pha rus dkar po gang nas mched pa'i mes po dag gi rjes dran du bod dang 'brel ba'i mi nyag gi lo rgyus mdo tsam gleng ba'o/ /'jigs byed dus kyi mtshon cha dbal rno bas/ /yod tshad srog dang bral ba'i bam thang du/ /lo rgyus bang so mthon po'i ngo sprad cig /med na 'khyar ba'i gnag dang khyad par ci/ /gdung drug ldong gi rigs rgyud mi nyag pa/ /gangs can shar byang khyon du chos srid kyi/ /nyi zla'i gzi 'od rgya dang hor sogs la//33

'gyed pa'i dpa' bo ldong gi rdo ring bslangs/ /mes po'i mdzad dkar zla ba'i ma ma las/ /grags pa'i chu 'dzin mkha' mtha' kun mdzes pa'i//rjes su phyogs pa'i na mnyam spun zla'i khyu/ /mgo bo dgye tsam mi bgyid gang du 'phyan/ /grangs med bgrang bya chu 'dzin 'khrig pa'i klong / /tsa mi su hu la sogs sgra brgya bas/ /phyogs kyi thos 'dzin 'gang ba'i nga ro yis/ /rigs kyi ba dan srid na mtho la ltos/ /ngo chen rgyal pos btsan gyis ma bskul zhing / /g.yo can 'phyon ma'i zol gyis ma bslus kyang //dri med lhag bsam dag pas rang rigs la/ /'das dang da lta'i lo rgyus phyogs sdom byas/ /bdag ni skyes sbyang rigs pa'i 'dren byed zung / /34
rmongs pa'i rab rib nad kyis bslad pas na/ /'di yin 'di min kha tshon gcod pa yi/ /spobs pa bral zhing 'gal ba'ang srid pas bzod/ /35

gang du chags pa'i gnas kyi che ba brjod pa glang po rin chen lta bu'i skabs te gnyis pa/ spyir gnas kyi dbye ba sogs bshad pa/de yang spyir gnas zhes pa 'di don dam pa'i dbang du byas na/sa chu spyan dang ma ma ki zhes pa ltar zhing dang sku'i rol bas ma khyab pa med pas rnal 'byor ba rnams la snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba dang / gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa/ /de yi mdun na thub pa bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dag snang dang dad mos mchog tu ldan pa dag la snang grags thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi rol bar 'char bas/ don dam par gnas la 'di yin 'di min gyi dbye ba ma dmigs kyang / mdo rgyud dag gi dbang du byas na dbye ba mang po mchis te/ dbyings dag pa chos sku'i zhing /36

nang rang snang dag pa longs sku'i zhing / phyi yul snang dag pa sprul sku'i zhing zhes dag pa sku gsum gyi dbye ba yod pa las/ phyi yul sprul sku'i zhing de nyid dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ khrag 'thung he ru ka chen pos ru dra pho mo bsgral ba'i phung po khams sogs gsang sngags kyi gnas yul dur khrod du byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ 'jigs byed drag po dus mtshan dang bcas pa btul nas/ de dag gi bzung ba'i mkha' spyod dang sa spyod sa 'og spyod pa rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid du byin gyis brlabs pa 'di dag gdod nas mchog tu grub pa'i gnas zhes gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis brlabs nus pa dang / phyis su rnal 'byor grub thob kyi skyes bu dag gis byin gyis brlabs pas gang zag gis gnas byin gyis brlab par bshad do/ /de lta bu'i gnas la gtso phal lam dngos dang yan lag gi dbye ba'ang yod de/ sbyang gzhi de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin sbyang 'bras don dam snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gnas pa dag sbyang bya rdo rje'i lus dri bcas rtsa rlung thig le rten brten pa'i tshul du grub pa'i gdangs phyi 'jig rten gyi khams su gnas yul mkha' 37

'gro'i rnam par shar ba ste/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi rlung 'bab pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin rtsa'i sdong po brgyad sum nyer bzhi ro rkyang dbu ma'i rigs su gyes pa'i spyi bor mi phyed la sogs rtsa'i rtse mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ phyi rol du dzā lad+dha ra la sogs pa'i gnas chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ de la brten pa'i rab gtum ma sogs dpa' bo dpa' mo nyer bzhi/ de dag re re la thim pa dang longs spyod pa bdag po'i dbyibs te rtsa phran bdun cu rtsa gnyis la/ phyi rol du sbas pa'i tshul gyis yan lag gi gnas re re de nas rim bzhin yul sum cu so gnyis sogs mtha' yas par gyes pa bi ma las mdzad pa'i tsa ri'i lam yig las/ 'dzam bu gling na mkha' 'gro ma thams cad nges par 'du ba'i gnas dang / dur khrod chen po brgya dang bcu gsum bzhugs pa las/ rgya gar na sum cu so gnyis/ o rgyan na brgyad/ kha chen bcu/ li dang hor na lnga/ mi nyag dang za hor na bcu sogs mang por gsung pa dang / rad gling dang 'ja' tshon gter byon tshig mthun par/ bsam yas nas bzung ste bod yul ma lus par zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs/ gangs 38

dkar ti se man chad nas khams/ gtsang kha/ gan 'jang / mi nyagahor la sogs pa thams cad sgrub gnas su byin gyis brlabs shing 'gro ba rnams smin grol la bkod do zhes dang / 'dul ba lung las/dge slong dag byang phyogs gangs ri'i khrod na sa rdo bem pos kyang sems can gyi don byed pa yod do zhes sogs lung gis bsngags shing phyi nang gi dag pa sbyor ba'i rigs pas 'thad pa'ang grub pas kha ba'i ljongs kyi gnas phal cher gdod nas grub pa'o//gnas kyi chags yul bshad pa/de yang rang re ma dag skye bo'i mos ngor ston mtshan zla ba'i mdangs kyis mngon par mdzes pa'i lhun po tshar du dngar zhing /dwangs gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan gyi lha chab dal gyis bzhur ba/ma rmos rang byung gi ljon tshal me tog gis mdzes pa'i bsil ldan bod kyi zhing khams 'di la/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug yod pa'i tha ma'i nang tshan mi nyag ra ba sgang zhes ldong gi pha sa'i lho rgyud kyi dbus/39

slob dpon pad+mas/sngon tshe rgya gar rdo rje gdan nyid kyiḥ dus mnyam nyid du rgyal bas gzigs pa'i gnasaḥ zhes pa de ni spyan ras gzigs dang o rgyan pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i yul khyad par can yin te/ gu ru rin po ches/ de ltar lha mchog phyag na pad+mo dngaḥsgrol ma'i sprul ba a jo 'phags ma lhaḥ phyag na rdo rje dngos byon bod kyi blonaḥ srid na zla bral 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dngaḥ hūm̐ kar la sogs rgya gar grub thob brgyadaḥ pad+ma badz+ra bai ro tsa na dngaḥgayu sgra la sogs grub thob du ma yisaḥ zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnasaḥ zhes rigs gsum mgon po'i gnas mchog mi nyag lha dga' ring mo'i shar phyogs rta ba nyin lam gcig gis chod pa'i spu lung la gnyis bar zhes pa/ thub bstan mtsho skyes pad+mas/shar lho'i mtshams na gnags kyi spu lung zhesaḥ sa dpe bkra bzang lha klu'i 'dun sa bzhinaḥ phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor ldan pa'i yulaḥ mda' na yul ba'i 'bru rigs g.yang chags pa'iḥ a 'bras nas kyi phung po spungs pa bzhinaḥ ri rgyal blta na sdug pas sgo 'dan tshulaḥ de la lha bu dge bsnyen gzhon nu 40

bzhugasaḥ phu na 'brog pa'i nor phyugs g.yang chags ba'iḥ rkang 'gro gnags kyi spu grangs gcal bkram pa'iḥ 'bri rdzong nam mkha'i bla bre phub 'dra laḥ phyugs lha sman mo rdo rje rab brtan bzhugasaḥgadags ri rin chen sgrom bu 'grig 'dra laḥ 'bru nor longs spyod spel pa'i nor lha gnasaḥ de las rtsi shing chu rgyun 'bab pa laḥbaza' btung 'dod yon ster ba'i klu sman gnasaḥ srib ri go khrab mtshon gsum bshams 'dra laḥ dgra lha g.yul las rgyal ba'i dmags tshogs bzhugasaḥ de las rtsi shing chu rgyun 'bab pa laḥbase rag 'gong po 'dul ba'i g.yang lha bzhugasaḥ bar gyi chu lam thang gsum bkram pa niḥ rin chen gzhong pa 'dod dgus gtams pa 'draḥ de la lha klu'i 'dod yon lha mo gnasaḥ tshe g.yang bkra shis 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzadaḥ ces gsungs pa ltar/ phu na byin chags gangs kyi lhun po'i dbu 'phang mtho zhing bar na rngam brjid rdza ri smug po'i dbal so rno ba/ zhol na g.yu mdog rtsi shing sna tshogs ldems ldem du g.yo bas mgrin sngon mjug sgro zlum por skyeng ba ster ba'i mtshams kun tu khod snyoms g.yu yi stegs bu rnam par 41

brdal 'dra'i ne'u gseng yangs po ru bdag tu bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i srog chags sna tshogs rtsen pa dang / dwangs gtsang chab kyi rgyun bzang dga' 'khyil gyi ri mos lho nas byang du 'bab pa'i yul de na dge bcus rang rgyud dul zhing las dbang bsod nams dar ba'i skye bo dag 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i lung ba de'i byang shar dbang ldan gyi phyogs na sgrub pa'i gnas mchog chen po spyi shwa bkra shis dpal spung ngam ra this zhes grags pa'i gdan sa ste/ thog mar mtshan thog tshul ni/ ra this zhes pa mi nyag gi skad de ra ni brag la zer zhing this ni thel gyi don te ri ngos su rang byung brag gi thel brgyab pa lta bu'i dung g.yas 'khyil zhig dod yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas brag thel lam mi nyag skad du ra this zhes grags pa'i gnas de ni/ thub bstan mtsho skyes pad+mas/dbang phyogs sangs rgyas bstan pa'i g.yang chags pa'iḥ rwa tī sgrub rgyud bstan pa dar ba'i glingaḥ ri klung dge mtshan shes pa 'bum phrag giḥ rtse mo gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba dang ཿ gnas mchog spyi shwa bkra shis dpal spung giḥ nang dbyings gnas yul rnam dag bkod pa laḥ42

rgyal ba rigs lnga jo bo bcu gcig zhalaḥ bla ma bka' brgyad sgrol ma nyer gcig dang ཿ mkha' 'gro seng gdong rdo rje rnal 'byor maḥgrub pa'i rig 'dzin sngags kyi rnal 'byor baḥlha klu mi yi drang srong grub pa dang ཿ rgyal bstan dkyil 'khor mchod bstod mnyes byed maḥ 'byung ba'i dwangs ma bcud spel lha mo lngaḥ bstan ba bsrung zhing sgrub la 'go ba'i lhaḥ 'dod khams bdag mo rdo rje legs pa sogasaḥ legs smon stobs kyis 'gro la rjes chags pa'iḥ ye shes sprul ba'i lha tshogs bsam yas bzhugasaḥ zhes gsungs pa ltar ri klung gi dge mtshan dang bkra shis pa'i gnas gzhan 'bum phrag las khyad par du gyur ba dang bla mar gyur ba'am rtse mor gyur bas gnas kyi gtso bo 'bum rtse gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa 'di nyid/ thub bstan gzhan phan nyi mas/ gangs chen bzhi yi cig shos 'bos dkar phyogasaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas mchog byin gyis brlabasaḥ sku yi gnas ri bzhag brag lha ri rtseḥ gsung gi gnas ri rigs gsum nye sras brgyadaḥ thugs kyi gnas ri pho brang rtse 'khor lngaḥ yon tan phrin las la sogs gnas rnams laḥ o 43

rgyan chen po'i sprul ba 'khor bcas kyiḥ phyag gis me tog 'thor zhing zhabs kyis bcagasaḥ zhal nas bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa blangasaḥ thugs kyi dgongs pas byin rlabs rdzu 'phrul bstanaḥ sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal kunaḥ sku yig phyag mtshan bkra ba'i rten du bsgyuraḥ ces gsungs pa bzhin slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas rdzu 'phrul gyis sku ri'i tshad tsam thim zhing byin gyis brlabs pas ri de'i phyi dbyibs kyang gu ru snang srid zil gnon dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i tshul du grong nger 'gying yod la/ nang ltar lha btsan dge bsnyen rdo rje drag po rtsal/ btsan rgod jag pa me len dang / sgrol ging las byed li byin ha ra sogs nang 'khor gtogs pa'i gnas bdag srung ma 'khor dang bcas rnams dang / sgo 'dan lha'i bu dge bsnyen rdo rje chos skyong / 'bri rdzong phyugs lha sman mo rdo rje rab brtan/ g.yung drung dbang drag rtsal/ las mgon dgra lha sogs phyi 'khor gtogs ba'i 'khor tshogs rnams kyis rnam dkar dge ba'i bya bar rtag tu brtson pa/ gsang ba rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byams su klas pa dang / rgyal yum rje btsun ta re dang 44

gnyis su med pa ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrol ma'i g.yu mtsho'am spyi sho'i mtsho zhes ljang sngon in+t+ra nī la'i mdangs kyis 'khyud pa'i nang du kha tog sna tshogs pa'i mig mi 'dzum pas rtsed 'jo byed cing mtha' bskor du mthong ma myong ba'i 'dab chags dag gis skad snyan 'byin pa de nyid gus pas bskor zhing btung na phan yon che bar gsungs pa'i mtsho de'i g.yas su mtsho dkar po 'o ma'i mdog ltar dkar ba btung zhing bskor bas zhi ba'i las 'grub pa dang / rgyab phyogs su mtsho nag po 'jigs su rung ba sogs mtsho dang mtshe'u kha dog dang ro nus tha dad pa du mas bskor ba dang rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan ras gzigs sgrol ma nyer gcig seng gdong ma sogs kyi gnas ri rnams/ las dag pa rnams kyis lha de dag mngon sum du mjal zhing rang bzhin gyi skye bo rnams kyis mthun snang du rang byung sra mkhregs brag gi ri bo'i phyi dbyibs lha rang rang dang mthun par mjal thub pa'i gnas khyad par can gyis bskor ba dang / o rgyan chen pos gter du sbas pa'i ngo mtshar gsang ba'i sbas yul sna tshogs yod pa mngon sum skye 45

bo 'gas mjal pa dang / dus bzang rnams su 'ja' sprin lang long 'thib cing dri bzang bro ba/ rnga rol mo dung dang rgyag gling chos 'don pa sogs kyi sgra snyan sna tshogs grags pa dang / gnas bdag gter srung rnams kyis sprul ba'i gzugs brnyan sna tshogs ston zhing skabs skabs su gur dkar po 'ja' 'phur pa ta can phub pa dang /mi la gtam sna tshogs smra ba ma zad gnod pa'i bar chad byed pa dag la rdo sogs mtshon gyi char ba 'beb cing sgrub pa'i skyes bur bsam pa'i don bzhin grogs byed pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mtshan sna tshogs 'byams su klas pa/gnas de'i phyogs bzhi'i gnas chen sogs bshad pa/gnas chen de'i shar du gnas mchog lha mo rtse lnga zhes dkar gsal gangs kyi lhun po lha yi zhal zas mchod stegs su dngar 'dra'i nye zhol ljon tshal gyi bar mtshams su kha tog sna tshogs pa'i mtsho dang mtshe'us bskor ba/ sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma 46

'khor bcas rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs nas byin gyis brlabs shing rig 'dzin dpa' bo ḍāk+ki 'du ba'i gnas dge mtshan brjod kyis mi lang pa'o/ /lho ru 'bo gangs dkar zhes bod kyi gangs chen bzhi'i ya gyal/slob dbon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis yun ring du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas mchog rang byung shel gyi mchod rten lhun chags mdzes pa'i nyams brgya sngo bsang nams mkha'i dbyings su lhang nger mngon pa la rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i 'ja' sprin 'thib pa/ mgul bar dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rang byung 'od kyi dar bo che dang / rtsa bar bod kyi grub rig skyes bu rnams kyis rdzu 'phrul kyi bkod pa mtha' yas pa'o//nub tu phag gdong ri zhes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gnas mchog sra mkhregs brag gi ri bor rang byung phag zhal gyis mtshan pa/ mi nyag rab sgang gi grub thob chen po gnyis med zhig po rdo rje sogs sgrub pa'i skye bu mang pos rtse gcig ting 'dzin sgom pa'i dben gnas dam pa'o/ /byang du/ slob dpon pad+mas/ thugs kyi sku yi gnas mchog bstan pa ni:bod kyi mdo smad mi nyag ces bya ru:lha rtse zhes 47

bya dung seng gnam mchongs 'dra: shar lho shu yi lung pa'i sked pa ru: brag ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra ba ru: pad 'byung zla gsum sgrub pa'i phug pa ni+oḥ zlum 'khyil chos dung dkar po'i dbyibs can nang ཿོ a ti zhi khro'i lha tshogs sku yang gsal: g.yas kyi lung pa'i brag ri thams cad la: nye sras brgyad dang rta phag yab yum bzhugs: zhes sogs gsungs pa'i gnas mchog bzhag bra lha rtse brjid ldan gangs kyi ri bor gu ru o rgyan yab yum dang / bai ro tsa na/grub chen thang stong rgyal po/'bri gong chos grags/ khrag 'thung ye shes rdo rje sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog ya mtshan gyi bkod pa 'bum dang ldan pa'o/ /bar mtshams su gnas mchog bzhag ma zhes par/ stag tshang phug pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i brag skyib mang po dang / rdo yi ngos su rang byung du dod pa'i lha sku phyag mtshan yig 'bru sogs mngon sum du yod pa/ bya bral bsod nams bzang pos/bka' gdams ma ṇi rang byon dang / /skye med a yig rang byung 'di/ /phal gyi nor bu'i do zla min/ /'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du shar/ /zhes dang / bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /yi 48

dam thugs rje chen po dang / /mkha' 'gro seṅge gdong can sogs//rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /srung ma ma gza' dam gsum bcas/ /thams cad gnas 'dir byon nas ni/ /sogs rgyas par gsungs pa ltar dang / yang gnub chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gter gnas dang sgrub gnas zhes mngon par mtho ba'i rdza brag gi mgul bar rang byung rdo yi spyil bu dang mtsho dang mtshe'u rtsi shing sna tshogs sogs mdor na ngo mtshar gnas kyi bkod pa bsam las 'das pa'i nye zhol du/ 'brug mo'i thag nye bar zhes pa'i yid 'ong ne'u gseng gi sman ljongs na/ lo rgyus ldan pa'i gling rje seng chen rgyal po'i gzim sbra'i mtsher ma dang phyag mdas gtor ba'i mda' 'ben pha bong / seng lcam 'brug mos thag btags shul dang rdo yi ja gtun/ yab rje seng blon gyi gser sga gter du sbas pas ri dbyibs sga chas dang mtshungs pa'i ya mtshan can gyi gnas ri/ phu bo rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi sgrub gnas khyad 'phags/ khams kyi ma ṇi rdo 'bum chen mo sogs dang / gzhan yang ther zur du bī ro tsa nas gter nas bton pa'i tshwa chu byin can bkrus na nad brgya sel ba'i 49

nus pa dang ldan pa dang / blon chen mgar dam pa rgya nag nas bros te bod la phebs skabs zhabs kyis bcags shing spro gseng mdzad pas da ltar yang blon po'i khug ces 'bod pa dang gzhan yang skyes mchog 'jam grags kyi sgrub gnas chu med dben lung gnas bdag dang bcas pa/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi gnas mchog ra mkhar dang / a ra chos rje sogs kyi sgrub gnas mgon po'i bla ri/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi gnas lag mkha' spyod 'od gsal dga' ba'i tshal du byang chub chos sku'i mchod rten dang /sgrub gnas rdo'i spyil bu mang po/ grub chu ngo mtshar can sogs ngo mtshar ba'i sgrub gnas mtha' yas pa'o//skyes chen dam pa mang pos zhabs kyis bcags tshul/de ltar phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu gnas lag dang gnas phran gyis yongs su bskor ba'i spyi shwa bkra shis dpal spung ngam ra this lung zhes phyi nang gsang ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas 50

kun nas mdzes pa'i gnas mchog der thugs bskyed smon lam bzang po'i 'bras bu dus su smin pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba khams kyi mkhas dbang chen mo rma se ston pa rin chen bzang po nyid/gzhi bdag sogs kyis gdan zhus bzhin phebs pa na 'byung khams dwangs shing ting 'dzin gyi sgo brgya ngang gis phye ba'i gnas dga' ba dang ldan pas ra this zhes pa'i ming legs sbyar gyi skad du bsgyur nas rā tī ste dga' ba dang ldan pa'i don can tu byas pa'i dgon pa btab cing 'chad nyan spel/ phyis 'bo rtse'i zhol du sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ slob ma'i thu bo slob dpon ye shes rdo rje dang / 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ shes rab dpal/ shākya dpal/phyug mo ston pa sogs kyis sla nga phug dang / brag dmar tshe chu phug sogs nyin srib kun tu sgrub pa'i rdo spyil gyis gang ba dang / karma pa bzhi ba rol ba'i rdo rje phebs shing chos gsungs pa dang / karma pa rim drug pa dang bdun pa brgyad pa bcu pa bcas phebs shing chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs kyi lo rgyus dag 'og nas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar tshul las 'byung bas der rgyas par rtogs 51

shing / gzhan yang lo chen bai ro tsa na dang / lha lung dpal kyi rdo rje/mi rje seng chen rgyal po sogs sngon kyi skyes chen du mas kyang zhabs kyis bcags par grags pa dang / /phyis su bstan pa nyams gud kyi skabs su mi nyag mkhas dbang kun bsod dam thub bstan chos kyi grags pa gnas mjal du phebs nas yang dgon du chu gter blangs pa dang / dga' ldan gling du sngar gyi sgo them dang gter bum slogs nas kun la mjal du bcug rje nyid kyis kyang smon lam mang du btab/ dad ldan skye bo yongs la spyod 'jug dang 'pho khrid sogs chos sbyin rgya chen gnang ba dang / 'bo gangs dkar sprul sku bshad sgrub chos seng ge mchog gnas 'dir pheb nas 'du khang che chung dang mgon khang sogs khang rming rnams ngos bzung / gnas dang skyes bu rim byon gyi yon tan rgya chen brjod cing gnas gzigs mdzad/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs smon yang yang gtabs tshul sogs da lha'i bgres po mi nyung ba'i mngon sum gyi yul du gyur ba dang / rdzogs sprul drug pa 'jigs bral byang chub rdo rje dang yongs 'dzin mkhan mgon ris/ mkhan chen 'jigs med 52

phun tshogs 'byung gnas/ skyabs rje pad+ma skal bzang sogs skyes bu dam pa mang pos zhabs kyis bcags shing smin grol gdam pa mtha' yas pa bstsal ba bcas so/ /'di ltar o rgyan chen po sogs dngos su byon pa'i gnas rnams su zhag gcig sgrub pa ni gzhan du lo gcig sgrub pa las lhag ces gu ru'i lung bstan bka' rgya ma las gsungs pa ltar yon tan bsam kyis mi khyab pas/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs las 'das pa zhig gis byin gyis brlabs pa ni rang re chos lugs pa zhig gi ngos nas bshad na skye bos 'bad rtsol las bskrun pa'i rten gsum zhig las brgya 'gyur du 'phags pa rin thang bral ba'i 'chod sdong chen po zhig tu nges pas slar gso dang lo rgyus med na ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu'i dpe bzhin rgyu mtshan med pa'i ngam grogs cig tu 'gyur srid pas gnas 'dir chags pa'i khyim mtshes dag la bsnyel gso dang phyag mchod dad pa'i srol rgyun bzang po'i skul slong zhig gi dod por gang du chags pa'i gnas kyi lo rgyus bshad pa'o/ /phun tshogs gnas mchog pad+ma bzhad pa'i tshal/ /53

rtsa gsum lha srung bung ba'i tshogs bzhin 'du/ /legs tshogs dri bsung dngar mos phyogs kyi mthar//yongs su khyab pa'i sa spyod gnas 'di rmad/ /mkhas rlom rab btags rgyan gyis ma spros kyang / /ngo mtshar gnas mchog mjal ba'i mngon sum gyi//ya mtshan snang ba gsar ba'i gar mkhan mas//tshur mthong srid pa'i snang ba 'gag par bgyid/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin sgom pa'i drang srong rnams//dgyes bskyed rang byung brag gi spyil bu dang / /rtsa rlung gtum mo sbyong ba'i rdo gcal sogs//sus mthong nges 'byung dad pa'i lam du bskyon/ /ljon tshal g.yu lo bkra ba'i ri klung du/ /bag pheb rtsed 'jor rol ba'i srog ldan khyus//snyan pa'i 'gyur khug rol mo 'bum bsgrags pas//gang zhig dbang med bde ba'i spu long g.yo/ /54

lha dang bla mas bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don/ /byin gyis rlabs shing sprul ba'i bkod pa dag /ngam grogs khang ral phal ba'i gral lus na/ /rjes 'jug mgo regs skal ba chad min nam/ /des na rten 'byung dag pa'i 'char sgo las/ /rang byung ngo mtshar gnas kyi bkod pa dag /zol med drang po'i gtam gyis 'dir smros pa/ /skal mnyam gang dag dgyes pa'i rgyu ru smon/ /

gdan sa chen mor bshad sgrub las gsum gyi bstan pa dar tshul bshad pa 'khor lo rin chen lta bu'i skabs ste gsum pa/yul phun sum tshogs par rten dang brten pa'i gdan sa btab tshul/de yang sum rtsen lha yi zhing la co 'dri ba'i mi yul gyi zhing khams lta bur gyur pa sa yi dpyad bzang rgu 'dzoms pa ste/ nam mkha' zlum po 'khor lo'i dbyibs su chags shing / sa gzhi yangs pa pad+ma'i gdan lta bu'i shar na sa dmar dang lho na rdza sngon dang nub na brag dmar byang na rdza shur bcas rim par stag dang g.yu 'brug bya dmar rus sbal gyi rnam pas sgo bzhi bsrung ba/ mdun phyogs shar gyi khis chen rgya sgo phye 'drar yangs pas sa yi ka ba dang 56

mkhas grub 'byung ba'i sa/ lho ru brjid ldan ljon shing rgyas pa phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i 'byor ba 'bad med du rgyas pa'i sa/ nub ri zlum por bskor bas bla slob sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa'i sa/ byang phyogs skyon med yol ba brgyab 'dra dgra rkun gyi bar chad med pa'i sa ste ka bzhi tshang ba/ mdun ngos su g.yu 'brug sngon mo gyen du 'gro bas snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs su khyab pa'i sa/ g.yas g.yon dang mdun thang du chu chen dang chu phran 'bab pas dngos grub dang 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i sa sogs sa dpyad legs rgu ma tshang ba med pa der rab byung drug pa'i bgrang bya so brgyad pa (1364)shing 'brug lor chos sde chen po 'di nyid btab pas bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan sna tshogs byung zhing lha klu mi gsum gyis sdong grogs rgya chen bgyis pas phyi nang gsang gsum rten dang brten pa mi min lha yi rdzu 'phrul gyis grub pa lta bu'i dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin dang mi gnyis pa'i gharjo la 'dir mtshan don dang mthun par rā tī dga' ldan byams pa chos 'khor gling zhes gsol/ chos kyi dga' ston rgya chen bgyis pa dang mkhas pa mi lngas gtsos mkhas grub kyi 57

skyes bu mang pos smon lam dang shis brjod byas te/ rgyal ba bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa gzhir bzhengs su slong bar mdzad do/ /gnas 'dir rma se ston pa rin chen bzang bo dang / shākya dpal/slob dpon ye shes rdo rje/ mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs grags pa/karma rol pa'i rdo rje sogs sku phreng rnams kyis mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par 'chad nyan gyi legs mdzad yun ring du bskyangs pas 'dus pa'i zhal grangs 'bum du long ba sogs 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ de lta bu'i gdan sa der gna' bo'i dus su skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang brten gzhi gtsug lag khang sogs ji ltar dar tshul yang mdo tsam brjod na/ de yang chos sde chen po de'i dkyil dbus su thub bstan yongs 'dus kyi dga' tshal ngo mtshar sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang mdzes shing brjid pa thog rtsegs gsum can/ rgya khyon du ka ba brgya dang lnga bcu'i tshad la gtsang khang du sku rgyu rin po che las grub pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan thog brtsegs gsum can g.yas g.yon du gnas brtan bcu drug nye ba'i sras brgyad/ mar 58

mi dwags gsum kyis gtsos pa'i bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad kyi bla sku dag dang mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma su kha sid+dhi/ jo nang kun mkhyen sogs bla rgyud rnams kyi sku brnyan mi tshad tsam pa dag la lha mi'i mchod rdzas gya nom pas mchod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi mdun phyogs su rin chen sna lnga las byas pa'i khang bzang du ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po longs skur zhal bsgyur ba jo bo gsung 'byon ma/ g.yas su byams pa/ g.yon du 'jam dbyangs bcas dang / gtsang khang gi g.yas g.yon gyi sgor 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po brgyad sogs bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pas mdzes pa'o/ /logs bris su skyes rab dpag bsam 'khri shing /rgyas pa 'bum sogs sher phyin gyi gleng gzhi/ skal bzang sangs rgyas stong sogs gser bris su byas pa/ sgo khang du rgyal chen sde bzhi/'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa/ 'bum rtse gtsug tor rgyal ba/ 'bo gangs dkar bzhag bra lha rtse/ mi nyag g.yu ri rtse rgyal sogs mdzes rtsal khyad du 'phags pas logs ris su bris pa'o/ /thog khang gnyis pa'i lcog bzhir mgon khang ba'i/ ste mgon po ber nag/ lha 59

mo dmag zor rgyal mo/ chos skyong jag pa me len/ dam can mgar nag bcas kyi sku dang chos skyong srung ma gzhan gyi zhal 'bag dang /rten rdzas bskang rdzas sna tshogs pas brjid cing 'jigs su rung ba'o/ /mtshams kyi lha khang gsum las g.yas su dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha khang / g.yon du phag mo'i lha khang / mdun du spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa'i lha khang ste re re'ang lha mi'i mchod rdzas dag dang 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan gyis kun nas mdzes shing ngo mtshar lha yi dpal la 'gran pa lta bu'o/ /steng khang du chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen dang te lo ba nā ro sogs gyi sku brnyan sna tshogs pa dag bzhugs so/ /g.yon phyogs kyi pho brang du ka ba brgya'i gzhi khyon can/ thog rtsegs gsum pa steng khang du gser khang nyer lngas kun nas mdzes par bskor ba'i rten gyi gtso bo rtogs ldan tre bos gnang ba'i gser zangs las grub pa'i byams sku mthong grol ma/ rje sku phreng bzhi pa rol ba'i rdo rje la rgya nag gong mas phul ba'i ston pa'i zhal tshab jo bo 'dzam gling g.yas bzhagamar pa lo tsa'i thugs dam gyi rten grub chen te lo ba'i sku brnyan 60

sogs rin thang bral ba'i rten gsum byin can mang po bzhugs su gsol ba'o/ /bar khang du karma pa sku phrang rim byon gyi gzims shag dang ra this rang dgon gyi gdan rabs dang mkhan rabs rim pa'i bzhugs khang bcas dang / 'og khang du phyag mdzod khang /mchod chas bdag gnyer khang /mdzod khang chen mo drug bcas so/ /g.yas phyogs kyi mgon khang chen mo ka ba nyer lnga'i tshad/ chos skyong bsrung ma'i sku brnyan rten 'bag spyan gzigs bskang rdzas sna tshogs pas brjid pa'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi sa khad cung mtho bar o rgyan lha khang dang dpe mdzod khang sbrel mar bzhengs pa/ o rgyan lha khang du gser zangs las grub pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad/ rig 'dzin brgyad/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs pas bstabs pa'o/ /dpe mdzod khang du gser dngul gyis bris pa'i bka' bstan sogs pod chig stong lhag dang mtshal bris dang dpar ma sogs pod chig khri lhag yod par bshad pa'i dpe mdzod khang dang o rgyan lha khang gnyis ni slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes bzhengs pa yin no/ /gtsug lag khang gi mdun thang du 'dus pa 61

chig 'bum lhag shong ba'i kun dga' ra ba lcags ri ltar bskor ba brgyud nas rgyang grags kyi mtshams su karma sku 'phreng brgyad pa dang mkhas grub rin chen legs pa rnam gnyis kyis phyag btab pa'i bshad grwa'i gtsugs lag khang dang / khor yug tu bshad grwa ba'i bzhugs shag gis bskor bar phyogs dang gzhi nas phebs pa'i grwa btsun dag gis thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i rig gnas rgya mtshor 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba la zhugs pas der gnas srog chags grog sbur yan chad kyang 'khor ba mtha' can du gyur ba'i bag chags bzang bo rgyud la thebs par mdzad pa'i gling 'di'i gtsug lag khang gi tshad dang bshad grwa'i mtshan dngos dang 'dus (pa'i zhal grangs sogs ni gsal por ma mthong bas bzhag la/ de nas yang rgyang grags phyed gnyis su phyin pa'i ri rgyal 'bum rtse ste ri dbyibs gu ru snang srid zil gnon lta bu'i pang du ra thi yang dgon bsam gtan gling du sgrub grwa'i gtsug lag khang ka ba bcu gnyis kyi gzhi khyon can mtha' bskor du sgrub grwa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyi bzhugs shag mang po yod pa de dag las phal cher ni 62

bug sgo 'dag zhal byas pa'o/ /g.yas phyogs su rma se ston pa rin po che'i bzhugs gnas kyang yod la rnam thar du yang dgon du bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te mthar sku gshegs par bstan pa'ang ra this yang dgon bsam gtan gling 'di yin no/ /yang dgon zhes pa khams gsum grags dgon du bshad pa ni nor ba ste gsar du spar bskrun mdzad pa'i 'jam grags rang rnam las gsal bo rtogs thub/ chos sde 'di las mched pa'i bu dgon yang bcu phrag lhag mchis pa de dag kyang bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar ba sha stag byung ba dang / gnas 'di'i nyin ngos phyogs su pha rgyud bskyed pa thabs kyi nyams len gtso bor byed pa mang po sgo 'dag zhal gyis lo mang po bzhugs pa dang / bskyed rdzogs gnyis su med pa nā ro chos drug dang mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi man ngag gi gsang ba zab mo'i sgrub pa la brtson pa rnams kha cig ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob cing grub rtags sna tshogs thon/kha cig ni bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs pa bcas mang po bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin srib ngos kyi 63

rdza ri thur du brnyil zhing gyen du ldog pa sogs chag chags nyil nyil du btang ba shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dben gnas rnams su rlung sbyor gyi man ngag rnams dang bde mchog snyan brgyud gtum mo'i skor dang thabs lam rtsa rlung gi 'phrul 'khor rnams bskor bas/la la nam mkhar bya ltar lding ba'i rtsa rlung la dbang ba/ la la dgun gsum kha ba'i khrod na ras rlon 'khyags rom chags pa mnab pa tsam gyis rlangs pa thu le bde drod 'bar ba la las rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes 'jog pa/ la las chos skyong bran du 'du ba sogs grub pa'i skyes bu mang po bzhugs pa bcas nyin srib gnyis su grub chen brgyad cu tsam yod par grags la 'di rnams kyis khams zas rags pa mi gsol zhing me tog dang cong zhi'i bcud len gyis 'tsho zhing brag skyib tu bzhugs pa'i sgrub gnas da lta dngos su kun gyi mthun snang du mjal bzhin pa de'o/ /64

sog gi ngan g.yo'i 'og thabs jus bzang po bgyis pa/stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i dge bsnyen tshangs sras 'byung gnas bya ba skabs shig ra thi dgon yul gnyis kyi bdag por gyur/ chos zab tsa na nag po'i bdud kyang zab ces gsungs pa ltar/ shin cang du yod pa'i o rod tsho bzhi'i ya gyal hu shog thu tsho ba'i mgo dpon gu shri han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis dpung btegs te/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo1640lor mi nyag du bskyod nas khams be ri rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rtsa med btang / mi nyag la bka' brgyud pa ches dar ba'i sgang yin pas thad kar rgol ma thub cing bsam sbyor ngan pa'i g.yo thabs kyis chos srid kyi bdag po bla ma tshangs sras 'byung gnas kho'i bu tshab byas/ bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa la dad pa'i zol gyis sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i chu 'go ra this dgon chen rgya bskyed dang khyed kyi rgyal sa byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ de nas gu shri 'jang nas 65

brgyud dbus gtsang du bskyod nas gtsang ba sde srid kyi pho brang gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse bcom/ bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa spel mi chog pa'i khrims bcas/ rje bcu ba chos dbyings rdo rje khams su bros bshol du phebs pa 'jang nas ra this dga' ldan gling du phebs nas yun ring bzhugs/ slar dbus su byon dgos byung / de nas gu shri han gyi bka' bzhin dgon pa rgya bskyed byas rjes rgyal po'i sdod gnas su bsgyur/ rim bzhin dga' ldan pho brang gis dbang bsgyur nas rgyal ba bka' brgyud pa'i bstan par 'gog rgoX dang ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa spel dgos tshul bka' bsgrags/ dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis mkhyen nas ma 'ongs bstan pa yang dar gyi rten skal du ra thi dga' ldan gling gi sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba rnams tshan pa gsum du bgos nas/ tshan pa gcig g.yas phyogs kyi thang du sbas nas steng du rdo dkar lug tsam gyis mtshan ma byas te gter gyi gnyer kha btsan rgod jag pa me len la gtad/tshan pa gcig dgon gyi mdun thang du sbas shing steng du mi 'gyur 66

rdo rje rjes dran gyi mtshan mar rdo ring ma ṇi rang byon du gsal ba zhig bzhag te gnas yul zhing skyong gi gtso bo lha btsun dge bsnyen rdo rje drag po rtsal la gnyer du gtad/ tshan pa gcig g.yon thang du sbas shing steng du rdo gtor ma'i dbyibs kyis mtshan pa dang srung ba'i bdag po shan pa li byin ha ra bskos/ ma 'ongs par bka' brgyud bstan pa dri ma med pa slar ma dar gyi bar du yul gyi rten dang skye 'gro'i phywa g.yang 'khor ba'i chos nor gyi gter dang 'gro ba kun la dge legs yid bzhin du 'jo ba'i mchod sdong chen po zhig tu byin gyis brlabs nas da lta'ang skye bo kun gyis gtsug gis mchod bzhin pa'o//bstan srid la nyam nyes yun du byung ba sogs kyi skabs/de nas dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i stod kyi cha la dmag 'khrug byung skabs dmag rnams rgyal mkhar ram dgon pa bcom du 'ong pa na grub pa'i skyes chen rtsa rlung la rang dbang thob pa rnams nam 67

mkhar 'phur nas rgyab ri'i rtser babs pas/ dmag rnams rab tu skrag nas dgon sde dngos kyi steng du 'gro ma spobs par srib ngos su song nas me skyogs kyis bsregs/ phyis rgya'i yig tshang sogs su mi nyag rgyal po'i mkhar shul tu grags/ grwa shag rnams bcom/dngos rdzas yod tshad khyer / bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa spel mi chog pa'i khrims bcas pas/ rim gyis bla ma dam chos rab brtan gyis dpal 'dzin rong du bkra shis 'byung gi dgon pa btab/ bla ma blo bzang dpal ldan gyis skyid legs dgon btab pa sogs/ skye bo grags pa'i rjes su 'brang ba lha sde phal mo che zhig grub mtha' gzhan du bsgyur to/ /rang rang gi chos dang bla mar phyir mi ldog pa'i dad dam 'gyur ba med pa dag dang mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes bu rnams ni/ 'bo gangs dkar sogs bka' brgyud kyi sgrub sde gzhan dang nyin srib kyi dben gnas mkha' spyod dga' tshal dang rab mkhar dang mchod rten dben lung / ra this gong ma dang bar ma la sogs su sgrub pa kho na la brtson nas sku tshe mtha' ru phyin pa sha stag byung / phyis su sbra gur la brten nas dbyar gnas dang phag 68

mo'i sgrub mchod 'tshogs nas yun ring por gnas pas da lta'ang ra this dbyar gnas thang dang ljongs rgyu khug sogs sa ming du spyod bzhin pa lags so/ /yin na'ang chos 'chad pa'i bla ma dang khrims 'cha' ba'i rgyal po med stabs sog po dang shel phreng sogs kyi jag rkun mang po stobs su bsdo bas dgon gnas slar gso'i skal ba yun ring du ma byung ba ma zad lha 'bangs phal cher phyogs phyogs su 'thor bas sngar gyi mkhas grub rnams kyi bka' 'bum dang / de 'chad spel sogs rig gnas sbyong ba'i go skabs ma byung ba'i god chag chen pos mun pa'i ru grong du gyur pas dbyar gyi dus mchod tsam las srol rgyun rig gnas dag med par gyur ba ha cang phangs ba'i gnas su gyur/ de nas dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i mgor seng seng karma dkon mchog la bu ma byung bas nyin zhig mchod sbyin rgya chen bgyis shing yul lha mchod du phyin pa na lab rtse'i rtsar bu chung gcer bu gzugs byad bzang ba zhig 'dug pa lhas gnang ba'i bu skal du shes te khyim du khyer nas bskyed bsrings/ ming la smon lam stobs chen zhes btags pa lus bong che zhing stobs rtsal 69

ldan pa mi phal pa las gzi brjid che ba lugs gnyis kyi bya bar mkhyen rab phul du byung ba zhig tu gyur bas skye bo kun gyis mngon par bstod cing yul gyi rgyal por brkos/ nyag rked mgon po rnam rgyal kyis 'di ba'i grags pa thos nas phrag dog gi dug zhags ring mos drung du bkug gshed ma gnyis la lcags sgrog gis chings la nyag chur skyur cig smras/ gshed ma gnyis kyis de bzhin byas pas chu khar sleb pa na kho'i stobs rtsal gyis gshed ma gnyis lnga lam du btang zhing lcags sgrog gtor nas phyir slebs pas nyag sked a mgon pas dpa' bo zhes mngon par bstod cing blon chen du bskos pa gang des ra this dgon gyi bla grwa rnams mchod gnas su bkur/ dbyar gnas dang sgrub mchod bcas kyi yon bdag mdzad zhar la kho bor lo rim mgon po khri tshar dang zhi khro'i stong mchod sogs lo bzhin 'tshogs pa'i srol rgyun bzang po btsugs pa da lta'ang ma nub par tshogs bzhin pa 'di ka lags so//70

phyis su snga 'gyur grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i bstan pa ltar yang dgon du spel tshul/sngar rma se ston pa o rgyan du gshegs shing gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i thugs smon gyi skal bzang dus su smin nas/ rig 'dzin nyi ma grags pa slar mi rdzur byon pa rig 'dzin 'jam dpal ye shes 'khrungs/ grub dbang rdzogs chen sku phreng lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje rigs kyi bdag por bkur bas chos tshul rgya mtshor gsan sbyang byas/ rdzogs sprul rin po ches rig 'dzin nyi ma grags pa'i sprul skur ngos bzung zhing grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i bstan pa la bya ba byed dgos pa'i lung bstan gnang / dbyar gnas dang sirnyi'i sgrub mchod sogs mthong brgyud phyag len dag la byang chub par mdzad/ phyis su grub mtha' bka' rnying 'dres mar gyur zhing / dbyar gnas kyi phyag bzhes rdzogs chen ltar byas/ nyid kyi chos mched rgyal 'phags mchog sprul dngos grub mkhan rabs dang po'i chos khrir mnga' gsol mdzad pa dang rim 71

bzhin gser kha ye shes/ gnubs zur shing thar/ che ring bla ma dbang ldan sogs mkhan khrir bskos pa'i rnam thar 'og tu gsal bas der gzigs par zhu/ nyid kyi nu bo rig chos sogs grwa sar btang nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la gsan bsam mdzad pa'i zhor du mthong brgyud kyi phyag bzhes rnams sbyongs shig ces gsungs pa bzhin byang chub par sbyang nas phyir 'byor ba na rdzogs chen ji bzhin sirnyi'i bum sgrub chen mo sogs btsugs nas grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i dgon lag dngos su bsgyur/ dgon pa slar gso gnang 'char gyi nyer bsdogs su rdzogs sprul lnga par bka' 'drir rdzogs chen du phebs pa ni rdzogs chen theng gsum pheb pa'i rjes ma yin la/ theng 'dir nyid kyi rgyal tshab du mchog sprul smin grol ngos bzung zhing dgon pa bzhengs dgos pa'i zhal chems dang bcas rdzogs chen du sku gshegs pa sogs rnam thar rgyas pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas sku tsha mthu stobs rdo rje dang seng seng stobs ldan sogs 'gan bzhes rnam pas rin po che'i yang srid de ma thag pa pad+ma bstan 'dzin khrir bkod/ mchog sprul 72

rin po che dgung grangs drug bzhes pa rab byung bcu pa sa pho stag gi lo ste spyi lo1938par gnubs zur mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis dang / seng seng shes rab stobs ldan/btsun pa dpal chen/sku tsha mthu stobs rdo rje sogs kyis mchog sprul rin po ches zhal gsung dang rdzogs sprul lnga ba'i lung bstan sogs gang ltar 'gro don dus su bab par dgongs nas ra this rma se ston pa'i sgrub grwa yang dben bsam gtan gling ngam yang dgon gyi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bskyar gso legs par bgyis/ mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis kyis bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad te tshogs pa yun du bskyangs/ de nas stong dpon sprul sku smin grol gyis gdan sa'i khur bzhes te rdzogs sprul sku rabs drug pa 'jigs bral byang chub rdo rje dang yongs 'dzin mkhan chen yon tan mgon po gdan 'dren zhus pas smin grol zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang du gnang zhing ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi gsung 'phros du ma bstsal/ nga dgu'i dus 'gyur chen mo'i zing 'khrug gi skabs rten brten pa dang bcas pa rming med du bshigs/ bla sprul yongs la 'o brgyal chen po 73

bzos nas bgrang bya du mar chos kyi sgra tsam mi grags pa'i mun gling du gyur/ slar yang dar bstan pa'i nyi gzhon gsar du bzhad pa'i skya rengs dang 'grogs nas rgyal 'phags sprul sku a dpal gyi thugs bskyed rmad du byung bas mkhan chen skal bzang rnam 'phel dang bla ma nam mkha' chos dbyings gnyis la gtso 'gan bkal nas ra this dga' ldan gling du ma ṇi dung 'khor gsar bzhengs mdzad/ sbra gur du sid+dhi'i bum sgrub chen mo dbu tshugs pa sogs phan dang bde ba'i 'jug sgo gsar ba'i dpal gyis 'tsho bar byas/slar yang mchog sprul a dpal rin po ches lung bstan dang thugs smon rnam par dag pas mkhan po skal bzang rnam 'phel dang bla ma nam mkha' chos dbyings gnyis la dgon pa 'debs dgos tshul gyis bskul ba bzhin khong rnam gnyis kyis gtsos dgon yul ser skya yongs kyis rin po che'i sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med rgyal mtshan khrir bkod/ lhag bsam dang las smon gcig tu bsdo ba'i stobs kyis bod rab byung bcu drug pa shing mo glang gi lo ste 1984par sngar gyi ra this dga' ldan gling gi o rgyan lha khang bzhengs 74

shing rten gyi gtso bo gu ru snang srid zil gnon thog brtsegs nyis tshad can dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku rten rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan 'gyur sogs gsung skor po ti grangs med pa/ thugs rten mchod rten cha brgyad bcas phyi nang gsang ba'i bkod pa rten dang brten pa legs par bzhengs/ bla ma bsod nams bzang po sogs skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis rab gnas dang shis brjod phun sum tshogs pa'i mdzad sgo spel/ dbyar gnas dang sirji'i bum sgrub chen mo/mgon po'i stong bzlog /seng gdong ma'i sgrub mchod sogs grwa sa gong ma'i phyag bzhes ji bzhin dus ltar rang dgon gyi bca' yig dang mi 'gal bar 'tshogs/ de nas chos rje 'jigs med phun tshogs rin po che gdan 'dren zhus shing chos bka' mang zhig gsungs nas 'dul 'dzin rab byung gi sde je mang du bsgyur/rdzogs chen mchog sprul pad+ma skal bzang rin po ches zhi khro 'phrad tshad rang grol dang dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi smin dbang sogs bstsal zhing / gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi dag snang tshes bcu'i gar 'cham chen mo rdzogs chen ji bzhin gsar 'dzugs dgos pa'i 75

bka' slob dang bcas ra this dgon par theg mchog bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling zhes pa'i mtshan thob gnang / bla ma nam mkha' chos dbyings rin po che'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas gdan sa'i khur mi lo bcu gsum gyi ring bzhes so/ /de nas mchog sprul tshe dbang rnam grol mchog gis gdan sa'i bdag po mdzad de tshes bcu'i gar 'cham chen mo'i 'cham gos yongs rdzogs dang /lha khang sdeb ris/ rīgayang ṭi las grub pa'i thub dbang mi tshad ma/ longs sku'i cha byad can te rin chen sna lnga'i dbu rgyan mgul rgyan sogs rin thang gzhal mi shes pa'i rgyan cha mchod rdzas kyisatsho brgyan pa jo bo mthong grol ma bzhengs/ gzhan yang rin chen sna lnga'i maṇ+ḍal/dngul kong chen mo sogs mchod cha ma tshang ba med par bgyis te/dgon gyi phyi nang gsang ba'i bca' khrims phun sum tshogs par mdzad pa bcas mi lo bdun du bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad/mthar gdan sa'i khur sprul thub bstan bzang por phog thub bstan bzang po mchog gis byams pa lha khang gsar bzhengs mdzad cing byams sku thog rtsegs gnyis can gser zangs las grub pa 'khor 76

du gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gu ru mtshan brgyad sogs dang /'dzam gling seng chen rgyal po'i zlos gar sogs gsar 'dzugs mdzad de lo bdun gyi ring thugs stobs zla dang bral bas bka' drin gnang ba'o/ /de lta bu lo grangs drug brgya lhag gi ring skye rgu bde ba'i 'jug ngogs rgyal bstan rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba'i rim par 'phel 'grib byung tshul rags tsam brjod pa 'di la/'das pa'i bgrang bya mang drags pa dang dpyad gzhi'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar nyung ba'i rkyen dbang gis 'gal 'khrugs mang zhig mchis srid pas gzur gnas blo ldan dag gis thugs dpyad legs bcos mdzad par mkhyen zhes pa bcas gdan sa 'dzin skyong spel ba rim byung gi lo rgyus bshad pa'o// //pad dkar 'chang dngos rat+na'i thugs bskyed kyis/ /bshad sgrub nyi zla zung gi gzi byin 'bum/ /'gro khams bde ba'i dpal du nyer drangs pa'i//rā tī dga' ldan gling 'di mngon par rmad/ /yang dag thugs bskyed kha ba'i 'dab ma 'bum/ /77

gcig tu spung ba'i rten gsum lhun po che/ /gzi byin na bun rgyan gyis rab klub cing / /mdo khams shar ri'i spo na yun du mtho/ /las smon bsod nams dpyid kyi sgegs mo mas/ /'bum phrag dmar ser 'dus pa pad+ma'i tshal/ /kun nas bzhad pa'i grags dkar phyi ma'i mthar/ /skyes kun rna ba'i dpyid du lhang lhang sgrogs/ /gzung 'dzin srid pa'i sgong rgya las grol zhing / /phyag rdzogs lta ba gshog pa'i rtsal shugs kyis/ /chos sku'i mkha' dbyings brtol ba'i grub rig khyus//zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /sngar zhig karma rka tshang na rim dang / /deng 'dir rdzogs chen yab sras brgyud pa'i srol/ /ma nyams 'khor lo gsum gyi legs mdzad de/ /78

'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i gtsug gi rgyan//gdul 'gro'i las dbang bsod nams dang 'grogs nas//bstan pa'i dar rgud gom stabs 'khyol bo bshul//lo zla'i rdul gyis rim gyi 'tshob nye tshe//lo rgyus sa bkra gsar ba'i ltad mo lhos//79

gdan rabs gser ri'i phreng ba'i rnam par thar pa blon po rin chen lta bu'i skabs te bzhi ba/gdan rabs dang po rma ston rin chen bzang po/snyigs du—sa kyi 'gro la thugs brtses 'jug pa rjes su chags pa 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don du dri bral pad+ma dkar po'i mtshan dpe gsar du bzhad pa rma se ston pa rin chen bzang po ni/ rab byung lnga pa spyi lo 1317me mo sbrul gyi lor dge ba'i mtshan ma 'bum dang bcas te zhabs kyi pad+mo shar mi nyag ring mo'i sa yi char rma se yul du thog mar bkod cing /yang dag pa'i bag chags stobs su bsdos nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs la mkhyen spyan rab tu yangs/ rim bzhin bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs kyi mdun nas dam pa chos kyi sgo 'phar gsar bar zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs kyi goms kha mdun du spos 80
