shing bla ma snying po rgyal mtshan gyis 'khrul ba med pa'i rdo rje'i lung gis 'byung 'gyur mdun lam gsar pa'i phyogs ston gnang ba bzhin dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing sar chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur/gsang phug tu phebs nas bla ma bu ru pa byang chub skyabs kyi drung du 'dul ba so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi sgo them dang po dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos shing mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtshor ngoms med du rol/ phyir khams su phebs pa'i lam bar du bla ma rgya rin po che dang mjal zhing dam chos kyi bgo skal mi dman pa thob/de nas sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i sgron me rje rang byung rdo rje dang mjal zhing zol med dad pa'i shugs kyis zhabs phyir 'brang bas bla ma rab tu mnyes nas chos dang nor gyi gnang ba mang rdu bstsal/mkhan po seṅge rgyal mtshan gyi mdun nas gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs kyi dge tshul gyi dngos por bsgyur/ don zhags pa chen po sangs rin gyi mdun nas bya rgyud bcu gcig zhal gyi bsnyung bar gnas pa'i dka' ba yun ring du spyad cing bsnyen pa grangs thebs par mdzad pas bsnyung gnas pa'am don zhags pa zhes 81

mtshan du chags/ bla ma des btsun pa mgo thon gcig pu zhes bsngags pa bzhin skye bo thams cad kyis gus shing bkur ba'i gnas su gyur/ bla ma lo tsā ba chen po dang bde bar gshegs pa sogs brtan mkhas gyi yon tan rab dang ldan pa'i las gral bzang po'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs te ston pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs dbang bar byas/ mkhan po seng ge bzang po dang slob dpon grags pa bzang po/ btsan dgon pa gzhon nu bsam gtan bcas kyi drung du mdo sngags chos tshul rgya mtshor shes brtson gshog rtsal gyis mtha' bcad cing slob tshogs gzhan kun gyi bla ru 'phags pas kun gyi grwa thog der chos skad bzang ba gcig pu zhes snyan pa rgyas/ yang dag lung dang rig pa'i kho lag nang nas rdzogs shing brgal brtags thal 'gyur gyi gad rgyang snyan mos dbus dang gtsang gnas rnying bcas la grwa skor mdzad/ zhwa lur grwa skor phebs pa na bu ston rin chen grub pa dang mjal zhing khong gis phar phyin dang tshad ma'i mtshan mtshon mi 'dra ba sogs thal 'gyur mang du 'phang bar bu ston rin po ches lan 'deb rgyu ma byung yang thugs 82

rab tu mnyes nas nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstan pa'i byung tshul sogs gsung / snar thang du mkhan chen blo bzang grags pa dang bo dong er bla ma don yod sku mched mkhan po gnas drug pa sogs las chos 'brel dang grwa skor 'dod pa bzhin byung / jo nang du kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan mchog gis gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi chos zhib par gsungs shing lo tsā ba blo gros dpal la slob ma'i mchog 'di chos dang zang zing gis legs par bskyong dgos tshul gyi bka' bstsal/ lo tsā bas kyang mnyes pas chos tshul mang po zhib par gsungs/ khro phu thar pa gling / 'dul chung sogs su grwa skor byas/ sa bzang blo gros rgyal mtshan dang bla ma brag kha ba chen po'i mdun du rgyags kyi mthil cung zhi la byas nas smin grol gyi gdams pa mang po zhus pas ting 'dzin la brtan pa thob/ ra pa shes rab seng ge'i drung du dus kyi 'khor lo lan bcu gnyis dang sbyor drug zhus te lo bcu gnyis bar 'dag zhal byas nas dus 'khor gyi rtsa sngags bsnyen tshad gnang bas grangs thebs pa bod na khong las med par grags pa dang / jo nang pa la bu chen nam mkha'i skar 83

tshogs ltar mang po yod pa'i nang nas bu chen bzhi'i ya gyal gcig rje 'di pa nyid lags so/ /'jag pa rgyal mtshan 'bum pa'i mdun nas bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang dang / mkha' 'gro ne gu ma'i zhal gyi drod rlangs ma yal ba'i gdam pa zab mo chig brgyud du bstsal ba sogs man ngag gi zab khrid shin tu mang po gnang bas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos mthong gi dad pa ldog med du skye zhing sgyu ma 'od gsal dang 'dres pa'i nyams bzang po skyes/ dpang lo tsā ba chen po dang na thang pa chen po bkra shis seng ge/ bla ma dpal ri ba blo gros grags pa/ 'bri gung bla ma rdo rgyal/ 'brug bla ma/ bla ma 'bri phyug pa/ bla ma brag lcog pa sogs kyi mdun nas chos tshul mang por slar yang gsan bsam rgya chen mdzad/ rtogs ldan dre bo'i mdun du phyin nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor rnams zhus pas bla ma'i thugs la rab tu btags nas smin byed dbang dang rjes gnang yongs rdzogs gnang zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bka' bab pa'i bu chen du gyur/ khyed byams chos par 'dug gsungs nas zangs dmar las bzhengs pa'i byams pa'i sku zhig gnang nas 84

byams chos kyis gzhan la phan rgya cher thogs pa'i rten 'brel yod gsungs pas gzhan phan rten 'byung gsar ba'i sgo 'phar thog mar phye nas phyir rab sgang du zhabs kyi kha lo bsgyur zhing phyag phebs/bsam 'grub rin chen gling du bzhugs pa'i dus/ karma sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje der phebs shing chos 'khor bskor ba na mkhan pos lo tsā ba mdzad/ mkhan po nyid kyis rang don du thos bsam sgom pa'i mtha' rgya chod par byas nas gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs mdzad dkar po phye ba'i thog mar/ byams gsar ba'i rnam thar las/chos grogs rma se ston pa rje/ /stong mgor bzhugs pa mjal bar phebs/ /khong gnyis sdeb nas ka bzhi ru/ /thal skad thog mar sgrog par mdzad/ /ces pa ltar stong mgo dang /ri ral ba can/ ni mgo sogs dgon sde mi sde kun la gang 'tshams chos kyi char pa bar med du 'jo bas gdul bya'i skye bo kun la blang dor mig gi pad+mo rab tu phye bar gyur/ spyir bla ma nyid dgon pa 'debs pa dang 'khor tshogs skyong 'dod med rung rten cing 'brel ba'i 'jug sgo bzang po 'ga' zhig dus su smin par ma zad/85

ra this lung pa 'di bde zer ba yang yang snyan du byung / gnas bdag 'bo rtses rta dkar la chibs/ dar mdung bzang po bzung nas nged ra this nas 'ong bla ma gdan 'dren zer nas yang yang phebs pas bla mas zhal gyis bzhes nas mi dang mi ma yin mang pos bsu ma dang bcas ra this lung par phyags phebs shing dgon pa btab pas lha klu mi gsum gyis ldong grogs dang bcas mthar chags su grub pa dang rma se ba nyid kyis ra this dgon du 'dus pa yongs la dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo mi lo dgu'i ring bskor bas slob tshogs shin tu mang ba'i khrod nas mkhas grub ye shes rdo rje/phyug mo ston pa gzhon nu dpal/ mkhan po shākya dpal/ skye mchog 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ bla ma shes rab dpal/ tshul khrims bzang po sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu grangs las 'das pa bskyed bsrings nas thugs sras mkhan chen shākya dpal la gdan sa'i khur spos/ skabs der rje gsum pa'i sprul sku rin po che rol pa'i rdo rje der phebs shing mkhan sprul gnyis kyis rab sgang gi yul gru kun 86

tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas 'khrugs pa bsdum zhing rnam dkar gyi bgyi bas yul kun khyab par byas/ slar ra this dgon du yar phebs/ nā ro chos drug sogs mdo dang sngags kyi chos skor mang po dang rdzas sngags bsrung bzlog dang bcas zla ba gcig gi ring gsungs shing 'byon khar thugs dam gyi rten rnams dgon par gnang nas yar phebs/ de nas mkhan chen gyis spyir bstan pa'i gzhi ma de 'chad nyan 'di khor nar nges kyang da ni khyed rnams kyis rang rkya pher bas ban rgan sgrub pa la 'bad na dga' zhes pa la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang po gsung nas ra this lung pa'i phu gnas ri gu ru'i gzugs sku brjid pa'i pang steng du sgrub grwa btsugs shing yang dbe+en bsam gtan gling btags pa bsdus ming du yang dgon zhes grags pa der sgo 'dag zhal mdzad/ nyid kyi zhal nas nga ni phyag rgya chen po de'i dkyil na langs yod pa yin gsung / dkyil na langs pa'i don ci lta bu lags zhus pas/ 'o 'di yin mod phyag rgya chen po phar bzhag don med/ tshur bzhag don med/ gang du bltas gang du phyin/ ji ltar byas kyang phyag rgya 87

chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos pa de lags gsungs nas tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po bshams/ rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa byon pa kun gyis mngon sum du mjal zhing bla ma 'di nged rnams kyis o rgyan du gdan 'dren gsung gin yod pa thos/ bla mas phyi nang gsang ba'i chos kyi gnad mang po gsung pa dang / nga la gsol ba 'debs na dang po rdo rje 'chang / de nas mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma/ de nas nga la gsol ba btab kyang brgyud pa mi 'chug ces thugs zin gyi skyes bu dag la gsung pa dang / zhing khams gzhan du phebs pa'i dgongs 'char gnang ba na 'di nas zhing khams gang du byon zhes zhus pas/ spyir mtshan nyid pa'i dus na dga' ldan du smon lam cher btab pa yin te rje dam pas bstan pa'i yang snying nye lam o+o ḍi ba de gsang sngags rdo rje theg par 'dug rang gzhan gang gis don sgrub kyang myur lam de 'dra zhig phebs su che bar gda'/sngags kyi kun spyod rnams ma cig o rgyan na yod par gda' bas nged kyi yi dam de yang o rgyan na bzhugs pas skor gcig gi smon lam de phyogs su bsgyur yod/ smon pa'i don de yang 'grub yod pa 88

'dra smon lam de tsam zhig 'grub kyang dgos pa yin gsung nas thugs kyi smon pa'i me tog o rgyan gyi zhing du phog cing 'byung char lhag pa'i lha mchog o rgyan gyi bstan pas rang gzhan gyi don rlabs chen bgyi ba'i lung bstan dang chos sde 'di'i grub mtha' rnying mar 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin no/ /de nas skabs shig 'gro ba'i don rdzogs pa dang gdul bya rtag 'dzin can dge la bskul ba sogs dgos dbang 'ga' zhig gis phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len dang mi 'bral bar rab byung drug pa'i chu phag lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu'i tho rengs la mkha' 'gro ma mang po'i bsu ma dang bcas te gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pas nam mkha' yongs su dag pa dang / res 'ga' 'od chen po 'khyil ba dang sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas chen po du ma byung / gdung de yang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsrung ba dang /spur bzhu ba'i tshe mkha' 'gro mas nam mkha' gang ba dang bla ma yang zhal 'dzum ba mdzad nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul du ma slob ma mos gus can rnams kyis dngos su 89

mthong ba dang gdung rus rnams rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang ring bsrel dang thugs sogs kyang byon pa yin no//gang de'i thugs bskyed zla ba dkar po'i gzi//srid 'dir grags dkar mdzes pa'i mtshan ma 'bum/ /thub bstan ku mud bkra ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /cha tsam mthong bas dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ /ces kyang smras so//gdan rabs gnyis pa slob dpon shākya dpal ni ra this dgon gyi nye 'dabs su sku 'khrungs shing na phra ba'i dus su srog gcod pa sogs mi dge ba'i las la skyi g.ya' ba/ dge ba'i las la rtse gcig tu 'dun pa gang nyid/ rim gyis chos sgor zhugs shing mkhan chen rin chen bzang po dang karma pa rol ba'i rdo rje/ byams gsar pa/ bka' bzhi pa rig pa'i seṅge sogs dang dbus phyogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i mdun nas/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtshor gsan bsam byang chub par mdzad/ phyis rang yul du phebs nas mkhan chen rin 90

chen bzang po'i mdun nas nā ro chos drug sogs zab khrid man ngag gi skor zhus te bzhugs pa'i skabs shig 'dren mchog bla ma rin po che'i bka' lung ldog tu med pas bla ma nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ mi lo bcu lhag gi ring bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyis ra this dga' ldan gling de nyid bde blag tu bskyangs/ sku na bgres pas gdan sa'i khur mkhas grub ye shes rdo rje la phul nas gdan sa'i nye 'dabs su sgrub pa kho na la gzhol te lo 'gar bzhugs mthar zhi bar gshegs so// //gdan rab gsum pa slob dpon ye shes rdo rje dpal bzang po /de yang thog ma'i dus su chos rje sangs rgyas pa bya ba la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma du mas lung bstan nas khyod la slob bu grub pa thob pa brgya rtsa brgyad 'byung zhing 'gro don dpag du med pa rgyas zhes pa ji bzhin 'byung ba'i slob ma de dag gi thu bo/grub thob seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis khong gi gdan sa 'dir 'jam dpal 91

dbyangs kyi sprul ba zhig 'byon gsungs zhes pa dang slob bu snying po rgyal mtshan gyis rab tu byung bar yang yang zhus kyang sdom pa len par ma gnang / de nas snying po rgyal mtshan mchog gis yum bsod nams rgyan bya ba khab tu bzhes nas bod rab byung drug pa'i chu lug lo ste spyi lo 1343lor 'bu nang du dge ba'i mtshan ma 'bum dang bcas de ye shes rdo rje dpal bzang po sku bltams/ khong ni la las grub thob seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi sprul ba yin par gsungs/ la las na ro pa'i slob ma zhig yin gsungs/ la las chos rje 'bri gong pa'i sku skye yin par bzhed cing mdor na chung ngus dus nas mgon po sogs chos skyong rnams kyis rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad cing snying rje dang dad pa rab tu che ba sogs rtsol med rgyal sras kyis spyod pa lhan skyes su mnga' bas sdig pa'i las phra mo tsam yang ye nas byas ma myong bar grags so/ dgong lo dgu bar stong 'gor phebs nas mkhan chen ma se ston pa dang mkhan po shakyā dpal mjal zhing rab tu byung / mkhan po shākya dpal las 'bri klog sogs rig gnas che phra mang po sbyang bas shes rab che ba'i tshad du grags/ bla ma seng 92

bzang pos sna tshogs dpe bum zhes mtshan gsol/ bla ma brag nag pa'i mdun nas dbang rdo rje phreng ba zhus pas bla ma rab tu dgyes nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba ye shes rdo rje dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gsol/ dgung lo bcu bdun par chos rje karma pa rol ba'i rdo rje mjal zhing zab chos mang po thob pa dang mkhan chen rma se ston pa las smin grol gyi zab khrid mang po thob pas khong gnyis thun min rigs kyi bdag por bsnyen cing brnyes pa gsum gyis gtsug tu bkur/ mkhan chen pa la bcos min dad pa bla lhag tu yod pas dbus lha ldan du skor zhig 'gro dgos yod kyang mkhan chen dang 'bral ma phod pa yin la mkhan chen pos mgo thur du ston nas song gsung yang thub pa yin gsungs/ mkhan chen pos kyang nga'i ye shes sdug pa kho na las mtshan gzhan mi gsol zhing shin tu thugs brtse chen pos mi lo sum bcu lhag tu bskyangs/gzhan yang skad gnyis smra ba byams pa kha che/ mkhan chen ka bzhi ba/mkhan po grags rgyal/ mkhan po dkon rgyal/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/bla ma dbu chen/sgom chen grags pa bzang po/ slob dpon 93

bsam gtan seng ge/ slob dpon shes rab rin chen/ slob dpon mkhyen dbon/ bla ma rdo rje shes rab/ slob dpon rad na se bo/ slob dpon nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ dbu se bla ma mgon po dpal/ slob dpon dbang phyug slob dpon rin chen dpal/ bshes gnyen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bshes gnyen rdo rje bzang po/ rnam rgyal dpal/seng ge dpal sogs ris med dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi mdun du mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par thos bsam gyi mtha' rgya chod par byas nas mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur/de nas gzhan don du rdza bra rin chen sgang dang ra this dga' ldan gling sogs su chos kyi 'khor lo yun ring bskor/ dbus mtha'i 'grel ba lung gi mdzod dang / rgyud bla'i 'grel ba nges don nor bu'i mdzod/ chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi 'grel ba/ phar phyin gyi don 'grel yum don gsal ba'i me long / dam pa'i ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul ston pa bshad pa gsal ba'i me long / shan 'byed chos kyi me long / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don gsal ba yang snying gsal ba'i me long / don smra'i rtsod pa spong ba rig pa'i go cha/ sangs rgyas dang 94

byang chub sems dpa' 'phags bod kyi lo paṇa rnams la gsol 'debs sogs ljags rtsom rab tu mang po gnang ngo / rdza bra rin chen sgang dang mkhan po shākya dpal gyis bka' bstsal ba bzhin/ra this dga' ldan gling gi bstan pa'i bdag po yin ring mdzad cing karma na rim lnga ba de bzhin gshegs pa mi nyag tu phebs pa ra this dgon du gdan 'dren zhus pa sogs 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dang mngon shes sgrib med du mnga' zhing byin rlabs gyi tshan kha shin tu che bas thugs gtad pa tsam gyis nad gdon bar chad mi 'dod pa thams cad zhi ba yin no/ rjes su ra this ba'i bstan pa sgrub brtson shes rab dpal la gtad nas rtag tu dben khrod rnams su sgrub pa kho na la gzhol ba lags shing skabs shig 'bo rtse rdza dkyil na bzhugs dus lo lnga'i rjes su zhing khams gzhan du gdan 'dren par lung bstan/ slar yang ra this dga' ldan gling du shan 'byed chos kyis me long dang phar phyin tshar gcig bcas zhib khrid dang zhal ta mang po gnang nas spyi lo 1403ste chu pho rta yi lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bcu drug gi nam lang la dkyil krung 95

dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bcas nas zhing khams gzhan du dgongs pa gtad/ zhag gsum gyi ring nam mkha' dwangs shing me tog gi char babs ring bsrel mang po byung zhing zhag du mar nub phyogs nas 'ja' tshon mang po ra this la zug pa dang gnas gzhi'i steng dang rdza bra la 'ja' gur phub/ mkhan chen rma se ston pa mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas bskor nas gang nyid o rgyan gyi zhing du gdan drangs bar skyes bu mang po'i nyams snang du gzigs pa'o/khong gi rnam thar rgyas par shes 'dod na mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs grags pas brtsams pa'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus sogs gzhan dag las mkhyen par mdzod cig//gdan rabs bzhi pa shes rab dpal/rigs kyi bdag po mkhan chen rat+na bha dra dang 'khrungs yul gcig par sku 'khrungs/ sku nar son skabs bka' bzhi pa byang chub dpal dang rma se ston pa/ ye shes rdo rje sogs mkhas grub mang po mnyes pa gsum gyis ring du bsten zhing bcu phrag rig pa'i 96

gzhung la blo gros kyi rtsal rdzogs/ mkhan chen rin chen bzang po thun min gyi bla mar bkur te smin grol gyi gdams pa zab mo yongs rdzogs zhus shing sgrub pa la brtson/ skabs shig mkhas grub ye shes rdo rje'i bka' lung ldog tu med pa dang / grwa btsun rnams kyis re bskul ltar bstan pa'i khur bzhes dgos byung / khong gis nus shugs yod rgus bstan pa la sri zhu rlabs chen bsgrubs pa dang /mkhas grub kyi skyes bu chen po 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba 'jam dbyangs grags pa gdan sa'i bdag por mnga' gsol/de nas yang dben bsam gtan gling sogs su sgo 'dag zhal gyi bsgrub pa la brtson/ phyag rgya chen po bcos ma ma yin ba'i gnas lugs la nges shes brtan po 'khrungs pa bcas zhi ba'i dbyings su gzims so/ /gdan rabs lnga ba skyes mchog 'jam dbyangs grags pa/skyes bu chen po 'di nyid ni rgya gar grub thob bram ze mgon 97

po'i rnam sprul yin par grags pa dang gzhan yang pu to pa dang chos rje karma pa'i rnam rol du skyes bu mang pos yang yang gsungs/khong ni rab byung drug pa'i smad du las smon dang bsod nams stobs su bsdos nas rab sgang gi sa'i char myi stod lcags mo tshang du (blug pa ru 'khrungs zer ba'ang snang )nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin gyis gur phub pa sogs ngo mtshar dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te sku bltams/ byis pa gzhon nu'i dus nas kyang skyes bo su zhig gis mjal kyang dang ba 'dren pa/ srog chags kun la rab tu byams pa'i snying rjes thugs brlan pa sogs byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa rnams rang chas su mnga'/ yab las yi ge 'bri klog bslab pas tshegs med du byang chub par gyur/ de nas ra this dga' ldan gling du pheb nas chos sde chen po mjal bas lus ba spu g.yo ba'i dad pa skye/ thog mar kun mkhyen ye shes rdo rje dpal bzang po'i zhabs la gtug nas lhag pa'i lha mchog rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dbang zhus shing yi dam du bsgrub pas lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs gyis zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing 98

phyag g.yas pa'i ral gri 'od dang bcas pa khong la thim pa sogs byung / de ltar mkhan chen rat+na bha dra dang kun mkhyen shrī dz+nyā na badz+ra pha la gtsug tu bkur nas mi lo bcu'i ring ra this dga' ldan gling du rang don du thos bsam sgom pa dang gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom pa mdzad pas slob ma'i 'du tshogs dang ljags rtsom po ti mang po byung bas mkhas pa'i grags pa sa chen po'i khyon kun tu (zur bkod dkar chag las gsal)khyab par gyur/ karma de bzhin gshegs pa dang mjal nas chos mang po zhus thun min gyi bla mar gyur/ de nas phag mo'i gnas ri dang karma lha steng 'jang yul sogs nas brgyud dbus lha ldan gyi gnas rnams bskor zhing phyag mchod dang chos sbyin rgya chen bgyis nas sog tsan+dan dgon dang 'dan yul tre shod brgyud de gzhan phan gyi bya ba kho na spel gyin phyir rab sgang du phebs nas yun ring bzhugs/ slar dbus phyogs su pheb pa/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ skabs shig mdo khams kyi mi sde lha sde kun gyis karma de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ma 'drongs par/rje karma pa nyid kyi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i thu bo mi nyag rab 99

sgang gi rma se'i 'dren pa mkhas pa mi lngar grags pa'i dge bshes khri phrag brgyad dgu'i dbus na 'gran zla dang bral ba/ mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan gzhal bar mi nus pa rab sgang nyid kyi mkhas pa mi nyag 'jam dbyangs grags pa zhes/ nyi zla ltar grags pa khyed byon dang cis kyang spyan 'drongs zhes zhus pas/ chos rje rin po che spyan e 'drong mi shes/ 'on kyang khyed tshos bskul ba ltar 'gro gsungs nas byon/ rje rin po che dang mjal bas/ rje yi zhal nas lan gcig mjal ba dga' zhes shin tu thugs dgyes par mdzad/khong gis dbus gtsang 'dir sgra mi snyan na bstan pa med zer ba sogs la bstan pa yod par dam bca' ba sogs gtan tshigs kyi shog dril mang po rdo ring dang / khyams khra'i sgo la sbyar ba dang grwa sa so sor springs pa na sus kyang lan ma theb pas/ rab dge gcig gis dbus dge de tsam zil gyis mnan/ zhes grags/ karma si tu drung rin po che sogs slob tshogs mang por smin grol gyi gdams pa rgya cher gsung / ngoms su chos mang po zhus pa sogs rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen bsgrub/ phyir rab sgang du pheb nas lha mo rtse dang ra 100

this dga' ldan gling phag mo gnas ri sogs dang gzhan yang rgya dang 'jang la phrin las rgya chen spel/ de nas ra this dga' ldan byams pa gling gi bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis kyi bdag por gyur nas dgon dang bshad grwa'i kun spyod rnams dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams phra mo dang mi 'gal ba'i bca' khrims mdzad/rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg par 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba dang rgyud sde gong ma'i las tshogs dang gar thig 'don dbyangs sogs mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa dang mthun par mi nyams gong 'phel dang nyams pa slar gso mdzad/ sgrub pa'i gnas mchog kun tu rgyud rdo rje theg pa ma rgyud lhan cig skyes ma dang rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis su med pa gsal bar ston pa nā ro chos drug sogs snying po nyams su len pa'i sdes phyogs kun tu khyab pas 'dus pa'i zhal grangs 'bum du long bar bshad/ gzhan yang la mo rtse dza lan+dhar/ phag mo ri/ stong 'go/ rdza bkra/ wa shi dpal gyi ri/ rna ri byang chub gling sogs kyang rje 'di ba'i bka' drin gyis bskyangs pas slob brgyud dang bcas pa nam mkhar bya ltar 'phur ba dang rdo 101

la phyag zhabs kyi rjes sogs grub pa'i rtags mtshan byung ba sha stag yin zhes grags/ skabs 'dir rje 'di ba'i phyi'i mdzad spyod skor rag tsam gleng ba las grub pa'i mdzad spyod dang lhas zhal gzigs lung bstan byung tshul sogs nang dang gsang ba'i rnam thar rje nyid kyis brtsams pa'i rnam thar gzhan la phan pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer las 'byung bas der gzigs par zhu/ rnam thar de nyid las dag pa'i snang ba phar cher rmi lam du gsungs na'ang khong gis rmi lam dang nyin snang gcig tu rtogs pas rmis zhes pa rnams mngon sum kho na yin te bgres po dag gi ngag rgyun du rlung ltar grags pa cho dper na nub cig mgon po phyag drug pas/ gnod byed dud 'gror brdzis pa mang po bsad pas phyir nyin sha mang du spung ba tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa skye bo mang pos za myong ba yin zhes sogs mang por 'byung ba bzhin no/ /gdan rabs drug pa mkhas grub seṅge dpal/de nas gdan rabs drug pa mkhas grub seng ge dpal ni/ /sku 102

na phra ba'i dus nas ra this dgon du rig pa'i gnas la gus rtag brtson pa'i stobs kyis yun du sbyangs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang karma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho gnyis thun min gyi bla mar bsnyen nas mkhas par gyur cing ra this dgon gyi bdag po mdzad skabs/ karma sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho ra this dgon du phebs par zhus shing gser dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang ja dkar sig chen brgya phrag gis 'bul ba byas/ yang 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i bu chen rnams dang zhing gi mi chen rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya chen bgyis nas nan gyis phebs par zhus pas zhal bzhes gnang / de nas ra this dgon gyi mkhas grub seng ge dpal gyis gtsos dpon slob dge 'dun mang pos bsu ma dang bcas rje rin po che phyags phebs/smin grol gyi gdams pa mang po bstsal skabs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i tshogs dang mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas kyis gus ldan gyi slob bu 'ga' dang bcas par zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing nyams rtogs rab tu 'phel/ de nas dar mdo sogs 103

su phebs/ slar yang ra this dgon du yar phebs mchod sprin rgya chen byas shing chos 'khor yun ring bskor/ gtso bo thugs dam la bzhugs nas ting 'dzin thams cad kyis rgyal po 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu la brtan pa thob/ thugs dam gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal gzigs shing nyid dang tha mi dad par rtag tu gzigs/ bla ma rnam gnyis la sangs rgyas dngos mthong gi 'du shes bcos min du 'khrungs/ gdams ngag thams cad gnad du phog pas nyon mongs rang sar grol ba'i rtogs pa mnyam rjes dang bral ba brnyes so/ /de nas mi nyag gi yul phal mo che brgyud nas phebs so/ /rje 'di ba'i slob ma'i thu bo bzhag bla ma kun dga' dpal ni rje bdun pas chos dang gdams ngag rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang / rjes su mkhas pa mi lnga'i nang tshan byams gsar pa yin pa'i sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i thugs bskyed kyis mi nyag tu phebs/ shin tu hu'i rgyal po dang dar mdo'i chen po sogs rgya'i blon chen dang rgyal bu du mas yon gnas dam par bsnyen pa dang / ra this dga' ldan gling du phebs te chos 104

'khor yun ring bskor kyang gdan sa'i khur khong gis ma bzhes par mngon/ de nas karma brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje mchog phebs nas 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i sgrub gnas dza lad+dha ra zhig gso byas pa sogs rje 'di bas mi nyag gi yul phyogs kun la bdag rkyen gang mang gnang / ra this dga' ldan gling du gdan 'dren zhus shing khri 'bul du ma byas/ rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal ra this pa'i gdan sa'i bdag po brkos/ zab chos mang du gsung nas mgar thar du yar phebs/ rab sgang gi gzhi bdag rnams kyis mjal ba dang bsu ma byas pa sogs rtags ltas ngo mtshar ba dang bcas mi nyag gi yul phal mo cher phebs pa'o/ /gdan rabs bdun pa rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal/rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal ni/ gzhon nu'i dus nas dobus gtsang du phebs nas ris su ma chad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po bsten pas gzhung lugs gang la chags thogs med 105

pa'i rab 'byams pa chen po zhes pa'i mtshan snyan thob/ rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje thun min gyi bla mar bkur nas 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i chos skor rnams gsan/ de nas rang dgon ra this dga' ldan byams pa gling du bzhugs skabs rje brgyad pas gdan sa'i bdag por bskos pas/ bshad sgrub kyi 'dus sde shin tu dar bar byas/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ yang skabs zhig rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal gyis 'brug lor karma pa brgyad pa slar yang ra this dgon du gdan zhus byed pa ltar phebs nas gser yig pa rnams kyis mjal ba byas/ zhes pa sogs rlabs chen gyi mdzad bzang rgya che/ phyis su rje 'di nyid kyi thugs bskyed bla na med pas phyogs phyogs kyi rgyal ba bka' brgyud pa'i dgon sde spyi dang khyad par ra this dga' ldan byams pa gling du logs su bshad grwa'i gtsug lag khang dang grwa shag bzhengs shing slob ma'i 'tsho rkyen phun sum tshogs par byas/ mkhas grub rin chen legs pas mkhan po dang phyi nang gsang ba'i khur bzhes pas mkhas pa'i tshul dgu'i grags pa dkar pos sa chen po'i khyon kun khyab par gyur to//106

gdan rabs brgyad pa mkhas grub rin chen legs pa/mkhas grub rin chen legs pa ni/ rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i thugs zin gyi slob chen te mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par mkhas pa'i tshad du gyur/de nas rje brgyad pa'i bka' las ra this dgon gyi bdag po yun du byas/ mkhas grub kyi skyes bu mang po skyed bsring mdzad pa'i slob bu gcig nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu bskos zhes pa gdan rabs dgu pa yin yang lo rgyus gsal bor ma shes pas skabs shig bzhag go /gdan rabs bcu ba tshangs sras 'byung gnas/gdan rab bcu ba tshangs sras 'byung gnas ni/ mi nyag mo lnga sum mdo ste da lta rdzong zhabs zhes 'bod pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam dpyod sogs lhan skyes kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pas yul gyi dpon por bskos/ chos la dad pa che bas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs shing ra this dgon gyi bla ma 107

rnams dang chos srid gyi 'brel ba gting zab chags pas zhabs tog kyang rgya chen bsgrub/ skabs shig sog po bstan 'dzin chos rgyal dmags dpung dang bcas mi nyag du 'byor bar khong gis thabs sna tshogs pas ra this dgon rang gi rgyal sa byas nas sog po'i btsan rgol las thar bas 'du khang chen mo rgya bskyed gnang ba sogs sri zhu rgya chen bgyis/ karma bcu ba chos dbyings rdo rje gdan drangs nas chos mang po zhus/ 'di skabs dgon gyi gdan 'dzin dngos mtshan gyi gsal kha ma mchis shing tshangs sras 'byung gnas 'di rgya'i yig tshang du gsal ba ltar bka' drin che bas gdan rabs su bzhag pa tsam mo/ /gdan rabs bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa/gdan rabs bcu gcig pa bla ma zhig dang / bcu gnyis pa ra this yang dgon pa zhes bla ma de gnyis kyis rim bzhin dgon pa'i rten 'thor bo bsdu rub dang yod pa rnams nyar tshags gnang ba yin yang lto rgyus med pas rnam thar skabs shig 'jog pa las 108

thabs med do/ /gdan rabs bcu gsum pa dang bcu bzhi pa/gdan rabs bcu gsum pa seng seng karma dkon mchog ni/khyim rgyud a mdo phyogs nas 'ong ba yin yang bla ma yang dgon pa sogs ra this pa'i sbyin bdag gtso bor gyur yod la dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i mjug tu sku 'khrungs/ mi gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas dpon sar bskos/ ra this ba'i rten rnying rnams dang bstan pa'i khur yang khong la gtad/ khong gis yul dgon gnyis kyi bdag po byas nas chos srid bskyangs/ brgyud 'dzin gyi bu ma byung bas rnam dkar gyi rim gro bsgrubs mthar gzhi bdag gis bu zhig dngos grub tu brtsal ba la smon lam stobs chen zhes pa'i ming btags/ de ni mi yi rnam pa las 'das pa'i stobs rtsal dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i skyes bu khyad par ba zhig ste chos la'ang rab tu dad cing mthu nus dang byin rlabs kyi tshan rtsal chen po yod par grags/ rjes su pha'i rgyal tshab tu gyur nas chos srid gnyis kyi 109

bdag por gyur/ snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs su khyab pa nyag rked mgon po rnam rgyal gyis phrag dog gis gsod par 'dod kyang ma thub par shor nas gang gi blon por bskos pa 'dis kyang mgon po khri tshar dang / zhi khro'i stong mchod/ phag mo'i sgrub mchod/ dbyar gnas sogs lo ltar 'tshogs shing ra this pa'i dus mchod dang kho rang gi lo rim sbra gur las stabs gcig tu 'tshogs pa yin pas gdan rabs bcu bzhi bar bgrang zhing khong gis rjes su bla ma rig la dgon pa'i rten rnying rnams dang gya nom pa'i 'bul ba bcas ra this pa'i gtso 'gan bzhes te slar gso bya dgos pa'i thugs re rgya chen bton pa sogs mdzad pa dkar po sku tshe mthar phyin pa'o//gdan rabs bco lnga pa tshe dbang rdo rje/skyes mchog 'jam grags kyi rnam rol bla ma tshe dbang rdo rje ni/khams mi nyag rab sgang gi sa'i char gtogs shar stod bzhag bra'i lho rgyud du rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i stod tsam du yab mes gtsang ma'i rigs rgyud du sku 'khrungs/ gser kha gter ston gyis skyes 110

mchog 'jam grags kyi rnam rol du ngos bzung nas rig 'dzin tshe dbang rdo rje'i mtshan gsol/ yab dang zhang gnyis las yi ge 'bri klog dang bca' bshams sogs sbyang par mdzad/ mi nyag kun bsod las rab tu byung zhing sngon 'gro blo sbyang dang sems sdom spyod 'jug sogs zhus/ dgung grangs nyer gsum tsam na nyag bla pad+ma bdud 'dul dang rdzogs chen chos zad ma sogs kyi snyan pa gsan pas chos 'dod gnas mjal ba 'ga' dang bsdebs nas lha sgang nas brgyud nyag rong du lhang brag pad+ma bdud 'dul mjal nas dbang khrid mang du gsan cing bla ma'i thugs zin gyi dngos slob du gyur/ de nas rim par rdzogs chen du phebs nas chos zad ma'am nam mkha'i rdo rje rin po che'i mdun nas snying thig gi chos skor rnams dang / karma rang byung rdo rje'i chos sku mdzub tshug pad+ma rig 'dzin gyi nyams len spar bcang / rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi lung bcas gsan nas lo gcig tsam du bzhugs/ slar zhe chen dang byang sde rdza chu kha nas brgyud dbus lha ldan du gnas mjal la phebs pa'i lam bar/ 'di dus bzhugs pa'i bka' rnying gi skyes 111

chen thams cad las chos 'brel ma thob pa med par byas/ phyir rdzogs chen du phebs skabs rdzogs sprul bzhi ba zhing du gzigs zin pas thugs skyo dang bcas dpal yul dgon du phebs te cho ga'i phyag len sogs la zhib gzigs gnang mthar rang yul du 'byor/ 'di skabs ra this pa'i gdan sa jun gar bas brlag nas yun ring zin cing lha sde phal mo che zhig dge ldan pa'i mnga' khong su gnas yod stabs dgon rnying gi shul tsam las gdan sa stong par chags yod la skabs 'gar gnas 'dir sbra gur la brten nas mgon po khri tshar dang phag mo'i sgrub mchod gnas stong bcas seng seng dpon gyis btsugs pa'i lo re'i dus mchod tsam 'tshogs srol dang / yang dgon dang brag dmar tshe chu phug sogs na rgyun bzhugs mtshams rgan kha shas yod par grags/ gang ltar ra this pa'i bstan pa rgud pa'i sgang yin yang khong gis mtshams bla rtogs ldan a bsod la rten rnying rnams sprad nas ra this dgon rnying gzhir bzhengs mdzad de bstan pa rang rkang tshugs pa zhig spel dgos pa'i bgres po'i zhal chems bcas re zhig zhi ba'i 112

dbyings su gshegs so//gdan rabs bcu drug pa rtogs ldan a bsod ni/gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam rol du grags pa mchams bla rtogs ldan a bsod rin po che ni/ shar mi nyag 'bo gangs dkar kyi byang rgyud bri rdzong phyug mo'i mdun zhol du rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa rta1859lor sku bltam/ rim gyis nar son pa nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs shes bya'i gnas la sbyang / lcags sgang gter ston las chos 'brel ci rigs mnog chos su thob/ thun min rigs kyi bdag po skyabs mgon ye shes rdo rje dang rgyal sras ral gri sogs yun ring bsten/ la 'ur thang du grwa shag cig tu mtshams la lo 'gar bzhug rjes khang pa de me yis tshig nas dngos po rnams med par gyur kyang khong gi phyag rnga chung ngu zhig yod pa mes ma tshig par rang sgra lha nge nag thig tsam yang med par yod pa sogs chos skyong rnams mngon par 'khor yod pa'i rtags mtshan yod par grags/ de nas hor ra mgon po bla ri'i sgrub phug ste sngar 'gag a 113

ra chos rje sgyub phug tu rim gnyis bsnyen sgrub kyi ting 'dzin la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas mtshams bla rtogs ldan gyi mtshan chags/ phyis su shug lung nang du mtshams grogs 'ga' dang bcas sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i skabs shig gzhi bdag gi sgo khyi bzung ba kun gyis mthong ba dang / nyin zhig mtshams grogs bla ma zhig glo bur phebs nas/ nga skrag gi gsung / ci la skrag gi zhus pas/ 'dre la skrag gi gsung khong gis na re/ha ha rdzogs pa chen po bya rtsol re dogs dang bral ba'i ngang skyong ba la 'dre zhig gang nas byung / rang re ban rgan tshos snang srid thams cad sems su shes/ sems nyid ye nas chos sku ru thag bcad pa ma yin nam zhes sogs dri ba dris lan gyi gdam pa mang po gsung ba bcas rdzogs pa chen po'i gdang tshad thob pa'i khyad chos mang bar bshad/ de nas bla ma che dbang rdo rje mchog gis rten snying dang bstan pa'i khur phul nas bstan rgyun gso ba'i re ba bton kyang sku mtshams 'ba' zhig la bzhugs pas gdan sa slar gso ma byas kyang / dbyar gnas dang mgon po'i sgrub mchod sogs kyi dbu bla mdzad/ rten rnying rnams nyar zhing 114

dben khrod rnams zhig gso byas nas sgrub pa'i bstan pa rgya chen spel bas gdan rabs su bzhag pa las chos srid gnyis la dbang bsgyur ba'i mdzad pa cher ma rgyas/ phyis nyi sprul 'jam dpal ye shes rin po che la rten rnying 'thor bo rnams sprad cing gdams pa nan po bstsal nas mthar sku tshugs drang por bsring nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa'o////gdan rabs bcu bdun pa mchog sprul 'jam dpal ye shes/de yang o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rdo rje'i bka' lung gis zab mo gter gyi 'khor los bsgyur bar dbang bskur ba'i rtsod med gyi gter ston chen po khams pa nyi ma grags pa'i gsung gi rnam rol du tshad ma'i bka' lung gis bsngags pa/ mi nyag mkhas pa mi lnga'i gdan sa ra ti dga' ldan byams chen gling gi bstan pa'i me ro gzhir bzhengs su slong bar thugs bskyed dam bca'i bden mthu la rang dbang 'byor ba'i dus babs kyi skyes bu chen po 115

bsam bzhin mi yi rdzu la zhugs pa grub brnyes rig 'dzin 'jam dpal ye shes zhes snyan pa'i grags pa sa chen po'i khyon na ldir ba gang nyid/ rdzogs sprul lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje dang sprul sku dri med 'od zer rnam gnyis kyis gcig mthun du/ hrīḥsngon tshe sems nyid ngal gso blo gros grags/ /klu yi dbang po sur+ya kirti sogs/ /sprul ba gcig bsdus rig 'dzin mañju shrī/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyi rlobs/ /zhes pa sogs kyi gsol smon gnang ba ltar sngon gyi dus na 'phags mchog sems nyid ngal gso dang bdag cag gi ston mchog mtshungs med thub pa'i dbang pos rim gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su dgra bcom blo gros grags/ de bzhin du dpal gyi bsam yas su o rgyan pad+mas bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs smin grol gdams pa'i dga' ston 'gyed skabs lo chen klu yi dbang po dang / phyi ma'i dus na mtshor 'khrungs pad+ma ka ra'i zab gter 'byed pa'i mnga' bdag rtsod dus kyi skal ba ngan pa'i mun pa 'jom pa la mchog tu bsngags 116

pa'i gter chen nyi ma grags pa dang / ma 'ongs par bskal bzang sangs rgyas so bdun par mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba sogs dus gsum du gzhan snang gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa'i bye brag dag ma dag gi ngo skal du sku'i rnam rol sprin rgya mtsho ston pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud las/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bu las/ /longs sku nyi ma shar ba ltar/ /sprul sku 'ja' dang 'od zer tshul/ /zhes dang mdo phal bo che las/ ji ltar sems can bsam pa bzhin/ /tshad med par ni rab tu snang / /zhes pa ltar las/ gang la me tog phog pa'i lha skal bka' drin zla bral mchog gi sprul ba'i sku 'di nyid gang du 'khrung pa'i yul ni mdo khams sgang drug gi ya gyal mi nyag ra ba sgang gi sa'i char gtogs/ gnas bdag 'bum rtse gtsug tor rgyal ba dang sgo 'dan lha bu dge sgosnyen sogs kyis bdag tu bzung pa'i gnas mchog be+e ro tsa na dang nyi grags rin po che sogs kyis zhabs kyis bcags shing / sa'i dpyad bzang dgu 'dzom pa'i sman ljongs nor bu thang zhes pa ru/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags 'brug lo ste spyi lo 1880lor yab sngags 'chang tshe dbang thar dang yum tshe 117

ring sgron ma zhes bud med kyi skyon dang bral zhing dge ba'i las la rab tu 'dun pa gnyis kyi sras su me tog gi char bab pa dang /'ja' 'od kyis sbra khyim gang ba/ ma yum gyis zangs dkar lung brgyad pa che chung phor ba'i tshad tsam zhig gi nang gser gyis gang ba dngos su rnyed pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ ji skad du/ du ba las ni me shes dang / /chu skyal las ni chu shes bzhin/ /blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes pa ltar/ sku na phra ba'i dus nas byis pa'i spyod pa las ring du 'da' zhing 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yeng la mi dga' bar skyes bu dam pa'i mdzad bzang sha stag byed/dgung grangs bdun par yab kyis klog bslab pa na sngon goms dge ba'i bag chags stobs su gyur ba dang mkhyen pa'i yon tan lhan skyes su mnga' bas byis pa gzhan dang mi 'dra bar klog bzang po 'phel ba byung / dgung grangs bcu drug tsam bzhes skabs/thengs gcig rmi lam lta bu'i nyams snang du skyes bu shwa mgo can zhig gis khyed rang rdzogs chen la phebs na bzang / nga tshos khyed la 118

rtag tu sdong grogs yod zer ba zhig byung ba yab la zhus pas/ kho bo la'ang de 'dra'i nyams snang zhig shar byung bas gri btsan chen po yin pa 'dra/ da nga tshos rdzogs chen la 'gro rtsis byed gsung nas tshe dbang sogs rim gro ci rigs bsgrubs te shing lug lor khams rdzogs chen du grwa sar phebs/ rdzogs sprul lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje dang mjal bas o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang zhal mnyam pa'i tshe rabs las kyi bla ma khong red 'dug pas de ring bdag skal ba re bzang snyam pa'i mos gus kyi mig chu dbang med du 'khrugs shing spro ba tshad med pa'i ngang sngon gnas rjes su dran pa byung / rdzogs sprul rin po ches kyang rig 'dzin nyi ma grags pa'i gsung gi sprul skur ngos 'dzin mdzad cing thub sku chung ngu zhig dang rdor dril nyi grags kyi gsung chos gleg bam bcas sku gsung thugs rten dang sku dngos kyi mnab stod kyang bshus te gnang bar ma zad/dbang lung khrid gsum gyi chos 'brel ci rigs pa mnog chos su bstsal nas mi nyag rā tī dgon zhig gso byas na bstan 'gror phan thogs rgya chen yod tshul sogs nang brtses gsung gnang mdzad/119

'jam mgon mi pham rin po che'i mdun nas/ spyod 'jug dang /nges sgron sogs zhus shing phur tsha'i a dkon sogs mkhan rgan rnams las chos 'brel du mar gsan bsam mdzad nas slar rang yul du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur/ de nas dbus lha ldan du gnas mjal phebs pa'i lam bar thengs gcig mi nag sngags chas gyon pa bdud rtsi thod phor gang thogs pa zhig mdun du slebs te bdud rtsi khyor gang drang nas 'di dngos grub kyi tshul du gsol zer nas glo bur gar song cha med du gyur/ khong gis bla ma'i dngos grub tu shes nas bdud rtsi gsol bas re zhig 'du snang 'gags shing nyams len la bog thon pa byung ba sogs bla ma dang chos skyong srung mas rtag tu zhal gzigs shing gdong grogs mdzad/ de nas lha ldan jo shāka rnam gnyis kyis gtsos dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i gnas chen khag la mchod 'bul rgya chen gnang nas bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs smon 'ba' zhig mdzad pa dang / gsar rnying ris su ma chad pa'i skyes chen dag las chos bka' mang du gsan pa sogs rgyal sras kyi mdzad pa rlabs po che bskyangs/ gdan sa rang phyir 120

phebs nas sngar ra this dgon rnying gi rten rdzas rtsa chen 'thor brlags song ba rnams bsdu rub mdzad cing dgon pa slar gso gnang bar nyer bsdogs bgyis/ rdzogs sprul lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje khong gi tshe rabs las kyi bla ma yin stabs rdzogs chen chos sde dang bla ma dran drag pas yang bskyar rdzogs chen du grwa sar phebs/rdzogs sprul lnga ba'i mdun nas rin chen gter mdzod dang nyi grags chos skor yongs rdzogs sogs dbang lung khrid gsum gyi gdams pa mang po gsan cing thugs yid dbyer med gyur/ mu ra pad+ma bde chen bzang po dang gzhan dga' sogs kyi drung nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa thugs nyams su bzhes/ khyad par snying thig dum gnyis/ ya bzhi/ ngal gso skor gsum/ rang grol skor gsum/ mun sel skor gsum khrid yig ye shes bla ma sogs rang lugs kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gsung rnams la khrid sbyang dang 'brel gsan bsam mthar chags su gnang mthar rang yul du byon nas ra this dga' ldan byams gling du sbra gur dang nag tshang la brten te yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi sgo nas sidzhai'i sgrub 121

mchod chen mo dbu btsugs/ phyag len mtha' dag rdzogs chen ltar bslab/ gzhi gsum cho ga'i phyag len dbyar gnas kyi rgyun btsugs nas dam chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa sogs kyis bstan pa'i me ro bslang / gra btsun gzhon nu blo gsal rnams khams rdzogs chen sogs su grwa sar btang zhing slob ston gnang ba sogs skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar 'dran zla dang bral/ gzhan yang lo ltar bsnyung gnas dang ma ṇi dung sgrub sogs kyi chos sbyin rgya cher bstsal/ sku tshe'i smad tsam la gal che'i skabs re zung ma gtogs sku mtshams bcad rgya byas skabs gzhi bdag gis dbyar dgun med par 'o zho 'bul ba sogs sde brgyad bran du 'du zhing rtag tu bsnyen sgrub la gzhol/ rgyal 'phags sprul sku dngos grub kyis gtsos 'dus sde yongs kyi re bskul ma ldog par rgyal 'phags dgon du phebs te dgon gyi bla grwa yongs dang phyogs nas phebs pa'i 'dus pa brgya phrag 'ga' la nyi grags chos skor gyi dbang lung gnang / mkhan sprul rnams kyi gtsos 'dus pa 'ga' zhig la gdam ngag khrid kyi rim pa rgya cher bstsal nas de dag gi rgyud la sku 122

bzhi'i sa bon grung po thebs par mdzad/ rgyal 'phags dgon par gser zangs las grub pa'i gu ru'i sku byin ldan zhig rten skal brtsal ba da lta'ang mjal du yod cing dgon de'i rdo rje rgyal bo'ang — yun ring bzhugs myong ba sogs khams mi nyag gi yul du bka' drin zla dang bral bar gyur/ de nas dgung grangs nga gsum bzhes pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sprel spyi lo 1932lor sku dngos kyi 'gro don re zhig rdzogs nas tha ma'i mdzad pa ston pa la phyogs te/ de yang rje bla ma 'di nyid nges pa'i don du/ mdo las/ nga ni mya ngan 'da' ma yin/ /dam pa'i chos kyang nub mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu re rnams sun phyung phyir/ /mya ngan 'da' ba ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ye nas skye 'chi spang ba'i chos dbyings bde ba chen por mnga' brnyes su zin kyang / gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams sun phyung ba sogs re zhig gdul bya'i gzhan ngor sku gshegs pa'i tshul ni/ chu med dben lung na sku mtshams bcad rgya ru bzhugs skabs theng cig glo bur du rdzogs chen sgrub mchod chen mor 'gro dgos pa'i brda' byung song gsung nas cho ga'i gshegs gsol 123

mdzad tshe rnam lnga'i mar me rang 'bar du gyur/ chibs pa sogs phral du 'du byas nas rdzogs chen phyogs su zhabs kyi kha lo bsgyur/rdzogs sprul lnga bas gtsos phyogs kyi skyes chen du ma dang lhan tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen mor thugs smon dang bcas tshogs zhugs mdzad/de nas pad+ma'i thang du zla shas ring sku mtshams la bzhugs skabs zhabs phyi bar/ zhal rtsed kyi tshul du/ nga rtsa ba'i bla ma dang 'bral 'dod med kyang zangs mdog dpa' rir skye ba'i smon lam mthu btsan song bas 'bral 'gro ba 'dra/ a la bla ma dang thugs yid dbyer med gcig tu 'dris song bas 'bral rgyu zhig e yod na/ zla shas nas nga tsho rang yul phyogs la sleb 'gro yong sogs zhing 'di nas zangs mdog dpa' rir skyes tshul dang de nas rang yul phyogs su yang srid 'khrungs tshul sogs lkog gyur mang po ji bzhin lung bstan gnang yang zhabs phyi bas zhal rtsed tsam las brda lung du ma shes/ phyis bsam tshe lung bstan dag dag red 'dug zer/nyin gcig sku cung zad snyun tshul mdzad nas rdzogs sprul lnga bar chibs pa g.yu sgong sogs 'bul nod rgya chen byas te rang dgon gyi 124

mkhan chung rnams dang / sku mched rig chos/ sku tshwa mthu stobs sogs grwa sa ba rnams la 'phral yun gyi bslab bya mang po dang bcas mjug mtha'i zhal chems bstsal nas nyin gsum gyi zhog par sku drang por bsrang ste a zhes lan gsum brjod bzhin nang gsal khyad chos drug ldan gdod ma'i nang dbyings su zhi bar gzims pa'i tshul bstan/ gsang sngags cho ga'i dar zhal phyes te gdung zhugs la phul tshe rgyud sde nas gsung ba'i phyi nang gi grol rtags thams cad mngon sum mthun snang du byung zhing khyad par thugs ljags spyan gsum dang ring bsrel sna tshogs pa babs pa sogs tha ma'i mdzad pa rdzogs chen pad+ma thang du grub par bgyis pa'o gdan rabs bco brgyad pa bsod nams bkra shis/gnubs zur mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis sam thub bstan rin chen bzang po ni/ rgyal ba'i sras po byang chub sems dpa' dag bsam bzhin shin tu nyag phra'i rgyal bstan nyams 125

dma' ba'i dus su byon pa lags te/ chos kyi 'od zer pas/ bī ma mi tra'i sprul ba'i rnam rol mchog /pad+ma ka ra'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /zhes bī ma mi tra'i rnam sprul du lung bstan pa dang / mkhan chen rma seng ston pa nyid mya ngan las 'da' kha nga 'di nas o rgyan gyi yul du 'gro gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la smon lam dang rten 'brel 'grig pa yin gsungs pa dus su smin pa rdzogs sprul lnga bas lung bstan pa sogs 'phags bod gyi mkhas grub mang po zhig gi rnam pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen bgyis shing slar yang sku skye sngon ma rma se ston pas btab pa'i dgon gnas rā tī dga' ldan gling du gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gdung las mched pa'i rigs rus bzang po'i yab gnubs zur tshe ring bkra shis dang / yum sprel thar sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i rtags dang bcas sa pho byi ba(1888)lo la sku 'khrungs/ sngon gyi bag chags bzang po dus su smin nas rnam dkar dge ba'i las la rab tu spro na'ang / khyim der klog bslab mkhan med pas khong gis sku ngal la ma ltos par gzhan sgo 'grim 126

nas yi ge 'bri klog rnams thogs med du mkhyen/ mchog sprul 'jam dpal rin po che'i mdun nas tshe dbang dang byang sdom sogs chos zur tsam re zhus/ rgyal 'phags sprul sku dngos gru ba der gnas mjal du phebs nas rgan rab rnams kyis gtsos skya ser yongs la bde chen zhing sgrub dang zab mo 'pho ba'i gdam khrid gnang skabs mchog nyid byis pa yin kyang zhus pa tsam gyi 'pho rtags thon par gyur/ de nas mchog sprul 'jam dpal ye shes theng gnyis par rdzogs chen du phebs skabs rje 'di nyid kyang mnyam du pheb cing rdzogs sprul lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje dang mjal zhing rab tu byung / ra this rma se ston pa rin chen bzang po'i rnam sprul du ngos bzung zhing mtshan yang thub bstan rin chen bzang po zhes btags shing brda byang dang rdo dril sogs gnang nas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten te thos bsam dgyid dgos tshul sogs bka' slob mang du gnang / yang mchog sprul 'jam dpal rin po che'i rjes bzhin 'brang nas zhe chen du mjal bar pheb pas rab 'byams ñja ba 'gyur med kun bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 127

mjal zhing / bdag ni chos 'tshol du 'ong ba lags pas bla ma su dga' zhus pa na 'o khyod rdzogs chen mkhan po bsod nams chos 'phel la bsten dgos zhes mtshan de thos ma thag tu bdag gi bla ma'o snyam nas bcos min gyi dad pa skyes/ tshur rdzogs chen du 'byor ma thag 'tsho chas rgyab tu khur nas nags chung ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i mkhan chen bsod nams chos 'phel gyi mdun du phebs nas gus pas rgyu mtshan dang bcas cis kyang chos kyis skyong bar bka' drin mi chung bar zhus pas/ mkhan pos byis pa 'o kha ma khyod/ sa thag ring bo 'dir rgyab kyi khur bo las sngon gyi mdud pa che ba zhig byed nas ci la 'ong mkhan chen gzhan phan snang bas rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che mdzad nas shrī seng chos grwa chen mo dpal nā lan+t+ra dang mi gnyis par byas pa der mi 'gro bar nga ban rgan 'chi kha ma zhig gi sar cis phyir 'ong mar song gsungs pas/ khong thugs rab tu skyo nas mig nas mchi ma 'don bzhin thugs la btags par bka' drin che zhes yang yang zhus pas/ 'o na skabs shig sdod gsung nas rgyal sras byang chub sems 128

dpa'i spyod 'jug gi ljags khrid gnang bas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi dad pa bcos ma ma yin pa 'khrungs shing dga' sdug gi rtog pa 'di dag thams cad sems kyi rol ba tsam dang sems de'ang ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar ngo 'phrod cing spyod 'jug mjug grub pa na bla mas da ni rgan 'khogs 'chol po kher bur 'dug tu chug khyed rang mkhan chen gzhan dga' rin po che'i mdun du song / gsungs nas 'dug ma bcug pas/ snying nas 'bral mi 'dod bzhin bka' ldog ma nus par bshums pa mdzad bzhin bza' gos dag khur nas shrī seng du phebs/ mkhan chen gzhan dga' rin po che'i mdun nas dbu ma bzhi brgya bar gsan bsam mdzad cing mjug grub pa na mkhan chen gzha' dga' dpal spung si tu rin po che pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal pos gdan zhus ltar dpal spung du phebs/ slob ma thams cad bla ma'i rjes bzhin byon na'ang khong bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel gyi mdun du yar phyin nas lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ bla mas 'o des na sdod dang chog gsungs nas/ sdom gsum rnam nges/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ rtsa shes/129

sdom 'grel dpag snyi/ klong chen mdzod bdun/ gsang snying phyogs bcu mun sel/ gsang bdag dgongs rgyan sogs la gsan sbyang mi lo lnga tsam du mdzad/ de'i ring la bla mar mnyes pa du mas zhabs phyi legs por bsgrubs pas kun gyis bsod chos zhabs phyi zhes tshul spyod legs pa'i tshad du grags/ skabs shig bla mar chu len sa'i rdza snod cig yod pa de ni bla mas khong gi pha dang 'dra bas chag ma shor gsung / nyin zhig khong chu len du song nas rdza snod chag shor bas shin tu skrag nas bla mar ngas de ring bya ba chen po nyes song zhus pas/ ci nyes song shod dang gsung / rdza bum chag shor song zhus pas/ 'o 'dus pa thams cad 'bral ba'i rang bzhin/skye ba thams cad 'chi ba'i rang bzhin/ bsags pa thams cad 'dzad pa'i rang bzhin yin pas rdza bum 'dang che rung ci phan/gces pa'i lus srog 'di dang drin che ba'i pha ma'ang 'dus byas kyi chos nyid las ma 'das tshul sogs gdam pa mang du gsungs/yun ring ma 'gying bar pha yul du skor rgyag la phyin pa na rgya dmags kyis bcom nas pha dang spun rnams bsad nor rdzas 130

rnams khyer nas med par byas zin pa mthong tshe bla mas gsungs pa'i gdam ngag dag lung du bstan pa mkhyen nas bcos min gyi dad pa skyes zhing spyan chab yang yang byung / 'khor ba la skyo shas gting nas skye zhing phyir rdzogs chen du phebs/ slar yang bla ma bsod chos kyi drung du phyin pa na/ bla ma thugs rab tu dgyes nas yar pheb pa dga' gsung nas gsol ston bzang po byas/ de nas bzung dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal dkar bos nam yang ma btang ba ma zad ngal gso skor gsum/ rgyud bcu bdun/ ye shes bla ma/ mkha' 'gro snying tig /bla ma yang tig sogs thob par dka' ba'i man ngag gi zab khrid mang po gsungs nas khyod lta bu'i slob bu snod ldan dam pa dkon pa yin zhes bsngags pa brjod cing slar yang bla ma yang tig chig brgyud du rgyas par gnang nas slob ma'i mchog tu dbang bskur/ snying thig gi phyag dpe yongs rdzogs gnang / rjes su mchog sprul 'jam dpal ye shes mkhan po bsod chos mdun du pheb pa na/ mkhan po'i zhal nas nga'i slob bu bsod nams bkra shis pha yul la pheb pa'i nub mo nga'i rmi lam du gser gyi rdo rje rtse 131

lnga ba zhig la dar tshon sna lnga btags te mi nyag gi yul du 'phen pa rmis pas bstan dang 'gro ba la phan pa zhig 'ong nges pas khyed kyis sor mdo 'don du chug dang chog gsungs nas me nyag gi yul du 'gro don 'byung bar lung bstan/ gzhan rdzogs sprul lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje dang mu ra pad+ma bde chen bzang po'i mdun nas smin grol gdam pa mang po gsan zhing / rdzogs sprul lnga ba'i bkas rdzogs chen bde kong gnyis kyi yongs 'dzin du bskos kyang dgongs gnas zhus nas pha yul du mar phebs/ yang dben bsam gtan gling gi nye char sgrub pa la brtson skabs rigs kyi bdag po bsod nams chos 'phel zhi bar gshegs nas ye shes sgyu ma'i gzugs sku mngon sum du pheb cing gsung gi dbug dbyung thob par bcos min gyis gsol ba btab pas lus kyi rtsa mdud yongs rdzogs grol zhing dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ de nas bzung mdo sngags gang la'ang chags thogs med pa'i dgongs pa'i klong rdol ba na mchog sprul 'jam dpal ye shes bka' lung ldog tu med pas mkhan por bskos/ khong gis 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi phyag len ma 132

nyams pa'i dbyar gnas dang smyung gnas sgrub mchod bcas kyi mkhan po dang bla ma lo ltar mdzad/ skya ser kun la sngon 'gro kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung spyod 'jug rgyal sras lag len yon tan mdzod sdom gsum dbu ma bzhi brgya ba dbu ma 'jug pa bcas gsung zhing rkun jag rngon pa sogs mi dge sdig spyod kyi rgyun bcad/dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas/ 'bum lnga dang sngon 'gro tshad du 'khyol ba rnams la klong chen mdzod bdun/ ngal gso skor gsum/mkha' 'gro snying thig gi khrid/ ye shes bla ma/ bla ma yang tig sogs lan gcig min par du ma gsung zhing yang dgon dang brag dmar tshe chu phug sogs su sgrub pa kho na la gzhol bzhin bzhugs pa na/gnas bdag 'bum rtse sku 'khor dang bcas ba mngon sum mi yi rnam pas mdun du 'ong nas khyed 'dir bzhugs pa bka' drin che khyed kyis nga'i chu mig 'dir gtor ma bsngos dang ngas khyed la grogs byed ces zhus nas mi snang bar gyur ba sogs sde brgyad bran du 'du ba dang gu ru'i sku tshab mthong grol ma gter tu bzhes pa da lta'ang mjal du yod cing / skabs shig phur ba yang gsang bla med 133

kyi bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs pa na shar phyogs rgya yi phyogs nas me stag dmar bo zhig rim gyis je che ru thon pa mthar steng gi nam mkhar sbra tsam du gyur ba na lha'i nga rgyal gyis phur bu gtad pa tsam gyi tshal bar 'thor nas med par gyur/ yang nub gcig rmi lam du rgya 'dre zhig gis bla ma'i sku la rdza chag zhig gis bskyon pas sku cung snyun zhing nyin der mngon sum du 'ong ba la lha'i nga rgyal gyis sdig 'dzub gtad pas lus ngan spang bar byas pa sogs grub pa'i rtag mtshan mang du byung / 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba mngon du gyur ba'i skyes bu chen po 'di nyid kyi thugs bskyed rmad tu byung ba dang mchog sprul snga ma'i 'da' kha'i zhal chems dang yang sprul gzhon nu pad+ma bstan 'dzin dgyes pas bskul ba bzhin rten 'brel dus su smin par dgongs nas rang slob dam pa seng seng shes rab stobs ldan dang bla ma dpal chen sku tsha mthu stobs rdo rje sogs kyis gtso 'gan bzhes shing dgon yul gnyis kyis lhag bsam dri ma med pas sngar rma se ston pa'i sgrub grwa yang dgon nam yang dben bsam gtan gling gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing /134

dbyar gnas dang sgrub mchod smyung gnas zhi khro rnams lo ltar 'tshogs shing chos 'khor rgya chen bskor/ gdan sa'i bdag po seng seng shes rab stobs ldan bskos/ de nas sku nyid ri khud du phebs shing mchog sprul chos kyi 'od zer gtsos 'dus pa yongs la snying thig dum gnyis kyi dbang lung cha tshang sogs smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor cing yar phebs/ spyir skyes bu 'di nyid chos tshul gang la'ang chags thogs med pa sogs mkhas shing grub pa zhig ste khyad par 'pho ba la rang dbang thob pas skya ser su la btab kyang rtags ma byung ba gcig kyang med pa ma zad gshin po la 'pho ba 'debs skabs nye 'khor gyi mi mang po'ang / mgo na chu ser zil ba khrom/ /'jag ma dal gyis tshugs sogs 'byung / /zhes pa'i rtags kho na bzhin byung ba sogs bka' drin zla dang bral/skabs shig mkha' 'gro sde bzhi bsu mar byung ba dang yang mkha' 'gro ma mang pos bla ma dgung grang re gcig par gdan 'dren zer/la las re gnyis par gdan 'dren zer mthar re gnyis par thag bcad song bas khong gis slob ma rnams la nga re gnyis par 'chi 135

ba 'dra gsung / de nas dgung grangs re gnyis pa ste rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa glang (1949)lor rmi lam du shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du song nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mjal zhing rigs lnga'i zhing khams gzhan rnams su 'gro snyam pa rmis pas shi rtags yin pa 'dra gsungs pas slob ma rnams ha las/ 'o rmi lam 'khrul ba yin pas ci yang mi shes gsung / 'di lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la bla mas zhabs phyi bar de ring khyed kyis za ma legs po gyis la slob ma rnams mgron bos gsung pa bzhin bgyis pas bla slob rnams kyis gsol ston dgyes spro gnang / nyin de'i phyi dror gzims khang gi sgo dam bor bcad sku lus drang por bsring phyag gnyis gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad nas nang dbyings khyad chos drug ldan ka dag gdod ma'i grol sar zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ nyin bdun par g.yon ru bzhad pa rdo rje phebs pa na sku mdangs dang rang tshugs ma shor bar bzhugs pa la/ thugs dam bzhengs bskul gsung skabs shang g.yas g.yon nas byang sems dkar dmar bzhur zhing dbu dud par gyur/ 'di 136

lta bu'i skyes bu dam pa chen po zhes bsngags ba mdzad/ de nas g.yon ru bzhad pa dang ri sprul chos kyi 'od zer sogs kyis las bzhis sbyin bsreg gis pur sbyangs mdzad tshe spyan nam mkhar 'phags pa dang 'ja' dang ring bsrel sna tshogs byung ba'o/ /de yang rje 'di ba'i zhal slob kyang mkhas grub nyis ldan gyi skyes chen sha stag ste ri sprul chos kyi 'od zer/ sprul smin grol/ mchog sprul pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ mkhan skal bzang rnam 'phel/ shes rab stobs ldan/ btsun pa dpal chen/ bla ma tshe ring chos 'phel/ mkhan tsha nor 'phel/ khang ltag bla ma/ rdo rje dbang rgyal/ bla ma rig chos/mkhan dge 'dun bzang po/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dbyings /btsun pa rgya lu tshe ring sogs grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas grub kyi skyes bu grangs las 'das pa byung zhing bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa spel dang spel bzhin pa'o/ /137

gdan rabs bcu dgu ba mchog sprul smin grol rin po che/nges gsang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog sprul smin grol rin po che ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i me 'brug spyi lo 1916lor yab gnubs zur blo gros dang yum stong dpon bsod nams sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su sbra khyim 'od kyis gang ba dang / chu snod 'o mar 'gyur ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma dang bcas sku bltams/chung ngu'i dus nas chos phyogs su 'jug pa'i blo bcos min du mnga' bas na bza' dur smig la dga' ba dang sems can 'chi kha mar snying rje skyes te bshum pa sogs mdzad pas/ snying rje can gyi gzhon nu 'di bla ma zhig gi rnam shes yin pa 'dra zhes skye bo kun gyis gleng ba byung / dgung grangs bdun par mchog sprul rig 'dzin 'jam dpal gyis gtsug phud bzhes pa'i mtshan la rig 'dzin smin grol rgya mtsho gsol/ kho bos byis pa 'di skyes mchog 'jam grags kyi rnam rol grub brnyes tshe dbang rdo rje'i yang srid 'khrul 138

med yin snang shar yang da dung rdzogs sprul lnga bar thugs brtags zhu dgos gsung nas mgul dar bsgron/ rang dgon du tshogs zhugs byed dgos pa'i bka' phabs nas yi ge 'bri klog dang brda dag sgrub 'phrin cho ga'i phyag bzhes sogs bslab pas yun ring po'i ngal ba la ma ltos par tshags med du mkhyen/ de nas sprul sku rig 'dzin 'jam dpal gyis rdzogs chen du khrid nas thub bstan chos kyi rdo rjer dgongs brtags zhus pas dgongs lung gcig mthun du gyur nas gong bzhin sprul ba'i sku ru ngos 'dzin mdzad de rdor dril dang pad zhwa sogs gnang / chos dbang ci rig pa bstsal/slar rang yul du phebs nas/ nyid kyi khu bo mkhan chen rin chen bzang po dang bsod grags rnam gnyis kyi drung nas spyod 'jug dang dbu 'jug 'dul ba me tog 'phreng mdzes/ byams chos sde lnga/gsang snying sogs chos tshul mang du gsan pas mkhyen rab kyi rtsal kha rgyas shing mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/ dgung grangs nyer lnga bar nyid kyi sku mched mkhan po nam kho dang rnam gnyis kyis chos phyir dka' spyad kyi mdzad pa lhur bzhes te khams grub dbang rdzogs 139

chen du zhabs thang gis grwa sar phebs/ rdzogs sprul lnga ba dang mjal bas gshin rje'i sgrub phug na mkhan lha rgyal bzhugs yod pas der phyin na legs tshul gsungs pa bzhin rnam gnyis der phebs/ mkhan rin po che mjal ma thag tu sangs rgyas dngos mthong gi dad pa phyir mi ldog pa skyes shing thun min rigs kyi bdag por mnyes pa gsum gyis bsnyen pas thog mar dbyangs can dkar mo'i rjes gnang bstsal te chos sgo phyes/ de nas rim par spyod 'jug bzhi brgya ba 'jug pa/ sor mdo/ mngon pa gong 'og phar phyin sogs gzhung chen bcu gsum gtso bor gyur ba'i rgya gzhung khag dang / yon tan mdzod rang 'grel dang / yon dga'i 'grel ba/ klong chen mdzod bdun phyogs bcu'i mun sel/ rong zom dkon mchog 'grel/ snang ba lha bsgrub/ sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa sogs rgya bod kyi gzhung lugs rnams la gsan sbyang mthar chags gnang / gzhan yang mkhan chen pad+ma tshe dbang / yab rje ngag dbang nor bu/ yong 'dzin mkhan rgan mgon dris sogs sar gnas kyi sems dpa' bsam bzhin mi yi rdzu la zhugs shing 140

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul du byon pa dag gi zhal kyi bdud rtsi mngar mo lan gcig min par yang yang nyams su myong / mkhan chen pad+ma theg mchog blo ldan las bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po bzhes nas 'dul ba'i bcas khrims rnams mig 'bras bzhin bsrungs/ thun min rigs kyi bdag po a bu lha sgong rin po che las bar do drug khrid/ ye shes bla ma/ bla ma yang tig dang bcas 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i zab khrid mtha' dag bum pa gang byos tshul du rje 'di ba dang sku mched nam kho gnyis la chig brgyud du thob/ tshe ring sgrub phug tu bcad mtshams kyis 'bum lnga ma dang bla rnal sku gsum bsnyen pa sa ya bcas grub par mdzad pa sogs mdor na lo 'khor du mar rdzogs chen du grwa sar bzhugs nas slar rang yul du phebs khar rtsa ba'i bla ma a bu lha sgong ngam mkhan chen pad+ma theg mchog rin po ches thub bstan chos rdor gyis gnang ba'i dbu zhwa pad+ma kha 'bus zhig yod pa khong la gnang / khams mi nyag gi phyogs su bstan 'gro'i don ci lcogs sgrub shig gsungs nas 'bral mi phod pa'i thugs brtse gnang / de nas rang yul du phebs 141

te rā tī dgon gyi gtso 'gan bzhes nas bum sgrub kyi rdo rje rgyal po dang dbyar gnas mkhan po gcig lcogs mdzad/ hrī lung dgon gyi rdo rje rgyal po yang yun ring mdzad pa sogs mi nyag gi yul gru kun la phrin las rgya cher bskyangs/ dus 'gyur gyi zing 'khrugs skabs brdung brdegs ci rig myong yang sku sha che grags pa dang snyun pa'i tshul gyis bsgyur bkod ngal rtsol gyi las kar zhugs ma dgos pas bsnyen sgrub 'ba' zhig la brtson/ dgung grangs re gcig par a paṃ gter ston gyi gter lung las/ drug bcu'i yar lag rdo rje'i phung po 'jig: shwam bha la ru chos kyi 'khor lo bskoroḥ skye ba gsum nas gu ru'i thugs kar 'pho: 'brel tshad thar ba'i lam sna zin par 'gyur: sogs lung bstan dang mthun par bsnyun khams 'khrugs pa'i gzhan rkyen la bsten nas 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi gzhi klong nang dbyings gdod ma'i lhums su re zhig gzims pa'i tshul mdzad nas gdung dang ring bsrel sogs rgyud sde nas gsung ba'i grol rtags dang bcas tha ma'i mdzad pas kyang sems can rnams kyi don rgya chen byas pa'o/ /142

gdan rabs nyi shu pa mchog sprul pad+ma bstan 'dzin/mchog sprul sku 'phreng gnyis pa pad+ma bstan 'dzin ni rje gong ma'i 'da' kha'i zhal chems bzhin khams mi nyag lha sgang ring mo'i g.yas zhol/ shing nyag ru khag bya ba'i 'brog sde zhig tu rdzogs sprul lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje dang / sngags 'chang dri med 'od zer zung gis bslu med rdo rje'i bka' lung gcig tu mthun pas 'khrungs yul dang yab yum gyi mtshan sogs tshig gcig gi 'gal ba med par rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa yab ka ri nyi ma phrin las dang yum mu ra zla ba sgron ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu bya spyi lo 1933lor mtshan dpe'i 'dzum zhal gsar ba mi yul du bzhad pa na byis pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rtags ltas ngo mtshar can mang du byung / de nas dgung grangs gsum bzhes pa shing phag lo'i dbyar zla ra ba'i yar tshes bzang po gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa bkra shis pa'i nyin mor/ ra this phyogs su chib kha bsgyur zhing rim par ra this dbyar gnas mar 143

thang du rgyal 'phags ri khrod sprul sku chos nyid/ la 'ur thang gi mchog sprul sgra gcan/ nyi 'od dgon gyi dung lung sprul sku/ gser kha a bdud/— rang dgon gyi mkhan rgan bsod grags/ mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis/ stong dpon sprul sku smin grol sogs skyes bu dam pa mang po'i dbus su mngon par bstod cing phyogs 'dus ser skya yongs kyis lha mi'i dpal gyi 'byor ba blo'i ra ba las 'das pa'i mchod sprin dang bcas khri phangs mthon por mnga' gsol/ ri khrod sprul sku chos nyid kyi dbus bla sprul rnams kyis tshe chog dang 'brel zhabs brtan legs 'bul spros pa dang / mkhan sprul bla 'tshabs rnams kyis ngo mtshar ba'i 'bel gtam sna tshogs dang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bul nod gya nom pa bcas dga' spro'i ston mo bkra shis lha rgyal gyis mtha' brgyan/ de nas dgung grangs drug tu bzhes skabs rab byung bcu drug pa sa stag lor thugs dgyes pas dgon pa bzhengs dgos gsungs pas mi kun ngo mtshar ba'i dad pa dang bcas yang dgon bsam gtan gling slar gso byas/ mkhan rgan bsod nams grags pa yong 'dzin du bskos 144

pa las klog bslab pas zhal 'don las chog phyag len dang bcas pa brda bstan ba tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen cing skye bo kun gyis bstod bsngags mdzad/ zhar la rgyal sras lag len/ spyod 'jug sdom gsum bcas la gsan bsam mdzad pas shes rab che ba'i tshad du gyur/ dgung grangs bcu bzhes skabs bum sgrub chen mo'i rdo rje rgyal bo mdzad pa dang / smin grol gyi las rim dag la chags thogs dang bral/ de nas dgung grangs bcu drug bzhes pa sa byi lo ste dus 'gyur gyi zing 'khrugs lang la nye skabs gdul 'gro'i bsod nams dman pas bar chad dam grib ngan pa'i gzhan rkyen la bsten nas cung zad snyun pa'i tshul gyis nyin gcig sku drang por bsrang phaṭa ces lan gsum brjod bzhin gzhi dbyings ka dag gi klong du re zhig gzims pa'i tshul mdzad do/ /gdan rabs nyer gcig pa mchog sprul 'gyur med rgyal mtshan/mchog sprul 'jam dpal rin po che'i sku 'phreng gsum pa 145

'gyur med rgyal mtshan ni/ rdzogs sprul drug pa 'jigs bral byang chub rdo rje dang / khang gdong 'gyur med rdo rje/ rdzogs sprul dri med rin po che bcas kyis brda lung gcig tu mthun pas gnas dang rus yab yum sogs gsal bor bstan pa ltar/ khams mi nyag ra ba sgang gi sa'i char gtogs/ sngon mi nyag gi rgyal bo 'ga' zhig dang lcags la rgyal po rim byon gyi gdan sa/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i gnas/ lo chen bai ro tsa na dang / karma pa sku 'phreng rim byon/mkhas pa mi drug rgyal dbang lnga ba sogs dang /nyi ma grags pa/mdo mkhyen brtse sogs kyis zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi thig le/ gzhi yi bdag po lha mo rtse lnga zhes tshe ring mched lngas rtag tu srung ba'i gnas mchog dge bcu'i mnga' thang rab tu dar ba'i grong khyer chen po mi nyag dar rtse mdo ru/ wa su skyabs pa tshang zhes chos rgyal lcags la tshang dang gnyen 'brel zab pa'i dpon khyim zhig tu/ de yang mdo mkhyen brtse'i gsang rnam las/ lcags la wa su skyabs khyim na bzhugs skabs shig la sras po po ye shes la stag gi khri mthon po brgyab nas 146

der sdod gsungs pas/ khong khri steng du 'dug ma phod nas khri'i rtsar bzhugs tshe bu mo chung chung lo lnga lon pa zhig yod pa des nga 'dug zer nas khri steng du bsdad pas/ skyabs rje nas/ 'o bzang bzang bu 'di 'dug nus na pha brgyud jukyi byang chub sems dpa' brgya byon/ da ma brgyud la byang chub sems dpa' lnga bcu las mi 'byung gsungs lung bstan to/ /zhes lung bstan las 'byung ba ltar yum wa se skyabs pa po po rdo rje dang / yab kha bo'i rgyal sras skal bzang gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa sa glang spyi lo (1949)lor ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ltas dang bcas sku bltams/ sku nyid kyi zhang po ri khud sprul sku chos kyi 'od zer gyis gtsug phud bzhes pa'i mtshan 'gyur med rgyal mtshan gsol/ nga'i tsha bo 'brog phrug yin skye ba mi 'dra bas gtsang sbra legs po gyis zhes gsungs/dgung lo lnga tsam na ra this dgon gyis sprul sku btsal 'tshol byas pas lung bstan dang mthun par mjal skabs khong gis 'dzum pa dang bcas dgyes tshor gyis sngon gnas dran pa'i rnam pa bstan pas thams cad yid ches/ sku gsung thugs rten dang na bza' cha 147

tshang mjal dar bcas phul nas mi ring rang dgon du khri 'don mnga' gsol gyi gros thag bcad/ 'on kyang dus 'gyur ngan pa'i mun nag du tshud nas khri 'don dang slob sbyong gi go skabs ma byung bar ma zad mi lo nyi shu lhag gi ring 'o brgyal chen po byung / slar yang rgyal bstan yang dar gyi nyi gzhon shar ri'i phrag tu bzhad pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing byi spyi lo (1983)lor ra this dgon yul gnyis kyis bsu ma chen pos mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol gyi mdzad sgo rgya chen spel/mchog sprul gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma rin po che rigs kyi bdag por bkur nas sngon 'gro blo sbyang gi rim pa dang / khrid yig ye shes bla ma sogs la gsan bsam mdzad/ bstan pa slar gso'i gros 'tshogs byas nas dgon pa bskyar bzhengs kyi thugs thag bcad/ lhag bsam dag pas shing cha phal cher sku nyid kyis gnang sbyin mdzad cing skyel 'gren byed nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing glang lor sngar rma ston gyi gdan sa dngos mar rten dang brten pa'i lha khang legs par bzhengs pa dang / gu ru'i zhal thang chen mo/148

rin chen dang po'i rgya gling / rgya nag grub mtshes gral gdan sogs phyi nang gi mthun rkyen sna tshogs pas sri zhu zla dang bral ba'i thugs bskyed kyis bstan dang 'gro la phan bde rgya chen bskrun bzhin 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa gang gi zhabs pad rdo rje'i khams su brtan cing thugs kyi bzhed pa mtha' dag gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub par rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas mthun 'gyur mdzod cig ces smon pa'o/ /rgyal kun mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od zer 'bum/ / gcig tu bzlum pa rat+na mañju zung / /rgyal bstan mkha' lam yangs por nyi zla bzhin/ /'gro ba'i nang gi mun sel gang de dran/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin sur+sā kirti yi/ /gsung gi rnam rol dz+nyā na mañju shri/ /snyig ma'i smag na thub bstan sgron me mchog /bka' drin zla bral gang khyed bstod pa'i yul/ /149

khams kyi rā tī dga' ldan chos gling gi /mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i rin chen khrir//mkhas grub rat+na'i phung po mngon spung ba'i/ /dge mtshan gzi 'od phyogs dus kun tu khyab/ /de ltar ston dang bstan pa rin chen gter/ /ma lus skye rgu'i bde ba 'byung ba'i gnas/ /longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang 'das pa'i ro/ /myong ba'i mod la dran pa'i mchi ma dku/ /gang gi thugs bskyed sprin gyi 'dab ma yis /gdul bya'i 'gro khams zhing sa gshin po ru/ /dri bral dge ba'i pad+ma 'bum bzhad pa'i/ /gzhal med bka' drin dran pa'i bsnyel gso yin/ /ji srid 'gro ba'i khams 'di ma stong par/ /gang gi thugs bskyed nyi zla 'bar ba'i gzis/ /rmongs sdug mun pa'i gdung ba rab zhi zhing / /150

bstan pa mi nyams rab tu dar gyur cig / mkhan rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar bsdus pa nor bu rin chen lta bu'i skabs te lnga pa/de yang slob dpon dbyig gnyen pos/ ston pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /der 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa ni lung dang rtogs pa'i chos gnyis su 'du la/ rjod byed lung gi chos rnams thos bsam gyis gtan la phab/ thos don brjod bya'i rim pa rnams sgom sgrub kyis nyams su bzhes nas zhi ba byang chub chen po'i go 'phang la dbang bsgyur dgos pa yin te/ ji skad du/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khrid cing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spo min pas/ /chos nyid zhi ba bstan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /gsungs pa bzhin srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir 'phyan pa'i 'gro ba rang 151

byas las kyi sdug bsngal drag po myong ba dag gzhan dag lta ci/ thub dbang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyag gis kyang sel bar mi nus na/ 'o na thabs gang zhe na 'dren pa'i ded dpon mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag gis chos nyid zhi ba chen po'i don phyin ci ma log pa ste/ lung sde snod gsum la 'chad nyan dang / lam bslab pa gsum la nyams len gyi bsgo skal bzang po bstsal bas grol bar 'gyur bas rtsa ba'i bla ma dag la/ yon tan sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam na yang / /bka' drin sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa'i mgon/ /zhes kun gyis bstod pa brjod bzhin yod pa de ltar bstod pa don dang mthun pa'i rang cag gi me tog phog pa'i lha skal bka' drin mtshungs zla ma mchis pa mkhan rabs nor bu'i phreng ba tshal du dngar ba 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar mthong thos rag tsam gleng na/ ra this dgon 'dir bstan pa snga dar phyi dar gnyis yod pa'i dbang du byas nas snga dar gyi skabs su thams cad gzigs pa chen po mkhan chen rat+na bha dra dang mkhan po shākya dpal/ye shes rdo rje/ shes rab dpal/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ seng ge 152

dpal/ rin chen legs pa bcas kyi rnam thar phyogs tsam re bris zin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ 'dir ra this pa'i mkhan po'i thugs 'gan yun ring bzhes myong ba'i bzhag bla kun dga' dpal ni/ karma sku phreng bdun pa las chos dang gdams ngag thams cad gsan te mkhas grub chen por gyur/ mi nyag mkhas pa mi lnga'i nang tshan byams gsar ba'i skye ba yin pa'i sngon gnas gsal bar dran nas yid ches pa'i nges pa du ma bskyed/ rab sgang du pheb nas yul sde'i 'khrug pa rnams bsdums/ chos sde nyam pa rnams gsos/ ra this dgon du 'chad nyan yun ring spel nas skye bo thams cad dad par byas pas/ shin tu ho'i rgyal bo dang dar mdo'i mi chen khag rgya'i blon po 'ga' dang bcas pas bsnyen bkur rgya chen bgyis pa sogs mdo khams su phrin las chen po spel ba zhig go /gzhan yang mkhan po tshul khrims bzang po/ smon lam dpal/ yon tan dpal/ lung rigs rgya mtsho/ byang chub bzang po/yang dgon pa sogs mkhan rabs shin tu mang po zhig yod na'ang /dus kyis bskal zhing rin thang ldan pa'i lo rgyus dag god chag 153

shor ba'i rkyen kyis rnam thar phar zhog mtshan tsam yang ma shes pa mang bas bya thabs bral/ da ni phyi dar ra this dgon gyi mkhan rabs cung tsam 'bri ba la/ mchog sprul 'jam dpal ye shes rin po che mchog gi bka' drin dang rdzogs sprul lnga ba rin po che'i thugs bskyed kyis grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i phyag len dang mthun par dbyar gnas dang 'chad nyan gyi skal ba bzang po'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba'o/mkhan sprul dngos grub rin po che/rgyal 'phags sprul sku dngos grub rin po che ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i smad tsam la rta 'ur sku 'khrungs/ sku na phra ba'i dus nas kyang dad brtson dran pa ting 'dzin shes rab sogs sa thob sems dpa' chen po'i mngon rtogs rang chas su mnga'/ 'bri klog brda dag sogs phyogs tsam bstan ba tsam gyis khong du chub cing rgyal 'phags bkra shis chos gling dgon du khri 'don mnga' gsol mdzad/'khor ba la nges par 'byung bas so sor thar ba dge tshul gyi sdom 154

pa bzhes nas yon tan kun gyi gzhi rtsa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po ches thugs rgyud phyug par mdzad/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos par spyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis bdag gir bzhes pas gnas brtan nye ba 'khor dang mi gnyis pa lta bur gyur/ dgung grangs bcu dgu yas mas su mi nyag kun bsod sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dag bsam sbyor dag pas tshul bzhin bsnyen nas thun mong dang thun min gyi gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/ rje 'di ni mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod/rtogs pa'i yon tan/btsun pa'i spyod pa rnams sgo kun nas 'dran pa'i zla deng bral bas don la gnas pa'i bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor yul du gyur/ chos phyir dka' spyad kyi bzod pa lhur blangs pas ris su ma chad pa'i skyes chen dag las rdzogs chen rgyud lung man ngag gi smin grol dbang khrid kyi gdams pa yongs rdzogs thugs nyams su bzhes shing theg rtse rdzogs chen gyi lta ba'i gdengs tshad mngon du byas/ sku tshe hril por dad 'bul gyi dngos rdzas ci yod ra this dgon gyi dbyar gnas kyi thebs rtsar phul/ mchog 155

sprul 'jam dpal rin po ches ra this bstan pa phyi dar gyi mkhan chen khri thog dang po'i bzhugs khrir mnga' gsol mdzad pas dbyar gnas mkhan po'i thugs 'gan yun ring bzhes shing bla grwa yongs la spyod 'jug dang sdom gsum sogs kyi bshad khrid rgya cher gnang / dad ldan mi skya'i tshogs la'ang skyabs sems kyi sdom lung dang / ma ṇi dang sirnyi dung sgrub/ kun bzang bla ma/ tshe thar dang srog bslu phan yon bcas kyi dge bskul gnang nas dam pa chos kyis rgyud smin par byas/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i smad tsam la zhing gzhan du re zhig zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /rje 'di nyid kyi rnam thar yig tshogs shin tu dkon pas gsal bor 'god thabs bral/gser kha'i mkhan po ye shes/mkhan rabs gnyis pa gser kha ye shes ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i stod tsam la mi nyag gi yul du gter ston mang du byon pa'i rigs rus gtsang ma gser kha tshang du mtshan dpe'i me tog bzhad 156

pa na ma yum gyi rmi ltas su gser gyi rdo rje dar tshon gyis brgyan pa zhig rnyed par rmis pa dang / sku 'khrungs tshe dgun grang ba'i sgang yin yang char bab pa dang 'brug sgra grags pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i rtags mtshan shin tu mang / dgung grangs bdun tsam nas klog bslab pas sngon gyi bag chagag sad pas tshegs med du mkhyen/mkhan slob grangs tshang ba'i mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi dngos po bzhes/ mi nyag kun bsod sogs kyi mdun nas mdo rgyud rgya mtshor gsan sbyong yun ring byas/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ spyod 'jugamangon rtogs rgyan sogs rtsa ba mang po thugs 'dzin mdzad par grags/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i snyan pa'i grags pas khyab pa byung zhing ra this dgon kyi mkhan po mdzad nas sdom gsum dang spyod 'jug gsang snying sogs chos kyi bdud rtsi rgya cher brtsal/ skya ser mi dmangs la'ang bde chen zhing bkod dang 'pho khrid sogs gsungs te mdor na las dang skal ba ldan pa'i gzhi byes so so nas phebs pa'i zhal slob dag la smin grol gyi chos 'khor dpag tu med pa bskor/ mthar gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la 157

bskul ba'i slad du thun mong gi ngor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan to/ / mkhan po rig 'dzin rdo rje/'jam mgon mi pham rin po che dang gto ru skal ldan rgya mtsho gnyis kyi zhal slob mkhas grub rig 'dzin rdo rje ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i stod du la 'ur thang gsha' nang tshang zhes pa'i bskyed khyim du sku 'khrungs/ nar son tshe rdzogs chen dgon du grwa sar phebs/'ju mi pham dang gto ru skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs thun min gyi bla mar bsten nas thun mong dang thun min gyi gtsug lag yongs la gsan bsam bsgoms pas zhun thar bcad te lnga zung shes bya rgya mtshor mkhyen rab kyi rtsal rgyas/ rim gnyis rnal 'byor gyi gdams pa dkyil 'khor gyi bca' shom 'bud rdung dkrol gsum sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag bzhes che phra kun la mkhas pa'i tshad du grags/gzhug mar ra this dgon gyi cho ga'i phyag len mtha' dag rje 'di nyid kyis bris pa'i zin bris dag la phug bcol bar byed pa byung /158

mchog sprul 'jam dpal rin po che'i bkas bskul ba ltar ra this dgon gyi mkhan rabs gsum pa'i chos khrir 'khod/ rje 'di nyid mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam par thar bas thugs rgyud phyug cing dam pa'i mdzad bzang 'gran zla bral bas mjal ba tsam gyis dang ba 'dren/ rtsa ba'i gdan sa la 'ur dgon dang ra thi'i dgon gnyis kyi gzhi gsum cho ga'i phyag bzhes dar spel byas/ brgyud 'dzin gyi slob bu dag la bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar ba'i sdom rgyun spel ba sogs bstan 'gro'i mdzad pa rgya che/ rje 'di nyid kyi ljags rtsom skor zin bris dang 'grel ba bstod tshogs sogs mang yang phal cher zhig ni nga dgu lo'i zing 'khrugs skabs brlags shor bas da lta glog zhags ma'i 'grel ba dang zin bris 'ga' dang bstod tshogs sogs nyung shas bzhugs pa'o/ /de ltar mkhas pa'i tshul dgu'i mngon par mdzes pa'i rje 'di dgung grangs re bzhi par re zhig zhing gzhan du gshegs tshul bstan to/ /159

mkhan po rig 'dzin dbang ldan/mkhan rabs bzhi ba rig 'dzin dbang ldan mchog ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i stod tsam la yab khyung thar rgyal dang yum kun bzang sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su mi nyag rab sgang gi sa'i char/ stag 'dra la thog ces pa'i ne'u gseng du sku 'khrungs/ dgung grangs brgyad par klog bslab pas 'go smos pa tsam gyi thogs med du mkhyen par grags/ sku nar son pa na grub dbang rdzogs chen dgon du phebs pas mkhan chen gzhan dga' rin po che dang mjal bas gtsug phud phul/ bla mas kyang thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung te chos bka' ci rigs pa bstsal/ bya bral kun dga' dpal ldan gyi mdun nas snying thig ma bu/ ye shes bla ma sogs kyang gsan nas lo drug gi ring la na bza' hral bo dang gsol chas skya bo byas te dka' spyad bdag gir bzhes/ thugs rgyud zhi zhing dul bas rtag tu dman sa bzung zhing gnas brtan rgan po lta bur bag yod kyi spyod pa 'ba' zhig lhur blangs pa las ma brtags pa'i rgyug 160

mchong sogs mi srid cing btsun pa'i yon tan la dbang 'byor/gzhan yang skabs skabs su dpa' bo mkha' 'gros zhal gzigs sogs byung skad/ dgung grangs so lnga par rang dgon gyi mkhan rabs bzhi ba'i chos khrir 'khod/ lo ltar dbyar gnas kyi skabs sdom gsum dang / sa ga zla bar skya ser kun la sngon 'gro'i khrid yig kun bzang bla ma sogs ljags khrid gnang ba las rgyun par rang dgon dang mchod rten dben lung sogs su bcad rgya byas te sgrub la gzhol/ mthar sku zhi bar gshegs rjes dgung zhag rdzogs pa na rdzogs sprul lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rjer dgongs brtags zhus pas rdzogs sprul lnga pa rin po ches zangs mdog dpal rir phebs song gsungs/ rje 'di nyid kyi sku tshe hril por bcad rgya byas nas bzhugs pa las slob tshogs skyong ba dang rten gsum bzhengs bskrun sogs ni cher ma byung /mkhan po lung rtogs 'od gsal/mkhan rabs lnga ba lung rtogs 'od gsal lam rtogs ldan 161
