shing thar tshe ring ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i stod tsam du khams mi nyag gi sa yi cha ru mtshan dpe'i lang tsho bzhad/ sku na gzhon pa'i dus nas kyang byams dang snying rje zhi dul bag yod kyi spyod pa rang chas su mnga'/ yab las klog bslab/ rang dgon du tshogs zhugs byas/ rnying ma'i chos spyod skor thugs 'dzin gnang / gnas nang mchog sprul tshul blo'i drung nas rab tu byung / rdzogs chen shrī seng du lo bzhi'i ring la brtson pa rdo rus su mdzad/ khang gdung mgon dbang las kyang chos bka' mang du gsan/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag a 'dzom 'brug rgan 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje thun min gyi bla mar bsnyen pas dbang khrid yongs rdzogs brtsal nas nyams rtogs gong du 'phel/ rang yul gyi sgrub gnas dag las lhag lha rab 'byams kyi bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol bar byas te sku mtshams su bzhugs/ rang dgon mkhan khrir phebs nas gzhi gsum cho ga'i phyag bzhes rdzogs chen ji bzhin ma nyams par spel/ hrī: lung dgon gyi bstan bdag kyang byas/ mi nyag gi yul gru stod smad kun gyi 'khon pa ci rigs pa bsdum/ sku tshe'i smad du phyogs 'dus kyi 162

slob bu dag la chos ci rigs brtsal nas snyigs mar gyur pa'i rgyal bstan gyi me ro bslangs pa sogs bka' drin 'gran zla dang bral/dgung grangs don gcig par rang dgon dang hri:lung dgon gyi 'dus sde yongs la bstan rgyun skyong tshul sogs zhal bsgos gsung gi tha ma bstsal nas bstan 'gro mtha' rgyas su sku gshegs so/ /mkhan po thub bstan rin chen bzang po/mkhan chen thub bstan rin chen bzang po'am gzhubs zur bsod nams bkra shis ni/ rma ston rin chen bzang po'i rnam rol du rdzogs sprul lnga bas ngos bzung / mkhan chen bsod nam chos 'phel gyi slob ma mchog tu bsngags pa sogs gdan rabs skabs su rnam thar rgyas pa bris zin pas slar zlos par dogs nas der gzigs par zhu zhes smras pa'o/ / mkhan po bsod nams grags pa/mkhan rabs bdun pa rngon pa mkhan chen bsod nams 163

grags pa ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu pho rta'i lo ste spyi lo 1882lor rngon pa tshang zhes pa'i 'brog khyim phal pa zhig tu sku 'khrungs pa ni/rgya cher rol pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rigs dman pa gdol pa'am/ smyig ma mkhan nam g.yung rigs sam shing rta mkhan gyi rigs su'ang bsam bzhin du srid par 'jug go zhes par ltar/ yab nam lo dang yum zon thar gnyis kyi sras su thugs bskyed smon lam btsan po'i dbang las yum la zug zer med cing kha ba'i me tog gis sa gzhi dkar 'jam yug gcig tu brdal ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/chung ngu'i dus nas yab 'das pas yum sras gnyis pos dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba myong zhing / rje nyid dgung grangs bdun tsam nas klog bslab mkhan med kyang / rang sbyong gis nyin rtag par bza' btung yang mi dran par klog 'don byas pas klog mthar phyin/rang dgon du tshogs la zhugs nas gar thig gdangs dbyangs la mkhas par sbyangs/ de nas mchog sprul 'jam dpal rin po che thengs gnyis pa rdzogs chen du byon skabs de dang lhan du grwa sar 164

phebs/ zhe chen rab 'byams 'gyur med kun bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la las kyi bla ma su yin gyi lung bstan zhus pas rgya kong gzhan dga' rin po cher bsten na legs tshul gyi lung bstan gnang bzhin mkhan chen gzhan dga' mnyes pa gsum gyi bla mar bsnyen nas thun mong dang thun min gyi bslab bya'i gnas la brtson pa drag pos gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad te mtshan thag thog tu zla 'od dang shing khra ma'i me thur sogs la brten nas rdo rus thug pas dka' spyad srog dang bsdos nas nyams len mthar chags su byas pas thugs zin gyi slob chen du gyur/ gzhan yang mi ra bde chen bzang po/ 'jam mgon mi pham pa/ thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje/rdzogs chen mkhan rgan bsod chos sogs kyi mdun nas/ dbu phar 'dul mngon sogs mtshan nyid theg pa'i skor dang / rgyud bcu bdun dang rong klong rnam gnyis kyi gsung sogs rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud lung man ngag gi chos tshul snyan brgyud dmar khrid dang bcas pa ste mdor na mdo sngags rgya mtsho lta bur gsan bsam sgom pa'i mtha' rgya bcad pas mkhas grub kyi rtse mor son/ rje 'di bas so 165

sor thar ba'i spang bkag gi gnas rnams rtag tu mig 'bras bzhin bsrungs pas btsun pa'i tshad du grags shing / shrī seng chos grwa'i gnas brtan yang lo du mar mdzad/ mkhan chen gzhan dga'i nye gnas pa mdzad de bzhugs skabs/ thengs cig gzim lam du shar phyogs nas sprin dkar lang long du 'phyur ba'i gseb nas rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams kyis zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas brda chos du ma gnang ba zhig byung bas/de'i tshul rtsa ba'i bla ma gzhan dga' rin po cher zhus pas/ kun mkhyen chen pos ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung ba yin pas shin tu legs gsungs te lha ris pa bsags nas gzim lam ji bzhin bris shing / gzhan dga' rin po ches rab gnas mdzad pa'i klong chen pa'i zhal thang da lta'ang mjal du yod/ khong gis bla ma yang tig gi phyag dpe dang zhal thang 'di gnyis rgyun tu 'bral mi phod pa'i rtsa chen du brtsi/dgung grangs so brgyad tsam nas rā tī rang dgon gyi mkhan khrir mnga' gsol bas gzhi gsum cho ga'i phyag rgyun rdzogs chen ji bzhin mi nyams par spel ba sogs gzhan don 'phrin las kyi 166

'jug pa rgya cher bskyang / rgyun du 'chang bar 'os pa'i chos gos rnam gsum dang / shes rab kyi rten phyag dpe nyung du tsam las gzhan dngos po ci yang med par kun btang bya bral kyi spyod pa lhur bzhes nas rā tī yang dgon dang chu med dben lung sogs dben pa'i ri la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams bzhes kho na mdzad nas gtan bzhugs gnang bas 'bras bu'i drod tshad mthon po brnyes/ thun mtshams rnams su phyogs 'dus kyi slob tshogs rnams la gzhung chen bcu gsum dang kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gsung rabs gtso bor gyur ba'i man ngag sogs bshad khrid bstsal bas zhal slob kyi gtso bo seṅge dgon gyi mkhan chen rgya ru chos rje dang / mdo mang bla ma/ ra this mkhan po nam kho/ rtsa ra dpal bzang / sprul sku pad+ma/ sprul sku smin grol sogs rgyal bstan bshad sgrub kyis spel ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mang po byon/ de ltar don gnyis lhun grub kyi sa la phyin nas 'od gsal gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdu ba'i tshul mdzad do//167

mkhan po smin grol rgya mtsho/rig 'dzin smin grol rgya mtsho mchog ni/ 'jam sprul tshe dbang rdo rje'i yang srid du rdzogs sprul thub bstan chos kyi rdo rjes ngos bzung / mkhan bsod bkra dang a bu lha sgong sogs kyi zhal slob tu gyur tshul bcas gong gi gdan rabs skabs su smras pa de'o/ /mkhan po skal bzang rnam 'phel/thun min rigs bdag bla ma skal bzang rnam 'phel mchog ni/rab byung bco lnga ba'i me sbrul lo ste spyi lo 1917lor me nyag ra ba sgang gi sa'i char 'bo nye lung ba zhes par yab mkhan chen bsod grags kyi sku mched rngon pa bsod chos dang / yum stong bza' chos sgron gnyis kyi sras su ya mtshan pa'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs/sku nar son skabs khu bo mkhan rgan bsod grags kyi drung nas 'bri klog dang brda dag bslab pas yun ring po'i ngal ba la ma ltos par thugs su chub pa byung / de nas ra this yang dgon dang chu med dben lung sogs su bī ma'i rnam 'phrul ra this mkhan chen 168

thub bstan rin chen bzang po dang mkhan rgan bsod grags gnyis kyi mdun nas rgyal sras lag len/ spyod 'jug kā ri kā lnga bcu ba/ sdom gsum rnam nges/ mdo rtsa/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs dbu ma'i skor dang / byams chos sde lnga/ klong chen mdzod bdun/ rgyud gsang snying sogs la lo du ma'i ring lan gcig min par yang yang gsan sbyang mdzad/ nyin zhig rang khyim du phebs pa'i lam bar du grub thob ye shes dbyangs 'phel dang mjal bas grub chen gyis rin po che phebs sam nor bu bzang po phebs sam gsungs nas tshong dpon nor bu bzang po'i skye srid du ngos bzung / dgung grangs bcu dgu bzhes skabs dgon gyi mkhan sprul rnasdas kyis bkas bskul bzhin yab mes gong ma dag gi bsti gnas mdo khams rdzogs chen du grwa sar phebs te mkhan chen pad+ma theg mchog blo ldan nam a bu lha sgong rin po che'i zhabs pad mnyes pa gsum gyis bsnyen nas gzhung chen bcu gsum gtso bor gyur ba'i rgya bod kyi gzhung so sor sbyang brtson drag pos thos bsam gyi mtha' rgya chod pa byas nas da dung rang lugs kun mkhyen yab 169

sras kyi gzhung man ngag zab mo'i drod rlangs ma yal ba dag la gsan bsam dpyis phyin pa mdzad nas yun ring sdod ri'achar gnang skabs/ bsnyun khams drag po zhig bzhes pas bla mas re zhig pha yul la phebs dang mi ring bar mjal nges shing de dus nga'i rgyud na ci yod po khyod rang la ster chog gsungs pas rang yul du phyir phebs/ bsnyun khams la sman dpyad gnang nas cung dwangs skabs khu bo mkhan rgan bsod grags rin bo ches ma hā skyid lung dgon na grub brnyes kyi rig 'dzin chen po gzan dkar ba bzhugs yod pas re zhig der song dang nad dwangs skabs rdzogs chen la 'gro chog gsung pas de bzhin ma hā skyid lung dgon du phebs/ a mdo gzan dkar bya bral chos kyi seṅge'i mdun nas zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang du gsan/ mthar rang yul du chas pa'i zhog par bla mas mdun du bos nas thugs brtse bas zhal ta bslab bya bzang po dang dbu skra na bza' sogs ci dgos rten skal du gnang mthar chang gsol thod gang gnang nas 'di 'thung thub na bu yin gsungs/ bka' bzhin btung bas bla ma'i zhal nas 170

rgyal ba klong chen pa'i dgongs pa 'pho bar gyur cig ces lan gsum du gsungs pas thugs yid dbyer med 'dris nas thugs sras bu chen du gyur/ de nas bsnyun khams yang gzhi nas dwangs song bas yang bskyar rdzogs chen du phebs shing yab chen ngag dbang nor bu'i drung nas/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi ljags lung /yon tan mdzod kyi bshad khrid/ snying thig ya bzhi/ dum gnyis sogs gsan/ yongs 'dzin mkhan chen 'jigs med yon tan mgon po las 'dzin grol gyi dbang / zab mo lta ba'i lugs kyi byang chub sems sdom sogs zhus/ thun min rigs kyi bdag po a bu lha sgang rin po che'i mdun nas sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa yongs rdzogs mnos shing /klong chen mdzod bdun/ khrid yig ye shes bla ma sogs dang khyad par bla ma yang tig gi ljags khrid rje 'di ba dang sprul sku smin grol gnyis la chig brgyud du brtsal nas mjug rdzogs skabs phyag dpe'ang khong la gnang ste ngas 'di la lan brgya tsam bltas pa yin da khyed kyis thugs dam gyi rten mdzod cig ang gsung nas bla slob dgong pa gcig tu gyur/ phyis rang yul du 171

bzhugs skabs rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo dpe gzigs dang bcas tshar gcig ljags klog gnang ba sogs yun ring dpe mtshams la bzhugs pa dang gnub chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sgrub gnas dang / shug lung / chu med dben lung / yang dben bsam gtan gling rnams su lhag lha rab 'byams kyi bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol ba byas shing / rtag tu 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po thugs nyams su bzhes/ rang dgon du rgyal sras lag len/ spyod 'jug rtsa 'grel/ khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung / bar do drug khrid/chos dbyings mdzod/ sdom gsum rnam nges/ 'pho khrid sogs lan gcig min par slob ma'i rgyud tshod dang mthun par yang yang bka' drin zla dang bral ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba kho bo cag gi'ang skal bzang nyams su myong / hrīḥlung dgon dang rdo rwa dkar mo sogs spyir mi nyag gi yul gru kun la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / bde chen zhing sgrub bsnyen gnas kyi sdom lung / ma ṇi dung sgrub bcas kyi chos sbyin phyogs med bstsal/ rā tī rang dgon gyi sid+dhi sgrub mchod chen mo dang dbyar gnas zhing sgrub sogs 172

'tshogs pa yongs kyi dbu bzhugs mdzad cing spyi khyab bstan pa'i gtso 'gan yun ring bzhes/ mthar dgung grangs don gnyis bzhes pa rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags rta lor sku cung zad snyun ba'i tshul gyis gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig chos dbyings su yib/nyin bdun par gser kha sprul sku skal bzang dar rgyas phebs pa na thugs ka'i drod ma yal bar sku tshug seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis bzhugs par thugs dam bzhengs bskul gsungs pas 'ja' dang dri bzang gis khyab pa kun la mthun snang du byung / de nas lha sgang khri ba bla ma don 'grub dang rang dgon mkhan po nor 'phel sogs kyis pur sbyangs mdzad/ nyin de'i nub mor kha ba babs pa'i steng du ring bsrel sna tshogs dang kha ba dmar po'i me tog 'dab ma brgyad pa che chung sen mo tsam pa mang pos bkab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtag ltas sna tshogs byung ba'o/ /mkhan po dge 'dun bzang po/ /rdzogs chen mkhan rgan ngag dbang nor bu rin po che dang / ra 173

this mkhan chen thub bstan rin chen bzang po rnam gnyis kyi thugs sras mkhas grub dge 'dun bzang po ni/ spyi lo rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu khyi lor yab rtswa ra kun bzang dang / yum rag za a rdor gnyis kyi sras su gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sgrub gnas dang / 'bum pa'i rgya tsha'i sgrub gnas kyi nye zhol du mtshan dpe'i me tog bzhad/ khu bo bla ma 'jigs med kyi drung nas 'bri klog bslab pa na/ skyes thob kyi shes rab 'gran zla dang bral bas yi ge 'bri klog sogs dka' tshag med par mkhyen/ dgung grangs bcu drug par rang dgon gyi mkhan chen thub bstan rin chen bzang bo las rab tu byung / rgyal sras lag len/ kā ri kā lnga bcu pa/ spyod 'jug sdom gsum rnam nges/ khrid yig kun bzang bla ma sogs la thos bsam phran bu re byas skabs btsun chung gzhan dag las khyad du 'phags pa byung / dgung grangs nyer lnga par mkhas mchog thub bstan rin chen bzang po'i bkas bskul ltar ru dam rdzogs chen du grwa sar phebs/ yab chen ngag dbang nor bu thun min gyi bla mar bsten pas gzhan las lhag pa'i thugs brtse bzang pos rjes su 174

bzung / shrī seng chos grwa'i yig cha gzhung chen bcu gsum gtso bor gyur ba'i rgya bod kyi gzhung ma lus par lan gcig min par yang dang yang du the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod pa byas/ zur du rdzogs chen mkhan thub bstan snyan grags kyi drung nas thun mong gi gtsug lag sgra snyan ngag rtsis sogs rig gnas kun la thogs med kyi mkhyen rab rgyas/ yongs 'dzin mkhan chen yon tan mgon bo las snying thig ya bzhi/ dum gnyis/ ye shes bla ma sogs rdzogs chen chos skor rnams mnog chos su thob/ de nas dgung grangs so gnyis par yab rje ngag dbang nor bu dpon slob lhan rgyas lha ldan phebs skabs rje 'di nyid bla ma ngag dbang nor bu'i drung na skyor dpon dang zhabs phyi'i rim gro gcig gcog gis khur yod stabs lhan tu khrid rgyu'i gnang ba thob nas mnyam du lha ldan mthil gyis gtsos dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i gnas chen khag la mchod mjal rgya chen mdzad de slar rdzogs chen du phebs/ thengs gcig chos rgyags kyi ched du 'dan khog du byon pa na/ a 'dzom 'brug sprul rin po che der byon/ khong rnam gnyis dbu ma'i skor gyi dri lan 'ga' byas 175

pas 'brug sprul pas lan theb dka' ba byung bas rjes mar rdzogs sprul rin po ches gsan nas thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad/ dgung grangs so bdun par rang dgon tu phebs de mkhan khrir 'khod kyang nga dgu lo'i dus kyi rlung mar drag po'i ru 'dzing stobs su bsdo ba'i skabs dang khel nas/ sku nyid la rdung brdeg dang rdab gsig mi nyung ba byung / nyin zhig chos bros su gshegs te/ skyes mchog 'jam grags kyi sgrub gnas su bcad rgya byas te bsnyen sgrub kyi las tshogs skor la sgrub pa nyams len byas nas zho phran bu res bza' btung gnyis ka'i go chod par byas te bzhugs/ mi nyag ri bo dgon dang sangs rgyas ye shes sgrub gnas/ khu bo ri khrod sogs su'ang bzhugs/ slar nas rgyal bstan yar dar gyi skabs su rang dgon du zhabs pad bkod de dbyar gnas mkhan po mdzad cing khrid lung gi bshad rgyun rgya cher spel/ khyad par grub brnyes kyi skyes bu chen po bla ma bsod nams bzang por khu bo ri khrod sogs gnas nges med du klong chen mdzod bdun dang ya bzhi sogs yun ring por bsnyel gso'i tshul du chig brgyud du ljags khrid gnang 176

bas bya btang ba chen po bla ma bsod nams bzang po'ang rje 'di nyid kyi zhal slob tu gyur/ gzhan yang bla ma rig 'dzin dang /dpal ldan ngag dbang / mchog sprul tshe dbang rnam grol sogs zhal slob mang tu byon cing phyis su rang dgon gyi grwa gzhon rnams la thugs brtse chen pos sngon 'gro dang blo sbyang sogs gsung ste bka' drin ci rig bstsal ba gus 'bangs kho bos kyang nyams su myong / rje 'di nyid 'pho ba la rang dbang thob pa'i tshad du grags shīng dgung grangs don lnga bar sku cung zad snyun skabs sman dpyad sogs byas pas snyun khams dwangs tshul mdzad nas zla ba gsum lhag la rang khyim du sku mtshams bcad rgya gnang / spyir khong gi nyin rer chos dbyings mdzod tshar re gtan nas chag ma myong la nyin gcig tshar bdun gsungs nas da de 'dra zhig gis chog rgyu red gsungs pa bzhin nyin bdun gyi nang mo tho rengs kyi dus sku tsha tshe 'phel la gding ba dang chos gos tshur zhogs da kho bo 'gro ran 'dug pas 'pho ba rnam grol myur lam gyi phyag dpe'ang phyes shig gsungs nas chos gos mnabs shing gding ba btang rjes sku drang 177

por bsrangs nas 'pho ba gsungs zin pa dang da red song tsha bo song dang chog gsungs nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdus skras//mkhan po nor bu bsam 'phel/mkhan rabs bcu gcig pa nor bu bsam 'phel ni/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i bgrang bya gnyis pa sa 'brug 1928lor gdan sa chen mo ra this dga' ldan gling du rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa yab gnub zur pad legs dang yum rgya mkhar a gsal gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ byis pa chung ngus dus nas mi dge ba'i las la 'dzem zhing kun spyod zhi zhing dul/ khu bo mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis kyi mdun nas yi ge 'bri klog dang kun bzang bla ma sogs blo sbyong skor dang gdam khrid mang po gsan zhing mkhan slob grangs tshang ba'i mdun nas rab tu byung / de nas khu bo'i bka' bzhin rdzogs chen du pheb cing bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus/ dam can sgang dang nags chung ri khrod sogs su yab rje ngag 178

dbang nor bu dang / rdzogs sprul drug pa/ mkhan po mgon ris/mkhan po thub snyan/ mkhon po nor g.yang / rdo grub rin po che sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i mdun nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad cing zhar la bka' gter gyi dbang lung du ma dang gtor ma'i bca' bsham 'don pa'i gdangs dbyangs sogs phyag len rnams kyang mkhas par sbyangs/ nga dgu'i dus 'gyur kyi dbang gis pha yul du mi log thabs med byung zhing 'o brgyal mang tsam myong / slar yang dus bzang gi skya rengs shar ba dang mnyam du shug lung ri khrod du lo 'khor bcu'i ring sku mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs/ de nas ra this 'bum rtse'i mgul brag dmar tshe chu phug tu sgrub pa kho nar brtson bzhin pa'i skabs shig rdzogs chen sprul sku skal dga' rin po che ra this dgon du gdan drangs pa mjal du phyin pa na/ mchog sprul rin po ches ldog tu med pa'i bka' lung gis rā tī dgon gyi mkhan por bskos pas dbyar dus su 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i mkhan po mdzad zhor gzhan chos 'dod rnams la kun bzang 179

bla ma sogs dang / grwa gzhon dag la gar thig dang mchod pa bca' bzo gdangs dbyangs 'bud srol sogs kyi bka' drin gnang ba dang / dgun dus brag dmar tshe chu phug tu sgrub pa nyams len la rtse gcig tu gzhol bzhin bzhugs pa gang nyid ni rang 'dod 'phregs po'i blo ngan tsam yang mi skyes zhing gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi 'dzum mdangs kyis skye bo thams cad dbang med dad pa'i gnas la 'god par mdzad pa mchog go /deng skabs mkhan tshe ring rdo rje'am thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis las thog mkhan po 'i thugs khur bzhes bzhin/ dri ma med pa'i lhag bsam gyis dus rabs kyi mdun lam dang srol rgyun gyi rig gzhung phyogs gang thad nas spobs sems chen pos skul 'ded byed bzhin pa'o/ /mi rtag g.yo ba srid pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /mi mthun las kyis rnam bkod rlabs 'phreng bzhin/ /mi dal bar med 'gran pa'i srog ldan khyu/ /mi ldog bde ba'i sbubs su thub pas drangs/ /180

mngon sum dngos gtso rig pa'i rnam dpyod dang / /mngon mtho tshangs dang lha yi mngon shes kyis/ /mngon par ma mthong yang dag zhi ba'i lam/ /mngon du ston pa thub pa nyid las su/ /des na thub pa'i bstan pa lung rtogs chos/ /'dzin dang spel ba'i mkhan rabs gser ri'i 'phreng //dri bral bslab gsum 'od kyis 'khor yug kun/ / zhi bde snang ba dkar pos khyab par byas/ /lung rig chu 'dzin dkrig pa'i thugs klong nas/ /brgal rtags rig pa glog gi zlos gar gyis//log rtog 'gong po'i klad rgya ral byas nas/ /ma nor thub pa'i lam bzang yangs par mdzad/ /sdom gsum gnang bkag gtsang ma'i ke ta kes/ /sgo gsum chu gter rab tu dwangs pa la/ /legs tshogs dpal gyi ngang mo rtag rtsen pa'i/ /181

mkhan rabs dam pa'i rjes dran ri mo spel/ /bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yang dag dam pa'i bshes kyis rjes bzung nas/ /gang gi yon tan dpal gyis mngon mdzes shing //rnam kun mkhyen pa'i gter la dbang bsgyur cig /skyes bu 'ga' zhig gi mdzad rnam zur du byung ba rta mchog rin chen lta bu'i skabs te drug pa/don gyi bya bral bla ma bsod nams bzang po/rigs kyi bdag po bya bral bsod nams bzang po ni/ shar mi nyag rab stong tshar sgang gi bye brag /ru sar sde ba bya ba'i 'brog sder/rnam dkar dge ba'i 'tsho bas bde bar rol ba/ yab o rgyan dang yum rta mgrin dbang mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa chu phag (1923)lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs pa ni 182

ji skad du/ rngon dang gdol ba la sogs pas/ /sprul ba'i lus kyis gdul bya rnams/ /yal bar mi 'dor 'dul bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin sku na phra mo'i dus nas byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs kyis gzhan phan gyi bgyi bar rab tu spro zhing yab las yi ge 'bri klog bslabs pas thogs med du mkhyen/ dgung grangs bcu tsam bzhes skabs ma rung kla klo'i dpung gis khyim gyi dngos po rnams 'phrog nas bcom brlags btang / yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas sprang po'i rnam pas nyi 'od dgon pa'i sgrub mchod mjal du phyin pas don lung sprul sku 'jigs med rin po ches bu 'di skyes bu rig bzang zhig lags pas ces kyang dgon 'di'i grwa ba byed dgos zhes gsung pa bzhin yab kyis gnang nas tshogs su zhugs/ 'brug mo'i thag nye bar gyi skal bzang skyes bo bsod nams can dag gi mchod pa'i zhing sa ma ṇi rdo 'bum chen mor khong yab sras rnams kyi rdo bsko yun ring mdzad de rgya bskyed gnang /skabs shig sgo 'dzi gter ston der phebs par yab kyis lung bstan zhus pas khong gis sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis sa ler 183

gzigs pa'i brda byang mang po gnang nas khyed kyi bu 'di bstan dang 'gro la phan thogs rgya chen 'grub pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig yin nges pas mi ring bar rdzogs chen du grwa sar 'byon dgos gsungs nas gsol rgyag gi rten mar sogs gnang ste nan por mdzad pas/ gter ston chen po'i lung bstan ltar rdzogs chen o rgyan bsam gtan chos gling du phebs nas slob rgan mar bzhugs pa na/ chos dung dkar mo 'bud thengs gcig gis 'dzin grwa khag bco lnga bgos te dus thog gcig tu mdo sngags gzhung lugs du ma kun dga' ra ba'i phyogs mtshams kun tu 'chad nyan mdzad skabs bcos min dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing 'phags yul na leṇ+ḍar dngos su sleb pa'i snang ba byung ba dang / nyid kyis kyang dbu ma bzhi brgya bar gsan bsam mdzad/ rdzogs sprul drug pa 'jigs bral byang chub rdo rje dang mkhan chen pad+ma tshe dbang / 'brug chen thub bstan bshad sgrub rgya mtsho bcas mkhan sprul dam pa dag gi mdun nas bka' gter smin grol gyi gdam pa zab mor longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang la lan gcig min par yang yang rol bar 184

mdzad/ mkhan chen thub snyan rin po che'i snyan pa gsan nas mdun lung khar phebs te mkhan chen rin po che'i mdun nas/ spyod 'jug dang / dbu ma 'jug pa/ klong chen mdzod bdun/ yon tan mdzod/ rgyud rgyal gsang ba snying po/ gsang bdag dgongs rgyan/gsang snying spyi don/ mun sel skor gsum/ sgom phyogs dris lan/khrid yig ye shes bla ma/ bar do drug khrid sogs mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas gzhi dbyings bya rtsol bral ba'i dgongs pa ngo 'phrod cing dgongs gter chos kyi brda byang yang yang babs pa mkhan rin po ches 'gro don mtha' rgyas su dmigs nas de ltar ma mdzad ces nan gyis bkags pa spyi bos blang / sku nyid la bdog pa'i dngos po yod tshad mchod sbyin byas shing na bza' hral hrul dang gsol ba ngan ngon gyi 'tsho bas bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar kho na bzhin mdzad pas grub pa'i rnal 'byor chen por gyur/ 'dan seng ge gnam rdzong pad+ma shel phug tu lo gcig gi ring sku mtsham bcad rgya mdzad nas bzhugs/ rdza stod lcang ma ri khrod du phebs te mkhan chen thub bstan chos 'phel gyi 185

mdun nas zab gsang chos kyi bdud rtsi dngar mor mi lo gsum gyi ring la rol bar mdzad/ mkhan rin po ches gdan zhus ltar ma ṇi bla ma pad+ma sid+dhi der phebs nas gdams khrid dang ma ṇi dbang lung gnang skabs 'tshogs gnas nag tshang nang yongs rdzogs 'ja' 'od kyis khyab pas bla ma mthong la mi mthong ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i rtags ltas mthun snang du byung / bcos min gyis dad pa skye zhing smon lam yang yang btab/ yang rdzogs chen du mar phebs nas mkhan nor 'phel sogs dang lhan rigs kyi bdag po 'jigs med rta mgrin yon tan mgon po las zab khrid spyi dang khyad par yang tig yid bzhin nor bu gdams ngag dmar khrid du mnos skabs mjug gi tshogs 'khor gyi mthun rkyen la dmigs nas sku la bgos pa'i na bza' bzang po rnams btsong nas sku nyid gcer bu min tsam byas pa sogs byang sems rtag du ngu'i rnam thar la 'khu ba'i chos phyir dka' spyad mdzad/ slar rang yul phyogs su phebs pa na/ sgo 'dzi gter ston gyis khyod gnas kyis gang zag byin gyi brlab pa'i grub pa'i gnas mchog rdzogs chen sogs dam pa gong 186

ma'i bsnyi gnas su mi sdod par pha yul du cis phyir 'ong yar song gsungs pas bka' bzhin yar phebs pa'i lam khar yid lhung 'ja' lus pa bsod nams rnam rgyal dang 'phrad pas khong rnam gnyis kyis las rgyu 'bras dang ma ṇi'i phan yon sogs zhal brda' mang du mdzad de gsol ja lhan du bzhes mthar zhing 'di'am zhing gzhan du lhan du bzhugs rgyu'i thugs smon btab/ de nas mkhan sprul rnams kyi mdun chos khrid ci rigs zhus/ bod pa sprul skur dri ba mang du byas pa sogs mdo sngags kyi gnas la thugs thag chod par mdzad/ mi nyag snyan lam dgon du rtsa ba'i bla ma phebs skabs dge slong grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/dus 'gyur la nye skabs phyir phebs nas da ni tshe gcig sgrub pa byed nas mi lus don can du bya snyam pa las gzhan ci yang bsam rgyu med pa zhig red 'dug gsungs pas spun gyi grogs byed par brten khu bo ri khrod du mtshams khang zhig gi sta gon bgyis na'ang nam 'chi cha med 'chi rkyen nges med la bsam nas ngas 'chi chos phar zhog 'bu mang po zhig gi srog bcad na nyes pa bsam gyis mi 187

khyab pas rang byung gi phug pa zhig 'tshol ba dga' snyam nas nges med du byon/ nyin zhig 'brog khyim zhig tu slebs tshe sa 'dir brag phug gam sa phug mi 'dug rung ba re e yod dris pa na rdzi bo tshe ring nyi ma bya bas gser rgya sgo na nga tsho char yib byed sa zhig yod zer nas lam ston du 'ong nas bstan/ khong gis sa phug che bar byas nas sku mtshams la bzhugs/ nyin zhig 'ur sgra dang bcas rbab rdo zhig 'gril ba thos byung bas ci yin snyam nas gzigs pas sngar med pa'i mdog dkar po 'od dang ldan pa zhig 'dug par gzigs su phyin pas rdo dkar po chos dung g.yas 'khyil lta bu zhig 'dug pa gnas 'dir dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa'i rten 'brel shin tu bzang bar dgongs nas chu mig cig yod pa de'i mgor bzhag cing khri brtsig yang thengs gcig gsol chu len du phyin skabs rdo kham pa lo ma'i dbyibs can ma ṇi rang byon dod pa cig rnyed pas khong gis myur bar chos khri bang rim can zhig brtsigs shing de'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ yang dus 'gyur byung la nye skabs rgad po bstan 'dzin zer ba'i rdzi bo zhig la ma ṇi'i phan 188

yon dang tshe mi rtag pa sogs gsung pas rgad pos chos la nges shes skyes nas ma ṇi bka' chen brgya brko bar dam bcas/ phyis rgad po mi snang bas ngo shes pa zhig slebs par/ bstan 'dzin gar e rig dris pas rgya dmag la ngo log pas bkrong song zer/ rjes su gzigs pas ma ṇi bka' chen brgyad cu tsam las mi 'dug pas rgad pos khas len mjug ma grub par tshe las 'das pa snying rje dgongs pa na ci cha med par tho gzong gnyis phyag tu 'byor bas bka' chen brgya dang brgyad grub par bzhengs nas sngar gyi chos khri'i steng du brtsigs te rab gnas dang bsngo ba mdzad/ ma 'ong bar kun gyi mchod gnas ma ṇi rdo mkhar zhig tu 'gyur ba'i thugs smon yang yang gnang bas rjes su rdo 'bum chen mo'i dbus su khel 'dug gsungs/ des na bya bral sangs rgyas tshe 'phel dang sprul 'brug grags rgya mtsho sogs gnas 'dir 'phrin las rgyas pa'ang bla ma rin po che 'di'i thugs bskyed gcig pu las byung ba gor ma chags la lo 'khor bcu phrag lhag la 'dir sku mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs pas mtshan rgya sgo'i bla mar grags pa byung / skabs shig 189

rgyud las gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid yongs su tshang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma mgon po mtsho phyag rgyar brten nas/ bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes lhan skyes bde ba chen po nyams su myong bas chos thams cad zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i nyams rtsal mngon du rdzogs/ dus 'gyur gyi zing 'khrugs cung dwangs skabs khu bo ri khrod du phebs nas stag tshang phug tu lo gsum gyi ring smra bcad kyis 'dzin pa rang grol bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs rjes chos 'khor rgya chen bskor ba ma zad nyid kyi gnas yig las/ rab byung bcu drug sa lug lo'i/ hor zla dgu ba'i tshes brgyad la/ /bka' gdams ma ṇi rang byung dang / /skye med ā yig rang byung 'di/ /dag snang mos gus lam nas mthong / /sogs gsung nas bzhag ma'i gnas sgo phye zhing ngo mtshar ba'i sku brnyan dang yig 'bru sogs rang byung mang po ngos bzung zhing 'phrin las rgya cher spel/ de nas phyogs kun la ma ṇi gsung ba sogs yun ring chos 'khor bskor ba'i 'bul nod rnams kyis khu bo ri khrod du lha khang bzhengs pa'i nyer bsdogs mdzad pa la mgo dar dang nag lung lcam pa sogs 'brog sde rnams 190

dang / 'dzi nang 'bar chag sogs kyis gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa legs par bskrun/ dam chos 'dul ba ni rgyal bstan yun ring du gnas pa'i gzhi mar dgongs nas seng ge dgon gyi ston 'khor yongs rdzogs gdan 'dren zhus shing gzhi gsum gyi phyag bzhes ma nyams pa'i dbyar gnas 'tshogs pa ni mi nyag yul gyi yang dar bstan pa'i me ro slong ba'i thog mar zhes skye bo kun gyis gleng / rā tī mkhan dge 'dun bzang po'i mdun nas klong chen mdzod bdun snying thig ya bzhi sogs yun ring gsan/ sgrib med dus gsum mkhyen pa'i brda lung gis mchog sprul tshe dbang rnam grol/ sprul 'od zer rdo rje/ bka' bzhi sprul sku sogs ngos 'dzin gnang / yang rā tī dgon slar gso mdzad par thugs bskyed rnam par dag pas bdog rgu zhal 'debs su gnang zhing mjug grub pa na sku nyid phebs nas rab gnas dang shis brjod sogs mdzad sgo rgyas par spros/ gtsug lag khang du lo gcig gi ring kar gling zhi khro dang rig 'dus sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol bar mdzad nas zhi khro'i dbang dang rig 'dus/ 'dzin grol 191

bcas kyi dbang dang thos grol chen mo dang bstan srung yong rdzogs sogs kyi ljags lung gnang / mi lo bdun gyi ring sid+dhi'i bum sgrub chen mo sogs kyi rdo rje rgyal po mdzad/ mi nyag gi yul phal mo cher ma ṇi sirnyi sogs kyi dung sgrub bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phrin las kyis phyogs kun khyab par byas/ 'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas mi nyag tu phebs skabs mjal bar phyin pa na/ chos rje rin po ches zhal nas khyed la re ba chen po zhig yod gsung / legs so zhus pas nga ri bo rtse lnga nas yar sleb pa'i bar khyed kyis a ra pa tsa dung brgya dang dbang sdud gsol 'debs khri dar zhig 'grub par gyis dang ngas ri bo rtse lnga nas bzang spyod sogs kyi dge rtsa yongs rdzogs khyed dpon slob yongs la bsngo gsungs/ khong gis thugs khur gnang bzhin lha sgang du phebs nas yong rdzogs bde blag tu 'grub/ de nas skya ki gser gdong ri khrod dang / gnas mchog pho brang lnga brtsegs/ 'bo gangs dkar gnas nang sogs su bsgrub pa yun ring mdzad/ bde mchog gdugs dkar gyi gnas mchog ra mkhar du lo bcu'i ring sku mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs/192

'dzi nang klu rgyal dung ri'i zhol du lha khang bzhengs shing rab gnas sogs mdzad nas chos kyi sgo 'phar legs par phyes/ mtshan yang mdo sngags bshad sgrub nyi ma rang shar gtsug lag khang zhes btags/ phyi gling ba zhig gis g.yang ṭi las bskrun pa'i shākya mu ne'i sku brnyan mi tshad tsam zhig phul bas 'o shin tu bzang ston pa thugs rje can 'gro ba'i don la phebs pa lags pas byin rlabs kyi tshan kha dbus lha ldan gyi jo bo dang mnyam gsungs/ sku nyid kyis ngos bzung ba'i mchog sprul tshe dbang rnam grol mchog la khong gis dngos rdzas rnams phul nas 'di'i gzhi bgyis nas rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang mgul rgyan sogs longs sku'i cha byad can du bsgyur mdzod gsungs pa sbyi bos mchod nas rin thang bral ba'i rin bo che'i rgyan gyis spros nas 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i mchod gnas su ra ti dga' ldan gling du bzhugs su gsol/ rdzogs chen sprel zla tshes bcu'i khri tshogs chen mor phebs shing snga 'gyur chos rgyud dang bcas lhan tu dgyes mjal dang smon lam 'tshogs/ de nas mgo dar lha sde gtsos gdul 'gro dag la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 193

bskor nas sngar nyid kyis btabs pa'i khu bo ri khrod kyi dgon gnas su rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon por bsgrengs nas bdag sogs 'gro ba kun gyi dpal du bzhugs bzhin lags pa gang nyid zhabs pad mi 'gyur rdo rje'i chos bdun gyi ngo bor brtan cing thugs bzhed mtha' dag gegs med du 'grub par gyur cig gu/ /mchog sprul tshe dbang rnam grol/mchog sprul tshe dbang rnam grol rin po che'i mdzad rnam phul du byung ba mang na'ang mchog nyid kyis dgongs gnang ma byung bas skabs shig rten 'brel mtha' can du bya ba las 'os med pas bzhag go//bla ma dar rgyas/bla ma dar rgyas sam thub bstan mtsho skyes pad+ma ni/ gnas nang dgon du tshogs zhugs mdzad/ mchog sprul tshul lo dang rgyan lo 194

sogs kyi mdun nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par gsan bsam yun ring mdzad pas mkhas par gyur/ 'khor bar nges 'byung drag pos chos bros mdzad nas lha sa'i rdo rje brag e waṃ cog sgar du phyi nang gsang ba'i chos tshul mang por sbyangs shing mi lo du mar bzhugs pas mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/ de nas bod kyi gnas chen yod do cog dang bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum sogs bal bo'i gnas rnams mjal skabs sngags 'chang zhig gis khyod song dang bya rung kha shor gyi rtsa bar dngos grub zhig yod gsung / song ba na ring bsrel phor gang rnyed pa phyis khong gis ring bsrel gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod rten bzhengs shing gzungs gzhug tu phul ba'o/ /gzhan rgya gar gyi gnas chen khag sogs zhabs thang kho nas bskor bas byin rlabs dang lung bstan mang po thob/ gzhan yang g.yon ru gter chen pas/ bai ro'i sprul ba dar gyi ming can 'byung: mdo khams smad du sa dkar thig le bkra:zhes 'byung ba bzhin mdo khams smad kyi sa gnad rnams su mchod rten cha brgyad sogs mchod rten rab tu mang po bzhengs shing 'gro 195

ba rnams kyi nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi ba sogs phan dang bde ba rgya chen po bskrun/ dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs shing sde brgyad bran du 'du ba kun kyis yid ches byas/ skabs shig ra this dgon du mchod rten cha brgyad bzhengs skabs gzhi bdag dang sde brgyad dag gis mngon sum mthun snang du grogs byas/ gzhan yang stong dar dang shug lung sogs su mchod rten mang po bzhengs nas yar phebs/ dus 'gyur gyi spyod ngan che ru phyin pas slar yang mar phebs/ ra mkhar sogs su yun ring bzhugs/ de nas ra this yang dgon du bzhugs nas dgongs klong chos kyi brda mdzod las phab pa'i bsang yig rgyas bsdus 'ga' dang gnas bstod/ chos skyong gi bskang gsol sogs mang po da lta'ang bzhugs pa'o/ /phyis ra this dgon du bdag da nas skye ba gcig gi gzhug mar dgon 'dir phan thog 'byung tshul sogs lung bstan mang du gsungs nas sku bsnyun pa sogs gang yang med par sku tshugs drang por bsring nas zhi bar gshegs so/ /196

sprul sku a dpal/rgyal 'phags sprul sku a dpal ni/ mi nyag nags bran 'brog sde ru sku 'khrungs/ rgyal rjes bya bral rin po ches khri ba btsan bla ye shes kyi yang srid du ngos bzung / ye ge 'bri klog sogs chags thogs med par sbyang zhing bcos min nges 'byung drag pos rgyud bskul te dam pa'i chos phyir bros nas g.yu khog tu phyin/ g.yu khog gi bla sprul 'ga' dang khyad par du bya bral chos dbyings rang grol thun min gyi rigs bdag tu bsten nas mi lo drug bdun gyi ring thun mong gi chos tshul spyi dang thun min smin grol gyi gdams pa mang po bum pa gang byo'i bka' drin bstsal cing slob bu mchog tu bsngags/ skabs shig bya bral rin po ches nyid kyi sku tshab tu ma hā skyid lung dgon du mngag pas khong gis smin grol chos kyi 'khor los yun ring por yul dgon gnyis po bde bar bskyang ba na dus 'gyur gyi 'tshubs cha che ru phyin nas 'o brgyal chen po byas/ de nas pha yul du pheb nas la 'ur thang du bcad mtshams bzhugs/ zhar 197

la slob tshogs rnams la kun bzang bla ma sogs gsung nas yun ring bzhugs/ gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi khur khyer nas mgo dar sde bar byon nas chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen spel/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dbyings sogs la 'gan bkal nas ra this dgon slar gso dang chos kyi sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i bka' gnang / bka' bzhin ma ṇi dung 'khor dang dus mchod sogs grub par byas pas slar yang mar phebs nas thugs bskyed chen pos dgon pa dngos slar gso bya dgos tshul bka' slob mang po gnang ba dang mkhan sprul smin grol rin po che'i yang sprul dgongs rtags gsal bas ngos bzung ba sogs lan gcig min par yang yang phebs nas bka' drin bskyangs ba brjod las 'das/ de nas yar pheb nas la 'ur thang du yun ring bzhugs shing mthar zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ / bla ma nam mkha' chos dbyings/rig pa 'dzin pa gnubs zur nam mkha' chos dbyings rig 198

pa'i rdo rje ni/ rab byung bcu drug pa chu bya lor ra this dga' ldan gling gi nye char rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa gnubs zur bya ba'i 'brog khyim du yab pad legs dang yum rgya mkhar a gsal gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams/ nyin zhig mas khur nas khu bo mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis sku mtshams su bzhugs pa'i mdun du song ba na/ khu bos 'o rten 'brel bzang byung mdang dgong bdag la rmi lam mtshar bo zhig byung mchog sprul 'jam dpal rin po che 'dir phebs nas bdag la nam mkha'i mang zhig 'dog dgos gsungs pas bu 'dir nam mkha' chos dbyings thogs gsung / de nas khu bo las yi ge 'bri klog bslab tshe rig pa bzo yi gnas lha bca' 'bri/ mgar/ shing la sko dkrol/ gos 'tshem 'drub sogs ma bslab 'bad med du mkhyen pa ma zad 'don rta dbyangs sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag bzhes rnams brda bstan pa tsam gyis khong du chud/shes rab che ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i rtags mtshan mi phal ba las 'das zhes kun gyis gleng / de nas khong gi lcam sring che ba dbang sgron ri khud sku zhabs chos kyi 'od zer gyi rigs mar blangs skabs 199

khong yang ri khud dgon du phebs/ ri sprul rin po che dang brag g.yab mkhan po sogs bla mar brten nas mdo sngags kyi chos phyogs rer sbyang ba mdzad/ lha ris lhag pa'i mdun nas rtsis la gzigs pas rtsis dkar nag la mkhas pa'i tshad du grags/ khong rnam dpyod bzang bas ri sprul rin po che'i phyag mdzod du bskos pas sri zhu yun ring bsgrub/ gzhan yang khu bo bsod nams bkra shis kyi mdun nas klong chen snying thig gi chos skor gtso bor gyur ba'i snga 'gyur snying ma'i smin grol gyi gdams pa mang po mnog chos su thob/ bla ma dar rgyas mchog gis khong dge slong nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam rol 'khrul med yin par gsung pa sogs bla ma 'gas bsngags pa byas/ skabs shig dus 'gyur zing 'khrug gi yun ring mnar zhing dus zing bde 'jag tu song ma thag sprul a dpal rin po che'i bka' bzhin sngar gyi dgon shul du ma ṇi dung 'khor dang sid+dhi'i bum sgrub chen mo dbyar gnas sogs gsar 'dzugs gyi thugs 'gan gtso bo gnang / rim bzhin lhag bsam gyi thugs spobs chen pos ra this dga' ldan gling gi 'du khang chen mo phyi 200

nang gsang ba rten dang brten pa'i legs mdzad mjug grub par bgyis pa bcas mi lo bcu gsum gyi ring la bka' drin chen pos thugs 'gan bzhes rjes bstan pa'i khur mchog sprul rnam grol la spos/ deng skabs khong nyid phyogs med 'gro ba'i don du bsnyen sgrub las kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas las bzhi gang bsgrub kyang mthu nus dang rtags ltas phun sum tshogs pas bka' drin skyong bzhin pa'o/ /bla ma tshe ring chos 'phel/ sngags 'chang tshe ring chos 'phel ni/ bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu khyi lor yab sog rag tshul khrims dang / yum bsod nams dpal skyid gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ khu bo dbang phyug las klog bslab/ nyag rong brag ri sprul sku mthu stobs rdo rjes brag ri pad+ma rnam rgyal gyi yang srid du ngos bzung nas lan gcig ma yin par sku bdag bya chog pa'i re ba lan mang byas kyang phas ma gnang / de nas ra this dga' ldan gling gi tshogs su zhugs nas mthong brgyud 201

kyi phyag len 'don dbyangs bca' rdung sogs la mkhas pa'i tshad du grags/ mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis rigs kyi bdag por bsnyen nas sngon 'gro blo sbyong gi rim pa nas bzung klong chen snying thig gi khrid skor rnams kyis gtsos smin grol gyi gdams pa mang po thob/ skabs shig ri sprul chos kyi 'od zer gyi mdun nas chos bka' mang zhig gsan/ ri sprul gyi zhal nas sngon gling dkar po yul na bdag rgya tsha zhal dkar yin dus khyod mi chung kha bde yin snang shar/ da khyed rang rdza bkra rin chen sgang du mtshams la sdod gsungs/ bka' bzhin rdza bkrar phebs nas mtshams la bzhugs/nyin zhig da ni 'gro dgos snyam nas 'byon pa'i nyer bsdogs byas pa'i nub mor ye shes rgyu ma'i rnam pas ri sprul rin po che mngon sum du byon nas khyod gang du 'gro sdod sogs gsung bas rab tu dad pas legs so zhus/ mi lo gsum gyi bar bcad mtshams dam por bzhugs/ hor ra brag them nas srin rgyal rak+ṣa thod phreng gi sgrub thabs gter nas spyan drangs nas chos bdag brag mkhar sprul sku pad rdor la sprad pa dang gzhan yang gter nas bton pa'i 202

dngos po 'ga' yod tshul dang gzhi bdag sogs mi min rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa yin zhes grags/ ma se man+dal thog sogs su 'dus pa rgya chen por chos bka' mang po bstsal/ dgung grangs nga gnyis bzhes pa chu glang lor ma se bya ba'i yul du zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /dgon dpon shes rab stobs ldan/bla ma shes rab stobs ldan ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i me khyi lor pha seng seng zan thar dang / ma gnub bza' pad+ma chos sgron gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ yi ge 'bri klog sogs byang chub pa ra byas/ de nas rdzogs chen du grwa sar phebs/ rgya kong gzhan dga' rin po che'i mdun nas mtshan nyid theg pa'i chos tshul mang por gsan bsam yun ring mdzad/ zhar la rdzogs chen o rgyan bsam gtan gling du mthong brgyud kyi phyag bzhes rnams la mkhas par bslab/ mar rang dgon du pheb pa na mchog sprul 'jam dpal rin po ches ra this dgon slar gso sogs kyi gtso 'gan par 203

bskos pas phyag rogs btsun pa dpal chen dang khong gnyis kyis sa stag(1938)lor yang dben bsam gtan gling du 'du khang rten dang brten pa grub par bzhengs nas lo ltar tshogs dang dus mchod rnams phyi nang gsang ba'i cha rkyen dang bca' khrims phun sum tshogs pas mi lo nyi shu lhag gi ring thugaso khur gnang / rdzogs chen mkhan po thub snyan rin po che'i mdun nas khrid yig ye shes bla ma sogs smin grol gdams pa mang po mnog chos su thob pas nyams len la brtson pa rgya chen bgyis/ dus zing skabs thugs rab tu sun nas me rta lor sku tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs par byas so/ /bla ma dge 'dun sogs/ /rgya mkhar dge 'dun ni/ thog mar tshes bcu dgon du tshogs zhugs mdzad nas rdzogs chen du phebs/ mkhan po bsod chos mdun nas chos mang po zhus/ de nas a 'dzom du phebs/ 'brug rgan 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje thun min gyi rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten nas gsang sngags rdzogs pa chen po zab khrid man ngag dang bcas 204

pa mnog chos su thob/ bla ma'i slob bu mchog tu gyur nas yun ring bzhugs/ de nas phyir rang yul du phebs nas ra this gong ma'am 'bri this nags khrod sogs su sku mtshams kho nar bzhugs pas nyams rtogs kyi yon tan mtho ba'i tshad du grags pa'o/ /gzhan yang ri khrod pa ste mchog sprul chos nyid/ mchog sprul tshe dbang mthar phyin/ bla ma rig chos/ dge bshes dbang phyug mkhan rdo rje yon tan/ mkhas pa pad+ma rdo rje sogs rang dgon la bka' drin che ba'i mkhan sprul de dag gi rnam thar theng 'dir 'bri ma thub kyang rten 'brel mtha' can du byas nas nam zhig dad ldan skye bo dag gi mdun stegs su 'bul ba'i bsgo skal ma khur rang bab kyi bya ba yongs rdzogs mthar phyin par gyur cig gu /gang 'dul gdul bya'i zhing sa gshin po ru/ /thugs bskyed smon pa'i sa bon legs btabs pas/ / legs tshogs phan dang bde ba'i myu gu'i tshal/ /bzhad par mdzad pa gang dag cis mi bsngags/ /rgyal bstan gangs ri'i spo na mngon 'gying ba'i/ /205

sa chen sems dpa' gdong lnga'i rgyal bo che/ /mi 'jigs spobs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs pa yis/ /gangs ri dkar bo'i snyan pa phyogs su bsgrags/ /'chad pa thogs med bdud rtsi'i gru chur 'jo/ /rtsod pa zla med glog gi zlos gar mkhan/ /rab 'byams rtsom pa'i sgra brgya'i nga ro yis/ /'gro khams dge ba'i rma bya'i gdugs gor phub/ /gang zhig dwangs pas mthong thos dran reg dang / /mchod dang bstod pa'i bsod nams 'bras bzang bas/ /phyi ma'i mtha' 'dir mdzad pa'i cha phra mo/ /ri mor bgyi ba'i skal bzang bdag la'ang rmad/ /mtha' yas 'gro khams mun pa'i ru grong kun/ /gang gi thugs bskyed smon pa'i gzi 'od gyis/ /yongs su khyab cing bde dga'i snang ba 'bum/ /skad cig tsam yang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /206

gang na thugs bskyed smon pa'i she mong gis/ /bstan 'gro'i khur chen 'degs pa ji snyed kun/ /sku tshe rdo rje'i khams su rab brtan zhing //mdzad 'phrin gegs med phyogs kun khyab gyur cig/mjug sdud bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan pa btsun mo rin chen lta bu'i skabs te bdun pa/mjug sdud pa'i gtam/deng 'dir ches mang ba'i bgrang bya'i rlabs phreng lang long du g.yo ba'i chu gter chen po dag na lo rgyus kyi gzi 'od mngon la mi mngon pa'i nor bu bzang po dag byi dor ma bgyis na rim gyis nyams nas rdo ba phal ba'i gral du lus pa'i ngan khag lcid mo zhig rang cag gi phrag tu 'bab la nye ba'i dus rabs 'dir/ bdag 207

gis kyang lhag bsam dar thag gis lcibs pa'i nor bu chung chung zhig rtsol ba phra mos byi dor bgyis shing mngon sum gyi gzigs mor phul bar gcig tu spro na'ang / thos mthong gi shes rgya dbul zhing lo rgyus 'di dag ni yun ring zhing hor sog gis btsan 'dzul sogs 'phel 'grib mang rkyen/ lo rgyus dang chos 'byung sogs dpyad gzhi'i yig cha phar cher mi min gyi spyod yul du gyur zin pas/mthong rgya dog pa'i skyes bo 'ga' zhig gis deng dus su mngon sum dngos yod kho na rgyu mtshan du byas nas bod kyi lo rgyus spyi dang bye brag mi nyag dang ra this kyi lo rgyus la yang skur 'deb cung re byed mkhan de dag ni rgya bod kyi rig gzhung la 'dren byed ldong zhing tha na 'dus byas yin na mi rtag pa yin pa tsam mi mkhyen pa'i sgrob nyams shig tu zad de da lta'i mthong tshod 'di las lo rgyus dang rgyu mtshan gang yang mi 'tshol bas shes la/ gzhan gzur gnas blo dang ldan pa ji snyed cig gis 'das pa'i mi lo mang po'i yar sngon du dgongs pa gcig dang mgrin gcig tu mngon sum ri mo 'bur dod kyi dan rtags khag cig 'u cag gi mdun stegs su bkram pa 208

las gsal bar shes la/ 'dir yang nga tshos lo rgyus yig rnying dag las skabs su bab pa'i lo rgyus zur du bkol ba dang rgyu mtshan can gyi ngag sgros yang dag pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrig na rmongs pa rmongs pas mgo mi skor bar ma zad skal mnyam gyi grogs po dag la rin thang ldan pa'i nor bu zhig tu mthong nas mgrin pa'i gzengs mthon pos smra bar spobs kyi/ med pa yod par sgrub pa'i rab btags dang / yod pa med par smod pa'i skur 'debs/phyogs lhung ris su chad pa'i 'khyog bshad sogs byed pa ni bdag gis spobs kyang mi spobs la/ spobs na'ang nyes pa mtha' yas pa'i rgyu ru zad de/ dper na sbal ba rma can bzhin du rang 'dod 'khyog por bshad pa'i lo rgyus ngan pa gcig gis/ lo rgyus yod tshad the tshom za ba'i snyogs 'dzing gi drwa rgya chen po zhig tu tshud pa myong bas grub pas rang cag rigs mthun kun gyis rtag tu gzab par thugs rje ma chung zhes lan brgyar zhu ba lags so/ /las smon bsod nams dpyid kyi rgyal mo yis/ /rgyal kun mi yi zol bsgyur dbyar gyi dpal/ /209

gnas 'dir mgron du bsus pā'i dpal yon de/ /bdag 'dra'i byis blos gzhal ba'i skabs dben yang //'di snang rgya las grol ba'i rnal 'byor dang //lung rig kho lag rdzogs pa'i mkhas pa yis/ /ri thang dogs mor byas pa'i skal bzang la/ /dwangs pas smon pa'i phyi phyag cis mi 'tshal/ /sngon rabs mkhas pa'i rnam thar bgrangs yas kyang //thogs med lo yi 'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshe//'byung bzhi'i dbyings su bag la zha na yang / /ma nyams sa 'og gser bzhin 'di na bkra/ /yang dag rig pa'i lam bzang la brten nas/ /don gyi gnas lugs ci bzhin bkod pa'i gtam//phyogs ris la rgya'i khu tshur mi 'phyar bar//drang por brjod 'di kho bo'i skal bar snyam/ /210

rnying zhen snyan pa'i grags dkar phyogs su ngoms/ /re ba'i goms stabs mdun du mi bskyod par/ /mgo mkhreg mjug ma ring ba'i sprel rgan gyi/ /log rtog mjug ma gcod pa'i zhu rten yin/ / srid pa'i gangs rgan chags pa'i yul gru 'dir/ /rigs kyi myu gu'i lang tsho rdzogs na yang / /phyogs su lhung ba'i legs skar spun zla la/ /mtshangs 'bru'i tshig gis rna ba 'gas par byos/ /pha chos nor bu'i rin thang mi dpyad par/ /rang 'dod dug lce g.yo ba'i bgegs tshogs la/ /brgal brtags yas glud bzang po'i rdzong 'debs bcas//thar med rgya mtsho'i pha mthar deng 'dir sprad/ /bgrang bya brgya phrag du ma rab 'das pa'i/ /snang brnyan ris su 'char ba'i a dar+sha/ /gangs phrug 'khyam pos bod rtsam zos pa'i rin//211

'khyog med tshangs pa'i gnam thig btab te bskrun/ /dus kyi 'jug pas zhing gzhan gshegs na yang / /dam pa'i mdzad bzang lhad med dri bral gser/gling bzhi'i khyon na grags pa'i ba dan 'di/srid pa'i mthar yang nyams pa med la ltos/yang dag thugs bskyed lha reg klub pa las/nyer grub thub bstan rgyal mtshan mngon mtho bar/gdul 'gro'i bsod nams rgud pa'i bar chad kyis/ngam nag grib ma'i tho mtshams kye ma hud//legs pa'i khe grags gleng na rna ba 'gas/ /nyes pa'i chag sgo gleng na snying rtsa 'phar/ /mi rtag srid pa sgyu ma'i gar mkhan mas/ /ma rtogs 'khrul ba'i 'gro la chag sgo bzos/ /yul nas chag sgo'i tshul 'gel ma mchis kyang /212

ngan rtog phyogs lhung nang gi lcags 'khor gyis//rang gzhan phye mar 'thag pa'i phung sbyor de//rigs mthun nang nas ma skor sku tshe ring //khams dbang mos pa gcig tu ma nges pas/ /rim bzhin lam la dkri ba'i dgos dbang gis//rgyal sras sems dpa'i gsung tshul tha dad kyang //don la 'gal ba mi srid mthar thug gcig /chos don kha ru khyer ba'i dge sbyong khyus/ / drang srong thub pa'i bka' dang ma 'gal na/ /grub mtha'i zhe 'dod phra mo'i 'khon 'gras kyis//nam yang sdang zhen ma mdzad sku tshe ring / /che mtho khri la 'dzegs pa'i brnab sems dang / /'ud shom bcos ma'i zol gyis grags 'dod min//'byung dang 'byung 'gyur bdag dang skal mnyam zlar/ /lhag bsam dag pas dpyad pa'i stegs su bstabs//213

dam pa'i sku dang gsung gi mdzad dkar las//thugs kyi gsang ba blo yis ma dpog kya nga / /rnam thar cha shas mthong thos gtsor byas nas//gsong po'i gtam gyis sri zhu phra mo bskrun/ /tshul 'dis nam zhig bstan dang 'gro ba la/ /phan sogs dge ba'i dngos po gang mchis pa/ /gcig tu bsdus nas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /phan bde dpal gyis 'tsho ba'i rgyu ru smon/ /shis par brjod pas mtha' brgyan pa/srid na nyon mongs me yis rab gdung ba'i//bde 'dod re ba gcig pa'i srog ldan khyu/ /zhi bde gdugs dkar dam pa'i bsil 'og tu//tshud padza sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i bkra shis shog /214

zhi bsil rang dbang gtsang ma'i chu gter che/ /nam yang bri med bde dga'i rlabs phreng la/ /gzhi byes gser gyi nya mo rtag rtsen pa'i//skal bzang gangs ljongs gsar ba'i bkra shis shog /grub rig bye ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsi mchog /srid pa'i nad kun gzhil ba'i bcud bzang pos//yongs su gtam pa'i 'dod 'jo'i bum pa bzang /rnam kun longs su spyod pa'i bkra shis shog/ brtse chen nyi ma'i drod kyis ma btang zhing //nges 'byung byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan pa'i//sems dpa'i gdung rigs pad+ma dkar po'i tshal//dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /lhad med lhag bsam dkar po'i rang mdangs kyis/ /zhi bde'i ded dpon 'bod pa'i skya rengs la/ /shis smon dung dkar snyan pa'i rang sgra yis/215

rdzogs ldan ston la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /bsil ldan sa la'i mtshan pa'i sman ljongs su/ /bcu phrag rig pa gter gyi sgo phye nas//lugs zung bde dga' mi 'gyur dpal be'u ris/ /rgud med rtag tu bkra ba'i bkra shis shog /grangs med shes bya'i dar thag gcig btags pa'i/ /bcu phrag lha gos gtsang ma'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /thub bstan 'dod 'byung nor bu'i tog mthon po//nyams med bshad dang sgrub pa'i bkra shis shog /dri bral gangs ri'i mu khyud zlum po ru/ /lnga rig gser gyi rtsib stong mngon bkra ba'i//lugs zung zhi bde dpal gyi 'khor lo mchog /'bral med rtag tu rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /216

brtsam bya 'di nyid dang 'brel ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/(1)chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ (2)'bri gung chos 'byung /(3)karma kai tshang brgyud pa rin po che'i rnam thar/(4)rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long /(5)lho rong chos 'byung /(6)rnying rgyud dkar chags 'dzam gling tha grur khyab pa'i rgyan/(7)bka' chem ka keṅgel ma/(8)sde dge bka' 'gyur dkar chags/(9)jo nang chos 'byung /(10)thub bstan mtsho skyes pad+ma'i gnas bstod/(11)gu bkra'i chos 'byung /(12)mdo smad chos 'byung /(13)mi nyag mkhas dbang lnga'i rnam thar/217

(14)shar ba'i chos 'byung /(15)mkhas dbang byams gsar ba'i rnam thar 'thor ba dag bsdus pa rin po che'i do shal/(16)rdzogs chen chos 'byung /(17)rgya rong dpyad yig(18)bod kyi lo rgyus gleng ba'i gtam/(19)bod kyi lo rgyus slob gzhi/(20)deb ther sngon po/(21)lha sgang gnas yig gter ma/(22)la dwags rgyal rabs/(23)bzhag ma'i gnas yig phag gdong ri'i gnas yig(24)dkar mdzes khul dgon pa khag gi lo rgyus/(25)bai ro'i rnam thar pad+ma'i dga' tshal/(26)'bo gangs dkar sprul sku'i rnam thar/(27)deb dmar dang de'i 'grel ba/(28)gnas yig phyogs bsgrig218

(29)skyes mchog 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i rang rnam chen mo/(30)mu li'i chos 'byung /(31)bod rgya tshigs mdzod/(32)rang dgon gyi lo rgyus brjed byang 'thor bo/(33)bsang yig rgyas bsdus 'ga' dang bcas pa'o 219

mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i gsung gi dkar chagachos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus gnyis/ sa/ paṇa rnam thar/ byang chub sems dpa' dang nor bzang gi rtogs brjod/ slob dpon ye shes rdo rje'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus gnyis/rang rnam gzhan phan nyi ma'i 'od zer/ rgyud lung btus pa gal mdo gnad kyi sgron me/ dad pa'i rnam bzhag /thub pas dus gsumyo/ lung bstan/ sngags kyi lag len/ lam rim/ sgrub thabs dang bstod pa gsol 'debs sna tshogs/ mgon po'i lo rgyus/ he ru ka'i gar dgu'i rnam bshad/ rgyal sras lag len gyi rnam bshad/ shan 'byed chos kyi me long gi 'grel ba/ lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo'i gso thigs kyi 'grel ba/ bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam gyi 'grel ba/rgyal sras bcas kyi yon tan rab tu gsal ba'i me long / snyigs 220

dus kyi gtam brjod pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i 'grel ba/ mngon mtho dang nges legs rab tu gsal ba'i me long ma 'ong ser gzugs rnams kyi lung bstan/ sems bskyed kyi phan yon dang cho gaskyes rabs phyag 'tshal ma/ byang sems zhing bkod dang bslab bya/byang sems kyi spyod yul bstan pa/ sangs rgyas kyis phal cher gsung ba'i 'khor 'dus pa'i tshul/ mthong lam yon tan gyi grangs/ byams pa sgom pa'i tshul/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i man ngag rin po che'i gser 'gyur/ legs nyes gsal bar byed pa'i ri chos/ blo sbyong brgyud pa'i rnam thar/theg chen blo sbyong gi rtsa tshig bsdus 'grel/skyid sdug lam khyer/blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel ba/dmigs skor/blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i 'grel ba/ rgyab chos gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/ lo rgyus sbas don gsal ba/ mos khrid kyi rgyab chos nges lung rnam par bkod pa/ sprul sku'i mdun du chos kyi bkaljori lung 'bul ba'i tho tse/ 'bul yig snga phyi gsum/ bla rnal dang maṇ+ḍal/bla ma mang po'i gsol 'debs dang rnam thar tshigs bcad ma'i skor/ phyogs med kyi brgyud pa so so'i gsol 'debs dang smon 221

lam skor/ mgur 'bum tshan pa brgya dang bdun/ dris lan skor tshan pa nyer gcig /bsang mchod bdud rtsa'i thigs pa/ lha mo rtse dang gangs dkar gyi bsang mchod/ lha mo rtsa'i bstod pa dang phrin bcol/ rdo rje g.yu khro gyi bsang / thang shing rgyal ba'i dben gnas dang lha mo rtse'i dkar chag /sman yig rin chen phreng ba/ sngags btus gzhan phan 'od zer/ /smon lam skor tshan nyi shu/ bzang spyod 'grel ba/ bcas khong gi dngos slob bla ma sangs rgyas dpal gyis bsgrig pa'i dkar chag gsal ba'i me long las btus pa'o//
